thesis.business_description: UNIOR Kovaska industrija d.d. (Zrece, Slovenia) is a forging, hand tools and machine-building group supplying the automotive and other industries; it sold its tourism division (Unitur, Rogla and Terme Zrece) in 2025 and has been selling other stakes.
thesis.competitive_position: Established Slovenian forging and tools manufacturer with 2024 revenue of EUR 194.9m but a parent net loss of EUR 41.2m ([Seenews](https://seenews.com/companies/unior-d-d-4105)); heavily indebted despite disposals ([Delo](https://www.delo.si/gospodarstvo/novice/unior-podpisal-dogovor-z-bankami)). Group returned to a small net profit of EUR 328k in H1 2026 after last year's loss ([Delo](https://www.delo.si/gospodarstvo/novice/unior-po-dveh-letih-izgube-spet-z-dobickom)). Competitive position is that of an automotive supplier with cost pressure; no strong moat.
thesis.main_shareholders: 2023 SDH general-meeting report: Slovenski drzavni holding (SDH) 39.4262%, Kapitalska druzba 5.5514%, treasury shares 2.4586% ([SDH report](https://www.sdh.si/Data/Documents/porocila-skupscine/2023/2023_07_05_Porocilo_Unior.pdf)); current stakes after the 2026 recapitalization process not found.
thesis.red_flags: Heavy leverage: debt to six banks (mainly NLB and OTP banka) and an estimated need of about EUR 50m of fresh capital, with the company sounding out the market for a share capital increase on 9 Jul 2026 ([Delo](https://www.delo.si/gospodarstvo/novice/unior-podpisal-dogovor-z-bankami)); 2025 group loss of EUR 54m per Delo; shareholders previously rejected a capital-cut plan ([Seenews](https://seenews.com/news/slovenias-unior-shareholders-reject-capital-cut-plan-807702)); state (SDH) controlling-holder dynamics; potential dilution from recapitalization.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (state fund SDH, about 39% in 2023, is the largest holder; no management stake found).

thesis.business_description: Finnish manufacturer of Honka log houses and log-building products (design, production and export of log homes and public/commercial log structures), with net sales of EUR 37.2m in 2025.
thesis.competitive_position: Long-established Finnish log-house brand with international exports; 2025 net sales rose 1.2% to EUR 37.2m but EPS was EUR -0.70 (2024: -0.37) ([2025 financial statements bulletin](https://www.inderes.fi/releases/honkarakenne-oyjs-financial-statements-bulletin-1-january-31-december-2025)). Order book at end-June 2026 was EUR 33.6m (+28% y/y), supported by large orders such as OnWood's 100+ log structures ([H1 2026 report](https://www.inderes.fi/releases/honkarakenne-oyj-half-year-report-1-january-to-30-june-2026)). Brand is a niche advantage but profitability is cyclical.
thesis.main_shareholders: AKR-Invest Oy 17.0% of capital / 8.9% of votes; Saarelainen Oy 10.4% of capital / 27.2% of votes (Inderes ownership page, undated snapshot) ([Inderes](https://www.inderes.fi/en/companies/Honkarakenne/ownership)); the four largest holders at 31.8.2025 were Saarelainen Oy, AKR-Invest Oy, Marko Saarelainen (CEO) and Arimo Ristola ([nomination committee notice](https://www.inderes.fi/releases/ilmoitus-honkarakenne-oyj-osakkeenomistajien-nimitystoimikunnalle)).
thesis.red_flags: Loss-making: EPS EUR -0.70 in 2025, no dividend ([bulletin](https://www.inderes.fi/releases/honkarakenne-oyjs-financial-statements-bulletin-1-january-31-december-2025)); H1 2026 operational EBIT EUR -2.2m, net sales down 5.3%, equity ratio down to 41.7% from 52.3%, net financial liabilities EUR 2.2m ([H1 2026 report](https://www.inderes.fi/releases/honkarakenne-oyj-half-year-report-1-january-to-30-june-2026)); dual-class structure gives Saarelainen Oy 27.2% of votes on 10.4% of capital; delivery-timing dependence on large orders; CEO said in April 2026 he would not stand for the board.
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Marko Saarelainen is among the four largest shareholders (stake % not seen) and Saarelainen Oy holds 10.4% of capital/27.2% of votes ([nomination committee notice](https://www.inderes.fi/releases/ilmoitus-honkarakenne-oyj-osakkeenomistajien-nimitystoimikunnalle); [Inderes](https://www.inderes.fi/en/companies/Honkarakenne/ownership)); direct link between Saarelainen Oy and the CEO is not confirmed.

thesis.business_description: S.C. Macofil S.A. (Târgu Jiu, Romania) manufactures fired-clay construction products (bricks, tiles; CAEN 2332) from local marl and refractory clay and sells through its own distribution network, listed on BVB AeRO since 2015.
thesis.competitive_position: Regional ceramic building-materials producer whose edge is access to local clay deposits and an own distribution network, but demand is tied to Romanian construction cycles and the business is capital- and energy-intensive ([Primet profile](https://primet.ro/actiuni/MACO); [Stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/MACO/company)). Third-party data show about RON 90.7m turnover and 177 employees in 2025, unverified ([termene.ro](https://termene.ro/firma/2157789)). Dividends of RON 0.50 (2024) and RON 1.00 (2025) per share were paid ([Primet](https://primet.ro/actiuni/MACO)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Concentrated register (7 holders present at the April 2026 AGM represented 75.38% of votes) ([BVB AGOA resolution](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/MACO/MACO_20260407145829_Raport-curent-Hotarare-AGOA-07-Aprilie-2026.pdf)); ASF sanctioned the company with a warning over holding-notification publication ([ASF decision](https://asfromania.ro/uploads/articole/attachments/65040913e4728790086297.pdf)); minority shareholders (13 holders, 5.12%) previously pushed for a predictable dividend policy ([BVB](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/MACO/MACO_20240329133656_Raport-curent-solicitare2-actionari.pdf)); thin AeRO liquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Polish group (NewConnect) producing fruit syrups, beverages and dietary supplements, with an additional cannabis/hemp-related subsidiary (Excellence Cannabis, in which it held over 46% with its supervisory board chairman in 2021).
thesis.competitive_position: Polish niche producer of syrups and supplements with annual revenue of about PLN 78.6M in 2024 (about PLN 82.2M TTM mid-2025) ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/EXC/revenue/)). Limited moat evident: private-label/contract-type manufacturing in a competitive food-supplement market; the founders remain the main holders. Business per [TradingView](https://in.tradingview.com/symbols/NEWCONNECT-EXC).
thesis.main_shareholders: Per Simply Wall St: Marcin Ciecierski about 31%, Dariusz Polinceusz about 21.4%, Bożena Ciecierska about 0.56% of capital; top-3 holders 52.99% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/food-beverage-tobacco/wse-exc/excellence-shares/ownership)). Parkiet register: Polinceusz with spouse 23.64% of shares / 31.40% of votes; a separate Ciecierski entry 36.63% of votes (date unclear) ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/spolka/PLEXCLN00016)).
thesis.red_flags: Voting rights and holdings differ across sources and dates (different holder percentages in Simply Wall St vs Parkiet), so the current control picture is unverified. Control sits with two founders (about 52-53% combined), which creates governance-concentration risk; sources show the supervisory board chairman (Ciecierski) is also a top holder and a co-investor in the cannabis subsidiary (related-party dynamics) ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/107245,wyniki-finansowe-excellence-za-2021-rok)). NewConnect-listed with 157,730,000 shares; liquidity risk.
thesis.insider_ownership: Marcin Ciecierski (Supervisory Board Chairman since 2013, about 31% per Simply Wall St) and Dariusz Polinceusz (President of the Management Board, about 21.4%) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/food-beverage-tobacco/wse-exc/excellence-shares/ownership), [BiznesRadar shareholder letter](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/147922,list-do-akcjonariuszy-grupy-excellence-2025)).

thesis.business_description: Residential property developer founded in 1990 in Alsace (HQ Entzheim, near Strasbourg), building mainly collective housing; about 98.6% of revenue comes from sales of apartments.
thesis.competitive_position: Regional developer focused on Alsace collective housing, with a long local track record but no structural moat and exposure to the French housing cycle and rates ([Euronext activity report 2016](https://live.euronext.com/sites/default/files/Connect_stradim_rapport_activite_2016.pdf)). Listed on Euronext Growth Paris, ISIN FR0000074775, with 3,439,760 shares and share capital of EUR 12.0M ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/fr/real-estate-management-and-development/epa-alsas/stradim-espace-finances-shares)). A EUR 0.18 dividend was proposed for the 17 June 2026 AGM.
thesis.main_shareholders: Hagenbach family acting in concert (Remi, Jeanne, Clement and Constance Hagenbach) 71.83% of capital and 78% of votes per AMF threshold declaration of Sept 2025, following a donation under a Dutreil pact; Remi Hagenbach alone 41.83% of capital and 45.45% of votes ([AMF filing via FinancialReports](https://cdn.financialreports.eu/financialreports/media/filings/1687/2025/RNS/1687_rns_2025-09-22_085b9145-3db9-4853-a7e2-855efaa886aa.pdf)). Francis Ebel 8.13%, free float about 20.05% ([Easybourse](https://www.easybourse.com/action-societe/stradim-espace/profil/FR0000074775-25)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlled by the Hagenbach concert (about 72% of capital, 78% of votes), leaving a free float of roughly 20% and limited liquidity ([AMF filing](https://cdn.financialreports.eu/financialreports/media/filings/1687/2025/RNS/1687_rns_2025-09-22_085b9145-3db9-4853-a7e2-855efaa886aa.pdf)). Listed on the lighter-regulation Euronext Growth segment. Real-estate development is cyclical and leverage-sensitive; no going-concern, auditor-qualification or litigation wording found in search results.
thesis.insider_ownership: Remi Hagenbach (Chairman and CEO) 41.83% of capital / 45.45% of votes; Hagenbach family concert 71.83% / 78% ([AMF filing](https://cdn.financialreports.eu/financialreports/media/filings/1687/2025/RNS/1687_rns_2025-09-22_085b9145-3db9-4853-a7e2-855efaa886aa.pdf)); co-CEO Francis Ebel about 8.13% ([Easybourse](https://www.easybourse.com/action-societe/stradim-espace/profil/FR0000074775-25)).

thesis.business_description: Read-Gene S.A. is a Szczecin-area (Poland) biotechnology company, founded 2005, with about 11.79m shares and roughly 20 employees ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/pharmaceuticals-biotech/wse-rdg/read-gene-shares/information); [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/RDG/)). FY2025 revenue was about PLN 15.6m (+18%) with net profit of about PLN 0.81m ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/ja/stocks/pl/pharmaceuticals-biotech/wse-rdg/read-gene-shares/future)). Segment split not retrieved.
thesis.competitive_position: Small Polish life-science/diagnostics services business with lumpy quarterly revenue (Q1 2025 PLN 1.47m, -31% y/y; Q4 2025 PLN 5.19m) per [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/RDG/revenue/). The share price run (about +50% in 2025 and >1,000% in five years per [Comparic](https://comparic.pl/ta-spolka-z-gpw-oszalala-50-wzrost-akcji-w-2025-i-ponad-1000-w-5-lat/)) took market cap to about PLN 59.7m in June 2026 ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/RDG/)), far above the roughly USD 1m book equity in the input data. Moat not evidenced in available sources.
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Valuation far above book value (market cap about PLN 59.7m June 2026 vs equity about USD 1m) after a large share-price run ([Comparic](https://comparic.pl/ta-spolka-z-gpw-oszalala-50-wzrost-akcji-w-2025-i-ponad-1000-w-5-lat/)); loss-making quarters in 2025 (Q1 net loss PLN 135.9k, Q3 net loss PLN 237.4k) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/ja/stocks/pl/pharmaceuticals-biotech/wse-rdg/read-gene-shares/future)); tiny team (about 20 staff) and NewConnect-level disclosure; Simply Wall St flagged a 'New Risk' in Feb 2026.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: EuKedos S.p.A. (Euronext Milan, ticker EUK, ISIN IT0004818297) operates elderly-care (residential care) facilities in Italy, FY2025 revenue about EUR 52.9M.
thesis.competitive_position: Regional operator of care homes with scale of ~EUR 53M revenue, but thin margins: FY2025 net loss attributable of EUR 698k versus EUR 704k in 2024 ([SoldiOnline](https://www.soldionline.it/?p=154488)). Returned to a group profit of EUR 446k in H1 2026 ([Teleborsa](https://www.teleborsa.it/DettaglioNews/295_2026-09-29_TLB/Eukedos-valore-della-produzione-sale-a-272-milioni-e-torna-in-utile-nel-semestre.html)). Moat limited to licensed facilities and regional reputation; real-estate holdings play a role (sold 40.24% of Poggio Imperiale in June 2026) ([Teleborsa](https://www.teleborsa.it/News/2026/06/10/eukedos-cede-il-40-24percent-di-poggio-imperiale-a-la-veranella-per-2-6-milioni-di-euro-291.html)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Net financial debt of EUR 128.78M at end-2025 (EUR 128.46M in 2024), largely incl. IFRS 16 leases, versus market cap of roughly EUR 18M ([SoldiOnline](https://www.soldionline.it/?p=154488), [Teleborsa](https://www.teleborsa.it/DettaglioNews/295_2026-09-29_TLB/Eukedos-valore-della-produzione-sale-a-272-milioni-e-torna-in-utile-nel-semestre.html), [QuiFinanza/market cap](https://quifinanza.it/borse/borsa-italiana/azioni/mil/euk/)); consecutive net losses in 2024-2025; asset disposals to La Veranella ([Teleborsa](https://www.teleborsa.it/News/2026/06/10/eukedos-cede-il-40-24percent-di-poggio-imperiale-a-la-veranella-per-2-6-milioni-di-euro-291.html)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Bonn-based German listed holding offering litigation funding (court and arbitration costs), company formation and corporate services (Gruendungs GmbH, FORIS Service GmbH) and fund advisory; FORIS holds EUR 5M in a fund and advises on its portfolio. 2025 revenue EUR 22.6M (2024: EUR 29.8M) ([FORIS 2025 annual report](https://www.foris.com/wp-content/uploads/FORIS_AG_Geschaeftsbericht_Konzernabschluss_2025.pdf)).
thesis.competitive_position: Small German provider of legal-adjacent services and litigation finance; scale and brand are modest, and its GO AHEAD unit will stop legal-adjacent care services at end-2026 for economic and regulatory reasons ([FORIS 2025 annual report](https://www.foris.com/wp-content/uploads/FORIS_AG_Geschaeftsbericht_Konzernabschluss_2025.pdf)). No durable moat is evident.
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Revenue fell to EUR 22.6M from EUR 29.8M and gross profit to about EUR 3.9M from EUR 7.6M; the company guided to a slightly negative 2025 group result ([FORIS ad hoc](https://stock3.com/news/pta-adhoc-foris-ag-foris-ag-schliesst-2025-mit-leicht-negativem-konzernergebnis-ab-16976092)); wind-down of the GO AHEAD care business at end-2026; litigation-funding outcomes are lumpy and binary; several voting-rights notices in 2024-2026 show shifting holders ([pressetext](https://www.pressetext.com/news/20260210009)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Balticon S.A. (Gdynia, Poland) sells and leases shipping containers and provides storage, repair, road/rail transport and customs services, mainly in Poland, with a Spanish container subsidiary.
thesis.competitive_position: Describes itself as the leader of the Polish market for container sales and leasing; revenue growth continued in 2025 (Q1 revenue PLN 73.8m, +24% y/y; TTM to Sep-2025 about PLN 311m) ([Stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/BLT/); [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/commercial-services/wse-blt/balticon-shares/news/balticon-reports-first-quarter-2025-earnings)). Moat is scale, inventory and logistics integration rather than a protected niche; results depend on freight-container pricing cycles. A PLN 0.12/share dividend was approved on 1 July 2025.
thesis.main_shareholders: BLT Assets Sp. z o.o. 1,617,012 shares = 52.07%; BLT Biuro Sp. z o.o. 1,339,991 shares = 43.16%; Adrian Kiedrowski 0.28%; Tomasz Szmid (President) 0.10%, per the Q2 2025 report ([Balticon 2Q2025 report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/52224958/DOC.20250814.52224958.Raport_kwartalny_skonsolidowany_za_2Q2025-0.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Roughly 95% held by two related-looking entities leaves a free float of about 5% and thin liquidity; controlling-holder dynamics (BLT Assets acquired 51.01% in 2017) ([MarketScreener](https://marketscreener.com/quote/stock/BALTICON-S-A-20706777/news/Blt-Assets-Sp-z-o-o-completed-the-acquisition-of-51-01-stake-in-Balticon-S-A-from-IPON-INVEST-M-35225431)); cyclical container pricing.
thesis.insider_ownership: Tomasz Szmid (management board president) 0.10%; controlling entities BLT Assets and BLT Biuro hold about 95% ([Balticon 2Q2025 report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/52224958/DOC.20250814.52224958.Raport_kwartalny_skonsolidowany_za_2Q2025-0.pdf)).

thesis.business_description: Internity S.A. (Poland) operates a chain of showrooms selling interior-finishing products (bathroom fittings, ceramic tiles, heating and air-conditioning systems, furniture, appliances) with services for architects and developers, plus an investment-property portfolio.
thesis.competitive_position: Niche premium interior-design retailer with showrooms (new ones in Wrocław, Białystok, Olsztyn) and architect/developer channel relationships; no strong moat and exposed to housing/renovation cycles ([Bonnier-hosted report](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-02/20260213_165637_0000001121_0000015970.pdf)). 2025 revenue was about PLN 154.0m vs PLN 150m; Q4 2025 EBITDA fell to PLN 3.0m from 8.4m on a high real-estate comparison base ([Bonnier report](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-02/20260213_165637_0000001121_0000015970.pdf); [Q3 2025 report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/52889162/DOC.20251114.52889162.Raport_Kwartalny_Skonsolidowany_Internity_SA_2025_3Q-0.pdf)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Earnings partly driven by one-off real-estate revaluations (Q2 2025 profit boosted by an asset revaluation) and cyclical demand; some customers paused orders after drone incident in Poland ([Bonnier Q4 2025 report](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-02/20260213_165637_0000001121_0000015970.pdf)); thin NewConnect liquidity; current shareholder register not verified.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Notorious Pictures S.p.A. (Italy, Euronext Growth Milan) is an independent film and TV distribution, production and co-production group, with theatrical, home-entertainment and platform licensing activities.
thesis.competitive_position: Independent Italian distributor/producer whose results are lumpy and slate-dependent: consolidated revenue fell 62% to EUR 36.4m in 2025 from EUR 94.8m in 2024, while H1 2026 production value rose 70.7% to EUR 30.0m with a net loss of about EUR 0.8m ([Soldionline](https://www.soldionline.it/?p=154510); [Teleborsa/Borsa Italiana](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsa/notizie/teleborsa/finanza/notorious-pictures-valore-della-produzione-balza-a-30-milioni-nel-primo-semestre-159_2026-09-29_TLB.html?lang=it)). Moat is a film library and distribution relationships, offset by high working-capital needs.
thesis.main_shareholders: GUGLY S.r.l. (100% owned by Guglielmo Marchetti) 17,690,480 shares = 78.65%; treasury shares 609,600 = 2.71%; AQA Colombo Extra Return 988,800 shares = 4.40%, of 22,491,480 shares, per the 11 June 2026 disclosure ([Notorious Pictures notice 20047-8-2026](https://notoriouspictures.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/20047-8-2026.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Leverage: net financial debt EUR 39.9m at end-2025 rising to EUR 42.3m at 30 June 2026, large versus the very small market cap ([Teleborsa/Borsa Italiana](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsa/notizie/teleborsa/finanza/notorious-pictures-valore-della-produzione-balza-a-30-milioni-nel-primo-semestre-159_2026-09-29_TLB.html?lang=it)); 2025 revenue collapse of 62%; controlling holder at about 78.65% with free float around 14%; H1 2026 net loss. Auditor is Deloitte & Touche; no going-concern wording confirmed or found ([Deloitte engagement](https://notoriouspictures.it/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/Deloitte-per-Notorious-Pictures-Proposta-revisione-legale-bilancio-esercizio-e-consolidato-triennio-2024-2026.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder/CEO Guglielmo Marchetti controls 78.65% via GUGLY S.r.l. ([Notorious Pictures notice](https://notoriouspictures.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/20047-8-2026.pdf)).

thesis.business_description: Zagrebacka burza d.d. operates the Zagreb Stock Exchange (Croatia) and, through a wholly owned subsidiary, the Ljubljana Stock Exchange (Slovenia), earning listing, trading, data and clearing-related fees.
thesis.competitive_position: Monopoly-type national exchange operator in Croatia with a second exchange in Slovenia acquired from CEESEG in 2015 ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ljubljana_Stock_Exchange)); moat is the regulated market licence, but turnover and issuer base are small. In Dec 2025 Axor Holding made an offer for 100% of Ljubljana Stock Exchange, which Zagreb said it could not consider until the Fina process was resolved ([Lider](https://en.lider.media/?p=143322)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Fina (state agency) about 9.99% and RR One Capital 9.99%, the rest mostly financial institutions, per tportal (Aug 2025) ([tportal](https://www.tportal.hr/biznis/clanak/fina-zeli-preuzeti-zagrebacku-burzu-20250801)).
thesis.red_flags: Pending change-of-control: Fina intends to take majority ownership via a public offer for 50% plus one share, conditional on approvals in Croatia, Slovenia and North Macedonia ([ZSE filing](https://eho.zse.hr/fileadmin/issuers/ZB/FI-ZB-e2855be668c10134c1a8939bf48bda13.pdf)); conflicting reports on Slovenian regulator view of Fina's request ([Lider](https://en.lider.media/?p=52976)). Fragmented financial-institution shareholders and thin trading.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Orchard Funding Group plc (UK, AIM) is a specialty lender providing insurance premium finance and related lending to UK customers; it changed its year-end to 31 January 2026.
thesis.competitive_position: Small UK premium-finance lender; reported record unaudited results for the 12 months to 31 July 2025, with non-Toyota lending of GBP 109.5m vs GBP 101.3m ([Investegate RNS](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/orchard-funding-group--orch/unaudited-results-for-12-months-/9141820); [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/orchard-funding-group-reports-record-financial-results-for-2025)). Competitive edge is broker relationships and underwriting; the moat is modest and concentrated.
thesis.main_shareholders: CEO Rabinder (Ravi) Takhar about 57.2% of voting capital ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/diversified-financials/aim-orch/orchard-funding-group-shares/ownership); [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/orchard-ceo-boosts-stake-to-over-57)); Jack Boardman 908,539 shares = 4.26% ([Investegate RNS 6 Jun 2025](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/orchard-funding-group--orch/holding-s-in-company/8917193)).
thesis.red_flags: Customer concentration: largest customer 'Insure That' entered administration, affecting about GBP 16.7m of the lending book ([TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/orchard-funding-faces-uncertainty-as-major-client-falters)); dividends halted to potentially fund a tender offer ([TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/orchard-funding-reassesses-capital-strategy-amid-market-challenges)); controlling holder with over 57% and small free float; results were interim/unaudited due to year-end change.
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Ravi Takhar about 57.2% of voting capital ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/diversified-financials/aim-orch/orchard-funding-group-shares/ownership)).

thesis.business_description: Romanian holding (formerly Mecanica Fina SA, renamed MF Capital S.A. in October 2025) repositioned as an investment platform with real estate (Hub 100 urban development) and agriculture interests; BVB-listed under MFC.
thesis.competitive_position: Small post-industrial shell turned real-estate/agri investment vehicle controlled by Mol Invest; no operating moat, value rests on its land/property and the new strategy outlined in the February 2026 shareholder letter ([BVB shareholder letter](https://bvb.ro/infocont/infocont26/MFC_20260223175803_letter-to-shareholders.pdf)). Described as operating real estate in Romania and investing in agriculture ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/MFC/company)); Mol reportedly injected EUR 67M into the former shell ([ZF](https://m2.zf.ro/zf-english/mol-feeds-67m-euros-into-former-shell-3022318)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Mol Invest S.A. is the majority shareholder (exact percentage not shown in retrieved text), with Sergio Mollo as reference shareholder and CEO/Chairman ([BVB shareholder letter](https://bvb.ro/infocont/infocont26/MFC_20260223175803_letter-to-shareholders.pdf); [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/MFC/company)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling-holder dynamics: Mol Invest is majority owner and the letter itself discusses initiatives to improve liquidity, implying thin free float ([BVB shareholder letter](https://bvb.ro/infocont/infocont26/MFC_20260223175803_letter-to-shareholders.pdf)); strategy change and symbol change (MECE to MFC) create execution/transparency risk; insider (Mol Invest) transactions notified under MAR in July 2026 ([BVB notification](https://m.bvb.ro/infocont/infocont26/MFC_20260727125925_notificare-tranzactii-art-19-rue-596-2014-mol-invest-S.pdf)). Does not pay dividends ([TradingView](https://de.tradingview.com/symbols/BVB-MFC/)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Sergio Mollo, CEO/Chairman, holds through Mol Invest S.A. (percentage not disclosed in retrieved text) ([BVB shareholder letter](https://bvb.ro/infocont/infocont26/MFC_20260223175803_letter-to-shareholders.pdf)).

thesis.business_description: Producer of luminaires and lighting systems, increasingly LED, based in Sroda Wielkopolska, Poland; sells industrial, commercial and consumer luminaires mainly in Poland and export markets.
thesis.competitive_position: Established mid-sized Polish luminaire maker with long-running brands such as the MIMO LED range, competing against larger European lighting groups and Asian imports; no structural moat beyond brand, distribution and local manufacturing ([StockAnalysis company profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/LEN/company)). It has paid regular dividends, though a lower dividend was reported ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/109237,nizsza-dywidenda-lena-lighting)), and runs share buybacks ([Parkiet ESPI](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art40987001-lena-lighting-sa-skup-akcji-wlasnych-spolki-lena-lighting-s-a)). The 2024 corporate-governance statement notes no securities carry special control rights.
thesis.main_shareholders: Fundacja Rodzinna Mimo 12,500,000 shares (50.25% of 24,875,050 shares and votes); Nationale-Nederlanden OFE 9.99%; PKO BP Bankowy OFE 7.19% ([Parkiet](https://parkiet.com/spolka/Lena_Lighting); [corporate governance statement 2024](https://www.bankier.pl/static/att/emitent/2025-04/Lad-korporacyjny-2024_202504301081260492.xhtml)). A June 2024 shareholding-change notice and correction were filed by the foundation ([ESPI](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art40747941-lena-lighting-sa-korekta-zawiadomienia-o-zmianie-stanu-posiadania-akcji-spolki)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlled by a single family foundation holding just over 50% of shares and votes, so minorities have little influence and free float is limited to pension funds and others ([Parkiet](https://parkiet.com/spolka/Lena_Lighting)). The June 2024 ownership notice required a correction, indicating changes in the holding structure ([ESPI](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art40747941-lena-lighting-sa-korekta-zawiadomienia-o-zmianie-stanu-posiadania-akcji-spolki)). Cyclical construction/lighting demand and Asian import competition; no going-concern or audit-qualification wording found.
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Wlodzimierz Lesinski has bought shares on several occasions per MAR notices ([Parkiet ESPI](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art27508921-lena-lighting-nabycie-akcji-emitenta-przez-prezesa-zarzadu)); a historic Parkiet table showed him at 59.21% in 2005. Current personal holding and the link between him and Fundacja Rodzinna Mimo not confirmed in sources found.

thesis.business_description: Confinvest F.L. S.p.A. (renamed Confinvest ORO S.p.A. in 2026; Euronext Growth Milan) is an Italian precious-metals/gold business that bought the Dierre precious-metals unit in February 2026; 2025 revenue was about EUR 80.9m (+153%) with net profit EUR 1.4m and EBITDA EUR 2.1m.
thesis.competitive_position: Small Italian gold-trading/processing player whose revenue is driven largely by volumes and gold prices rather than a moat; management attributes 2025 growth to higher volumes, and the Dierre acquisition lifted preliminary H1 2026 revenue to about EUR 86m (+80%) ([Teleborsa on AGM and FY2025](https://www.teleborsa.it/DettaglioNews/201_2026-04-29_TLB/CONFINVEST-ORO-via-libera-assemblea-al-bilancio-2025-e-nomina-del-nuovo-CdA-e-Collegio-Sindacale.html); [Confinvest H1 2026 preliminary revenue release](https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-07/20260716_186930.pdf); [Il Sole 24 Ore](https://en.ilsole24ore.com/art/egm-raggi-x-confinvest-gold-80-per-cent-of-revenue-thanks-to-the-integration-of-dierre-AJDbKyX)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Bolaffi S.p.A. 2,147,035 shares = 24.00% of capital (lists for the 29 April 2026 AGM; may have bought more in the following six months); Dierre S.r.l. 6.15% ([Confinvest notice via Emarketstorage](https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-05/20260505_183430.pdf); [Il Sole 24 Ore](https://en.ilsole24ore.com/art/egm-raggi-x-confinvest-gold-80-per-cent-of-revenue-thanks-to-the-integration-of-dierre-AJDbKyX)).
thesis.red_flags: Thin profitability (net profit EUR 1.4m on EUR 80.9m revenue) with results sensitive to commodity volumes ([Teleborsa](https://www.teleborsa.it/DettaglioNews/201_2026-04-29_TLB/CONFINVEST-ORO-via-libera-assemblea-al-bilancio-2025-e-nomina-del-nuovo-CdA-e-Collegio-Sindacale.html)); transformational Dierre acquisition and new board/name in 2026 create integration and governance change risk; Bolaffi (a precious-metals peer) is a 24% holder and a new board was appointed on 29 April 2026; roughly 500 small shareholders per an undated Milano Finanza piece (limited liquidity).
thesis.insider_ownership: Daniele Savelli reported at about 7% after reinvesting about EUR 1m (undated Milano Finanza article; current role not verified) ([Milano Finanza](https://www.milanofinanza.it/news/confinvest-corre-con-l-oro-alle-stelle-e-con-dierre-2693146)).

thesis.business_description: Romanian hotel and spa-tourism operator in Covasna (Transylvania), running the Caprioara, Cerbul and Covasna hotels and the Valea Zanelor camping complex; domestic leisure/balneary tourism ([Wall-Street.ro](https://www.wall-street.ro/articol/Piete-de-capital/52653/sif-transilvania-investeste-in-modernizarea-hotelurilor-sale-din-covasna.html); [Bursa.ro](https://www.bursa.ro/in-urma-socului-covid-19-turism-covasna-raporteaza-o-pierdere-de-4-2-milioane-pentru-anul-trecut-83483244)).
thesis.competitive_position: Local spa-resort hotel operator in a regional balneary destination with no scale or pricing power; assets are older hotels that require modernisation, with the Covasna hotel reported as slated for demolition ([Wall-Street.ro](https://www.wall-street.ro/articol/Piete-de-capital/52653/sif-transilvania-investeste-in-modernizarea-hotelurilor-sale-din-covasna.html)). Owned by the SIF Transilvania investment group, which funds the modernisation. The main asset value is the hotel real estate rather than an operating moat.
thesis.main_shareholders: SIF Transilvania (now Transilvania Investments Alliance, ticker TRANSI) 95.15% per a 2020 report ([Bursa.ro](https://www.bursa.ro/in-urma-socului-covid-19-turism-covasna-raporteaza-o-pierdere-de-4-2-milioane-pentru-anul-trecut-83483244)); 93% per a 2023 article ([rhn.ro](https://rhn.ro/en/wp-json/wp/v2/posts/116123)). Current stake sits in the annex of the TRANSI 2025 annual report ([BVB](https://m.bvb.ro/infocont/infocont26/TRANSI_20260326185213_Raport-financiar-2025-TRANSI-BVB---EN.pdf)) and was not verified.
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder owns about 93-95%, leaving a tiny free float and very thin trading on BVB AeRO; COVID-hit losses (RON 4.2M loss in 2020, [Bursa.ro](https://www.bursa.ro/in-urma-socului-covid-19-turism-covasna-raporteaza-o-pierdere-de-4-2-milioane-pentru-anul-trecut-83483244)); ageing hotel assets needing capex and one hotel slated for demolition; possible squeeze-out/delisting risk given the >90% holding; EGM on 24.09.2026 amended the articles ([BVB notice](https://m.bvb.ro/FinancialInstruments/SelectedData/NewsItem/TUAA-Hotarari-AGA-E-24-09-2026/AE26B)), contents not reviewed.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Regenbogen AG (Kiel, Germany) operates holiday and camping resorts, from rustic campsites to club-style resorts with holiday homes and wellness areas, and can hold investments in other companies; Germany.
thesis.competitive_position: The company describes itself as a market leader in its field in Germany (company profile, Dec 2020) ([Regenbogen](https://www.regenbogen.ag/resources/persistent/f56d11a08707403fabcdbe8d5767bf740d537c32/Unternehmenskurzportrait%20Regenbogen%20AG_2020_17_12.pdf)); asset-heavy leisure operator with owner-family management and no clear moat beyond site ownership. 2025 revenue fell from EUR 22.4m to EUR 19.3m and operating profit from EUR 2.5m to EUR 0.8m ([EQS annual report 2025](https://ir-api.eqs.com//media/document/64ee7afb-cd1d-4a5c-9638-87f7bc66269c/assets/DE0008009564-JA-2025-EQ-D-00.pdf)); EUR 0.90 per share dividend proposed at the 12 Sep 2025 AGM ([Boersengefluester](https://app.boersengefluester.de/en/newswire/DE0008009564/regenbogen-ag/geanderter-beschlussvorschlag-der-ordentlichen-hauptversammlung-am-12092025-wird-die-ausschuttung-einer-dividende-in-hohe-von-eur-090-je-aktie-vorgeschlagen-2192684)).
thesis.main_shareholders: December 2020 company profile (2,300,289 shares): Ruediger Vosshall about 53.3%, G. May-Rosorius 25.0%, free float 21.7% ([Regenbogen profile](https://www.regenbogen.ag/resources/persistent/f56d11a08707403fabcdbe8d5767bf740d537c32/Unternehmenskurzportrait%20Regenbogen%20AG_2020_17_12.pdf)). Simply Wall St describes Regenbogen as a subsidiary of Vov Vermoegensverwaltung GmbH & Co. KG (undated, not confirmed from a primary source) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stock/db/rgb)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling-holder dynamics (family and one other holder about 78% in 2020; free float about 22%); 2025 revenue down about 14% and operating profit down about 70%; 2026 outlook calls for slight revenue decline; generational board change (Marc and Patrick Vosshall joined 1 Jul 2023).
thesis.insider_ownership: Vosshall family controls the company (Ruediger Vosshall about 53.3% in 2020; Marc and Patrick Vosshall are board members; Patrick Vosshall transferred 15,334 shares at EUR 13.50 under a 30 Jun 2022 purchase agreement per EQS directors' dealings).

thesis.business_description: Warsaw-based video game publisher (founded 2019) known for the simulation titles 112 Operator and 911 Operator, listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange; recently signed a contract to develop and publish the game Economicon.
thesis.competitive_position: Small publisher of niche simulation games tied to the PlayWay publishing ecosystem (PlayWay is its largest listed holder). Moat is limited to the franchise portfolio and PlayWay distribution relationships; revenue depends on a few titles ([TradingView](https://cn.tradingview.com/chart/GOP/1milROWn/), [Money.pl on Economicon](https://www.money.pl/gielda/komunikaty/7278135980331585.html)).
thesis.main_shareholders: PlayWay S.A. 36.39% (2,001,000 shares) per Investing.com (date not shown) ([Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/equities/games-operators-sa)). Other 5%+ holders not retrieved.
thesis.red_flags: Dependence on PlayWay as largest holder and ecosystem partner (related-party dynamics); hit-driven revenue from a small number of titles. Supervisory board change recorded 12 Jun 2026 after the 11 Jun 2026 AGM ([Money.pl](https://www.money.pl/gielda/komunikaty/7278135980331585.html)). Full 5%+ holder list not verified.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Polish digital-reading company operating the Legimi subscription platform for e-books, audiobooks and press (Poland and some other CEE markets), with a publishing-technology/ereader side; listed on NewConnect (GPW alternative market) since April 2021 ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/artykuly/debiut-ipo/20210414/legimi-debiut-na-newconnect)).
thesis.competitive_position: One of the leading Polish e-book/audiobook subscription services, competing with Storytel, Audioteka and Empik Go; scale is modest and moat limited to catalogue licensing, brand and subscriber base. A strategic investor, Wirtualna Polska (WP Media), entered in November 2023 by buying a block at PLN 27.50/share ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/wiadomosci/20231120/wp-inwestuje-w-legimi)) and issued a further invitation to sell shares in February 2025 ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/wiadomosci/20250218/zaproszenie-do-skladania-ofert-sprzedazy-akcji-spolki-legimi-sa)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Mikolaj Malaczynski (founder): 359,625 shares / 564,625 votes = 31.11% of votes at the 3 April 2026 EGM (per Legimi's over-5% list as summarised from the filing); Wirtualna Polska Media/WP Holding approx. 25% (Simply Wall St, undated) after acquiring a 27.27% stake agreement in 2023 ([MarketScreener](https://m.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/LEGIMI-S-A-121503979/news/Wirtualna-Polska-Holding-S-A-agreed-to-acquired-27-268948-stake-in-Legimi-S-A--45738965/); [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/media/wse-leg/legimi-shares/ownership)). Latest list: Legimi 2025 annual report, 'Struktura akcjonariatu', p.12 ([report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/1750_20260323_213900_20260323_Legimi-Skonsolidowany-Raport-Roczny-2025.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Strategic holder (WP Media) has repeatedly bid for shares (2023, Feb 2025 invitations covering 21.10% of votes), implying creeping-takeover/squeeze-out and delisting risk ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/wiadomosci/20250218/zaproszenie-do-skladania-ofert-sprzedazy-akcji-spolki-legimi-sa)); NewConnect-listed with a small free float and low liquidity; thin book equity relative to market cap (USD 1.1M vs USD 15.2M per input data).
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder/CEO Mikolaj Malaczynski about 31.11% of votes at the 3 April 2026 EGM (Legimi over-5% list; Simply Wall St shows 17.7% of capital, undated).

thesis.business_description: Construction contractor based in Braila, Romania, described as a leader in construction on the Braila market and part of the Bursagrirom holding since 2002; shares trade on BVB's AeRO multilateral market since 1997 ([Tradeville](https://tradeville.ro/actiuni/COKJ/sumar); [StockAnalysis profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/COKJ/company)).
thesis.competitive_position: Regional construction contractor with a local leadership position in Braila and the backing of a parent holding; construction is competitive and low-margin with no strong moat beyond local relationships and track record. Aggregator data show revenue of about RON 285M and earnings of about RON 38M for the period to 30 Jun 2025, which should be verified against the filing ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stock/bvb/cokj)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Bursagrirom S.A. Braila 747,966 shares = 73.2076% of subscribed and paid-in capital (AGOA of 25 Apr 2024 record, [BVB](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/COKJ/COKJ-Hotarari_AGOA_25042024.pdf)); total 1,021,706 shares ([Primet](https://primet.ro/actiuni/COKJ)). Remaining holders not named.
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder Bursagrirom owns about 73%, leaving a free float of about 27% and low AeRO liquidity; related-party/parent dynamics (BVB filings name Bursagrirom as majority shareholder, [BVB Dec 2021 filing](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/COKJ/COKJ-Raport curent tranzactii MAR 13112021.pdf)); construction cyclicality; Tradeville lists multiple 2025 annual report versions, one with and one without audit report, so audit status needs checking ([Tradeville](https://tradeville.ro/actiuni/COKJ/stiri)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Administrator Petrica Dumitrascu reported small COKJ share purchases in BVB MAR notices in 2021-2023; percentage not disclosed ([BVB notice](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/COKJ/COKJ-Raport curent tranzactii MAR 17122021.pdf)). Bursagrirom is represented by administrator Gheorghe Bunea Razvan.

thesis.business_description: Italian water-treatment company founded in 1979, based in Castelfidardo (Ancona), listed on Borsa Italiana's AIM Italia (now Euronext Growth Milan) since 20 December 2017 with an IPO of 2,192,500 shares; Innovative SME since July 2017 ([GEL press release, July 2026](https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-07/20260716_186939.pdf)).
thesis.competitive_position: Small niche Italian water-treatment specialist with a limited float; no market-share data were found in searches, so no durable moat can be evidenced. Treasury-share buybacks (about 4.48% of capital held in 2023) and a EUR 0.22/share extraordinary dividend approved on 3 Aug 2026 indicate a cash-return posture ([Teleborsa/Borsa Italiana](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsa/notizie/teleborsa/finanza/gel-convoca-assemblea-per-approvare-dividendo-straordinario-da-022-euro-195_2026-07-16_TLB.html?lang=it)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Delisting risk: the board proposed revoking the Euronext Growth Milan listing in Feb 2026, citing thin trading and low free float; the 27 Feb 2026 meeting (95.356% of capital present) failed to reach the 90% reinforced majority, so the shares remain listed ([GEL release, 27 Feb 2026](https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-02/20260227_177977.pdf); [GEL release, 11 Feb 2026](https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-02/20260211_177417.pdf)); low free float and liquidity; a controlling-holder dynamic is implied by the delisting push but holders were not identified in the sources seen.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: UK AIM-listed international specialist recruitment/staffing group; FY2025 revenue was GBP 239.0m (-3%) and net fee income GBP 47.3m (-6%) with adjusted operating profit up, results published 18 May 2026 ([Investegate](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/empresaria-group--emr/results-for-the-year-ended-31-december-2025/9571882)).
thesis.competitive_position: Diversified, mid-sized staffing group (multiple brands across the UK, Europe, Asia Pacific and the Americas, per the company's reporting) in a cyclical, fragmented industry with no durable moat; net fee income fell 6% in 2025 and no final dividend is proposed for FY2025 ([Investegate](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/empresaria-group--emr/results-for-the-year-ended-31-december-2025/9571882)). It bought out the remaining 10% minority of UK subsidiary Greycoat Placements in March 2026 ([Techleap feed](https://finder.techleap.nl/news/feed/empresaria-acquires-10-minority-stake-in-uk-subsidiary-for-63-500)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Per the company's top-shareholders page (undated): A V Martin 27.93%, H M van Heijst 17.89%, Stichting Hendriks Family Office 10.34% ([Empresaria](https://www.empresaria.com/shareholder-information/top-shareholders)).
thesis.red_flags: 2025 takeover turmoil: unsolicited consortium approach (May 2025) rejected as undervaluing the company ([AJ Bell](https://www.ajbell.co.uk/news/articles/empresaria-says-takeover-proposal-consortium-undervalues-company)); Legacy UK Holdings made a non-binding approach at 62p on 30 Jul 2025 and then confirmed no intention to bid on 22 Oct 2025 ([Investegate](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/empresaria-group--emr/statement-of-no-intention-to-make-an-offer-/9187904)); a requisitioned general meeting ousted the CEO and chair (board change 15 Oct 2025) ([AJ Bell](https://streaming1.beta.ajbell.co.uk/articles/latestnews/293395/empresaria-ousts-chief-executive-and-chair-requisitioned-meeting)). Governance instability, concentrated holders, falling net fee income and no final dividend.
thesis.insider_ownership: The company's top-shareholder list shows A V Martin 27.93% and H M van Heijst 17.89% (undated; roles not confirmed in the search results); the CFO bought shares per [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/empresaria-cfo-increases-stake-with-significant-share-purchase).

thesis.business_description: Zagreb-based milling and food company producing flour (including for 15 private-label brands of Croatian retailers) and related dairy/food lines; about 450 employees and 2024 revenue of about EUR 98.4M.
thesis.competitive_position: Croatian milling and private-label food producer; 2024 revenue about 98.4M (+12.5%) per [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/zse/GRNL/); 2023 operating income fell 17% to EUR 54.1M with revenue down about 18%, milling being the only segment to grow ([ZSE 2023 report](https://eho.zse.hr/fileadmin/issuers/GRNL/FI-GRNL-cf667b1b4c71561a6272fb1e26020cf9.pdf)). Commodity-like flour and retailer private-label dependence imply a thin moat and customer concentration.
thesis.main_shareholders: Hrvoje Filipović 58.11% of capital at 31 Dec 2024; ten largest shareholders together 95.77% (2024 management report on the Zagreb Stock Exchange) ([ZSE issuer filings](https://eho.zse.hr/fileadmin/issuers/GRNL/GS-GRNL-a12f19709c374a3f3071634033e97281.pdf)). Q1 2015 report showed Filipović at 60.74% ([ZSE](https://eho.zse.hr/fileadmin/issuers/migrated/financials/GRNL-fin2015-1Q-NotREV-K-EN.PDF)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder Filipović holds 58.11% and top 10 holders 95.77%, so free float and liquidity are very thin ([ZSE issuer filings](https://eho.zse.hr/fileadmin/issuers/GRNL/GS-GRNL-a12f19709c374a3f3071634033e97281.pdf)). Dependence on Croatian retailers' private-label contracts and volatile grain input costs (2023 revenue fell about 18%) ([ZSE 2023 report](https://eho.zse.hr/fileadmin/issuers/GRNL/FI-GRNL-cf667b1b4c71561a6272fb1e26020cf9.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Hrvoje Filipović, majority shareholder with 58.11% at 31 Dec 2024 (see ZSE filings).

thesis.business_description: Greek provider (HQ Metamorfosi, founded 1992) of furnishing and equipment solutions for retail stores, warehouses and distribution centres, including racking, automation and technology projects, operating mainly in Greece; the group also includes Organizer Stores S.A.
thesis.competitive_position: Niche supplier of retail/warehouse fit-out and storage systems in Greece with a project-based business, so revenue is lumpy; 2025 group revenue fell 8.33% to EUR 38.29M from EUR 41.77M and earnings dropped ~61% to EUR 216k per StockAnalysis data ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/ath/VOSYS/)), with the chairman attributing parent-company 2025 losses to investment in staff and more complex automation projects ([Euro2day](https://www.euro2day.gr/en/article/2356092/nikos-vogiatzoglou-where-will-the-2025-losses-be-a)). 2022 turnover jumped to EUR 24.7M ([Powergame](https://www.powergame.gr/epichirisis/436019/vogiatzoglou-systems-alma-tzirou-sta-247-ekat-to-2022/)). No clear moat beyond local project track record.
thesis.main_shareholders: Nikolaos Vogiatzoglou 82.92% (older ATHEX 2014-15 data) ([ATHEX](https://www.athexgroup.gr/el/documents/10180/2497143/%CE%92%CE%9F%CE%93%CE%99%CE%91%CE%A4%CE%96%CE%9F%CE%93%CE%9B%CE%9F%CE%A5%20SYSTEMS%20%CE%91.%CE%95.%20%282015%29/66cfa5d2-5d23-472b-8f5e-17ae0c42d607)); Simply Wall St shows individual insiders ~83% and public ~15.5% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gr/capital-goods/ath-vosys/vogiatzoglou-systems-shares/ownership)).
thesis.red_flags: Parent-company losses in 2025 and sharply lower earnings (EUR 216k, -61%) on revenue down 8.3% ([Euro2day](https://www.euro2day.gr/en/article/2356092/nikos-vogiatzoglou-where-will-the-2025-losses-be-a), [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/ath/VOSYS/)). Very high insider concentration (~83%) leaves ~15.5% free float and thin liquidity; controlling-holder dynamics. Project-based revenue and customer concentration not quantified in sources found.
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder-chairman Nikolaos Vogiatzoglou holds ~82.9% (ATHEX 2014-15 data; Simply Wall St ~83% insiders) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gr/capital-goods/ath-vosys/vogiatzoglou-systems-shares/ownership)).

thesis.business_description: Joensuu-based Finnish group (formerly PunaMusta Media) combining a declining commercial printing and packaging business (PunaMusta Oy, plants in Tampere, Joensuu, Forssa) with visibility and digital units such as Profilight (lighting/digital displays), PunaMusta Coloro (wrapping/visual merchandising), RockOn (product information management) and Exove (digital services); 2025 turnover EUR 108.4M ([Rebl Group release via MFN](https://mfn.se/all/a/rebl-group/rebl-group-oyj-n-tilinpaatos-ja-toimintakertomus-2025-f76e8458); [Wikipedia: Punamusta](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Punamusta)).
thesis.competitive_position: One of the larger Finnish printers consolidating through bolt-on purchases (Offset-Kolmio's packaging/print business in Feb 2025 and Hansaprint's business in 2025, per [MFN releases](https://mfn.se/all/a/rebl-group/taydennystiedote-rebl-group-konserni-on-ostanut-hansaprint-oy-n-liiketoiminnan-e50b8bb7)). Moat is limited: printing is a structurally declining, overcapacity market, and Inderes says profitability improvement depends on efficiency in the declining printing business and faster growth in the other units ([Inderes forum](https://forum.inderes.com/t/rebl-group-entinen-nimi-punamusta-media/35474?page=5)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Refinancing: in Dec 2025 Rebl agreed new financing with Danske Bank and Nordea plus a new EUR 9M hybrid loan, which raises financing costs ([Inderes](https://www.inderes.fi/analyst-comments/rebl-group-uusii-rahoitustaan)); change negotiations covering 65 employees at PunaMusta Oy's Joensuu, Tampere and Turenki sites ended March 2026 ([MFN](https://mfn.se/ind/a/rebl-group/sisapiiritieto-muutosneuvottelut-paattyneet-punamusta-oy-ssa-b85fc373)); further restructuring of Turenki production; declining core printing market; concentrated ownership (top 12 holders about 89.84% per [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/fi/media/hel-rebl/rebl-group-oyj-shares/ownership)) implies thin free float; Inderes held a reduce recommendation.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Caffyns plc (Eastbourne, UK) is a franchised motor retailer in the south-east of England; FY to 31 March 2026 turnover was GBP 270.7m.
thesis.competitive_position: Regional franchised car dealer; turnover fell 2% to GBP 270.7m, underlying EBITDA fell to GBP 3.6m from GBP 5.6m and the company swung to a loss before tax in FY2026, though the dividend was held ([AJ Bell](https://www.ajbell.co.uk/news/articles/caffyns-keeps-dividend-unchanged-swings-annual-loss); [Investegate final results](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/caffyns--cfyn/final-results-/9626439)). Moat is limited to manufacturer franchises and local site network; margins are thin. Net bank borrowings GBP 7.3m (gearing 24%) and the defined-benefit pension deficit fell to GBP 1.4m from GBP 4.5m.
thesis.main_shareholders: RNS March 2026 major-holdings notification: Maland Pension Fund 21.45% and Portnard Limited (Andrew Perloff) 0.77% ([Investegate](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/caffyns--cfyn/notification-of-major-shareholding-/9496659)). Simply Wall St splits ownership as individual insiders 37.4%, institutions 36.5%, employee share scheme 4.61% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/retail/lse-cfyn/caffyns-shares/ownership)).
thesis.red_flags: Swing to a loss in FY2026 and shrinking EBITDA; shares fell 12% on results day to 351p; motor-retail margin pressure; defined-benefit pension deficit (GBP 1.4m); concentrated holder (Maland 21.45%) and large insider block reduce free float.
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders about 37.4% and employee share scheme 4.61% per Simply Wall St (aggregator; named director holdings not retrieved). Chairman Brian Carte.

thesis.business_description: Viadana (Italy)-based designer and maker of home textiles and furnishing (bedding, bath, kids lines, licensed brands), founded 1962 by Camillo Caleffi; listed on Euronext Milan (Standard segment) since 2005.
thesis.competitive_position: Established Italian home-fashion brand/licensor with revenue of about EUR 57.5M in 2024 (-2.9%) and guidance of about EUR 60M for 2025 with a 7-8% EBITDA margin; low-moat, competitive category driven by retail relationships and licences ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bit/CLF/); [Caleffi Sept-2025 results release](https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2025-11/20251112_174262.pdf)). Nine-month 2025 consolidated revenue was about EUR 41.9M ([same release](https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2025-11/20251112_174262.pdf)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Giuliana Caleffi S.r.l. 60.526% (Consob shareholder register as of 28/05/2025) ([Consob](https://www.consob.it/web/consob-and-its-activities/w/caleffi-spa-azionariato-1)). Some data providers instead name Minerva S.r.l. as parent ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bit/CLF/company/)), so the holding chain should be verified.
thesis.red_flags: Controlling family holding company owns about 60.5%, leaving a limited free float ([Consob](https://www.consob.it/web/consob-and-its-activities/w/caleffi-spa-azionariato-1)); CFO Giovanni Bozzetti's relationship was terminated in June 2026 ([Teleborsa](https://www.teleborsa.it/AMP/News/2026/06/05/caleffi-risolve-rapporto-con-cfo-giovanni-bozzetti-venute-meno-le-condizioni-203.html)); thin guided EBITDA margin (7-8%) leaves little buffer in a cyclical discretionary category.
thesis.insider_ownership: Controlling family vehicle Giuliana Caleffi S.r.l. 60.526% (Consob, 28/05/2025) ([Consob](https://www.consob.it/web/consob-and-its-activities/w/caleffi-spa-azionariato-1)).

thesis.business_description: Convergenze S.p.A. Societa Benefit (listed on Euronext Growth Milan) is an Italian technology operator in telecommunications and green energy, running a proprietary fibre network (over 12,800 km at end-2025) and entering mobile telephony in February 2025.
thesis.competitive_position: Small alternative telecom/energy operator in Italy competing with large incumbents; the proprietary fibre network (12,800+ km vs 11,100+ km a year earlier) gives some infrastructure asset base but no dominant position ([Convergenze 2025 report](https://convergenze.it/assets/Bds_2025-5e0a3d5d4a1803e476ca75beea8eac69bc22866e678f9a71047614baf2422631.pdf)). Cerved Rating Agency confirmed a B1.1 rating on the issuer and its EUR 1m minibond ([Convergenze](https://convergenze.it/comunicato-nps-download/56/convergenze-s-p-a-sb-e-b-corp-cerved-rating-agency-s-p-a-conferma-il-rating-b1-1-sia-sull-emittente-sia-sul-minibond-da-1-milione-grazie-alla-solida-tenuta-finanziaria-e-attese-di-ripresa-nel-breve-medio-periodo)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Rosario Pingaro (Chairman/CEO), Grazia Pingaro, Sage Gestioni S.r.l. and G&RP Consulting S.r.l. presented a joint auditors' slate in 2023; a Prearo family company and a Redfish Longterm Capital RFLTC S.p.A. affiliate are also listed holders (Jan 2024 notice); percentages not seen; share capital 7,497,509 shares with 171,000 treasury shares (2.281%) ([Convergenze](https://convergenze.it/comunicato-ps-download/54); [Borsa Italiana](https://borsaitaliana.it/borsa/notizie/price-sensitive/download/20203_143404_2024_oneinfo.html)).
thesis.red_flags: Small, capital-intensive telecom operator with a Cerved B1.1 rating and minibond debt ([Convergenze](https://convergenze.it/comunicato-nps-download/56/convergenze-s-p-a-sb-e-b-corp-cerved-rating-agency-s-p-a-conferma-il-rating-b1-1-sia-sull-emittente-sia-sul-minibond-da-1-milione-grazie-alla-solida-tenuta-finanziaria-e-attese-di-ripresa-nel-breve-medio-periodo)); founder/family-controlled via holding vehicles; small EGM listing with limited liquidity. No going-concern wording or audit qualification seen in sources.
thesis.insider_ownership: Chairman/CEO Rosario Pingaro and family vehicles (Grazia Pingaro, Sage Gestioni, G&RP Consulting) are core holders; Pingaro bought a further 5,000 shares in 2026 ([Convergenze](https://convergenze.it/comunicato-nps-download/60/rosario-pingaro-presidente-e-amministratore-delegato-di-convergenze-acquista-ulteriori-complessive-n-5-000-azioni-della-societa-a-conferma-del-costante-allineamento-dei-propri-interessi-con-quelli-di-convergenze-e-dei-suoi-azionisti)); aggregate % not seen.

thesis.business_description: Itim Group plc is an AIM-listed UK software company providing omnichannel/click-and-collect and retail-technology software to retailers on a recurring-revenue (ARR) model; FY2025 ARR was GBP 14.2m (+9%) and adjusted EBITDA GBP 1.7m ([FY2025 results](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/itim-group--itim/full-year-results-for-year-ended-31-december-2025/9565050); [Morningstar IPO piece](https://morningstar.co.uk/uk/news/AN_1623141918685656200/click-and-collect-software-firm-itim-plans-aim-ipo-in-push-for-growth.aspx)). Customers are mainly UK retailers.
thesis.competitive_position: A niche UK retail-software vendor with growing recurring revenue (ARR GBP 14.2m vs GBP 13.0m) but profitability fell: adjusted EBITDA GBP 1.7m vs GBP 2.5m and a pre-tax loss of GBP 464k, partly from a bad debt when retail customer Quiz Clothing went into administration ([Hargreaves Lansdown](https://www.hl.co.uk/shares/stock-market-news/aim-and-small-cap-news/aim-bulletin/archive/itim-confident-despite-swinging-to-pre-tax-loss)). Moat is limited to switching costs of embedded retail integrations (not evidenced in the sources); exposed to the weak UK retail sector.
thesis.main_shareholders: Herald Investment Management Ltd: 3.91% (1,228,701 shares) after falling from 7.09% on 10 June 2026 ([Investegate TR-1](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/itim-group--itim/holding-s-in-company/9616562)). Robert and Virginia Millington crossed a notification threshold on 8 April 2026 (percentage not seen; [Investegate](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/itim-group--itim/holding-s-in-company/9511033)). Full register of 3%+ holders not retrieved.
thesis.red_flags: Customer failure (Quiz Clothing administration) drove a bad debt and a swing to pre-tax loss; cash fell to GBP 2.6m ([FY2025 results](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/itim-group--itim/full-year-results-for-year-ended-31-december-2025/9565050)); cost base cut by over GBP 1m in H2 2025 (restructuring); retail-sector customer concentration; AIM small-cap liquidity; notable institutional selling (Herald cut stake to 3.91% in June 2026).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Schulte-Schlagbaum AG (Velbert, Germany; founded 1833) develops, manufactures and markets systems and solutions for locking and organizing buildings (access control, locks and fittings) through a group of five companies; shares trade in the Dusseldorf open market.
thesis.competitive_position: Long-established German locking and access-control niche player; the group comprises five companies and acquired Saechsische Schlossfabrik GmbH ([SAG news](https://en.sag-schlagbaum.com/news/schulte-schlagbaum-ag-takes-over-saechsische-schlossfabrik-gmbh/)); FY2024 revenue about EUR 59.8m, up 2.4% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/de/tech/duse-sss/schulte-schlagbaum-shares/news/schulte-schlagbaum-reports-full-year-2024-earnings)), though another page shows EUR 57.4m. Brand and installed base provide some stickiness, but scale is small versus large lock and access-control groups.
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Management turnover: a board member resigned and Thomas Golatta, appointed to the board effective 1 Jul 2024, was to act as sole board member from November 2024 ([Boersengefluester](https://app.boersengefluester.de/en/newswire/DE0007190001/schulte-schlagbaum-ag/vorstand-legt-amt-nieder-1848597)); open-market (Freiverkehr) listing with limited disclosure and liquidity; conflicting revenue figures across sources.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Pirmasens (Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany) brewer producing beer brands including Park, Bellheimer, Valentins Weissbier and Rheingoenheimer, plus alcohol-free beverages; founded 1888.
thesis.competitive_position: Regional German brewer and beverage producer with consolidated revenue of about EUR 24.77M (audit report filed 2025-07-25, per [FinancialReports](https://financialfilings.com/companies/park-bellheimer-ag/)). No evidence found of pricing power or a durable moat; the German beer market is mature and fragmented, and the company's scale is small (5,000,000 shares; market cap about EUR 10-12.5M per [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/de/food-beverage-tobacco/fra-pkb/park-bellheimer-shares/information) and [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/de:pkb)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Remarul 16 Februarie S.A. (Cluj-Napoca, Romania; BVB ticker REFE) repairs, modernises and builds railway rolling stock (wagons), a business dating to 1870, serving Romanian rail operators.
thesis.competitive_position: Small Romanian rolling-stock repair/modernisation player with a few anchor customers: the 2025 report lists CFR Calatori, Conpet and Transferoviar Grup among main clients ([BVB 2025 financials](https://www.bvb.ro/info/Raportari/REFE/REFE_20260327160009_Situatii-financiare-2025.pdf)). It was reportedly the sole bidder for a PNRR-funded contract of RON 235M to modernise 30 CFR Calatori wagons ([Economedia](https://economedia.ro/contractul-pentru-modernizarea-a-30-de-vagoane-cfr-calatori-remarul-16-februarie-a-depus-singura-oferta-la-licitatia-pnrr-de-235-milioane-lei.html)); revenue reportedly rose from ~RON 35M (2024) to over RON 106M (2025) ([Actual de Cluj](https://actualdecluj.ro/?p=293023)). Moat is limited to site/know-how and affiliation with Transferoviar.
thesis.main_shareholders: Transferoviar Grup ~33% (historic 32.96% in 2013) ([Bursa.ro](https://www.bursa.ro/transferoviar-grup-si-a-redus-la-33-procente-detinerea-la-remarul-16-februarie-dupa-amenda-de-la-cnvm-6770958)); other holders and current percentages not retrieved from the 2025 annual report.
thesis.red_flags: Customer concentration on state/related rail entities (CFR Calatori, Conpet, Transferoviar) ([BVB 2025](https://www.bvb.ro/info/Raportari/REFE/REFE_20260327160009_Situatii-financiare-2025.pdf)); revenue is lumpy and tied to a PNRR contract ([Economedia](https://economedia.ro/contractul-pentru-modernizarea-a-30-de-vagoane-cfr-calatori-remarul-16-februarie-a-depus-singura-oferta-la-licitatia-pnrr-de-235-milioane-lei.html)); related-party: acquired Uzina de Vagoane Aiud (over 99% held by Transferoviar Grup) for ~RON 4.2M ([ZF](https://www.zf.ro/burse-fonduri-mutuale/remarul-16-februarie-cluj-napoca-una-dintre-cele-mai-tranzactionate-companii-de-pe-aero-cumpara-uzina-de-vagoane-aiud-pentru-4-2-mil-lei-16745593)); board chairman resigned and an administrator was replaced in Aug 2026 ([BVB report](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/REFE/REFE_20260820115951_Raport-curent-demisie-presedinte-CA-si-numire-administrator.pdf)); past dispute with CFR Calatori over a large sum ([Bursa.ro](https://www.bursa.ro/dorobantu-cfr-calatori-cu-remarul-16-februarie-ne-judecam-pe-o-mare-suma-de-bani-86236029), date not verified).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: B+S Banksysteme AG (Munich) develops and sells standard software for banks and financial management, with maintenance and ASP revenue as recurring income; about 86-88 employees.
thesis.competitive_position: Niche German software vendor to retail, savings and online banks and industrial treasuries, with recurring maintenance/ASP income supporting stickiness ([4investors interview](https://www.4investors.de/nachrichten/boerse.php?ID=183795); [finanztrends](https://www.finanztrends.de/vorstandsinterview-exklusiv-bs-banksysteme-wir-gewinnen-marktanteile/)); 9M FY2025/26 sales rose 11% and EBIT 48% to EUR 1.33m ([pressetext/stock3](https://stock3.com/news/pta-news-bs-banksysteme-ag-zwischenmitteilung-q3-2025-26-17076881)). Scale is very small versus large core-banking vendors, so moat is switching cost only.
thesis.main_shareholders: Per boerse.de (undated, 2025): Wilhelm Berger 26.42%, Peter Bauch 23.59%, Axxion S.A. 9.98%, Ludic GmbH 5.10%, PEN GmbH 4.46%, free float 30.45% ([boerse.de](https://www.boerse.de/unternehmensprofil/B-S-Banksysteme-Aktie/DE0001262152)); voting-rights notifications under section 40 WpHG were published in Sept and Nov 2025 ([pressetext](https://www.pressetext.com/news/20251124032)).
thesis.red_flags: Concentrated register (two holders about 50%) and small free float; small-company key-person dependence (Simon Berger is the board contact in press releases, Peter Bauch listed as CEO on a price page, unconfirmed); share buyback notification of 19 Sep 2025 shows company is repurchasing shares ([stock3](https://stock3.com/news/pta-pvr-bs-banksysteme-ag-korrektur-einer-veroeffentlichung-ueber-erwerb-eigener-aktien-nach-40-abs-1-satz-2-wphg-vom-19-09-2025-16667790)). No going-concern or auditor issue found in the sources reviewed.
thesis.insider_ownership: Wilhelm Berger 26.42% and Peter Bauch 23.59% (boerse.de, undated); roles of both on the board not confirmed in search results.

thesis.business_description: Warsaw-based brokerage house (NWAI Dom Maklerski S.A.) offering brokerage, issuer services (IPO/offer, issue sponsor) and investment services, with a focus on Polish small caps; transferred from NewConnect to the GPW Main Market, first main-market trading day 29 July 2026.
thesis.competitive_position: Small niche broker in the Polish market; its net profit in 2025 was PLN 8.8M ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/debiut-ipo/nwai-debiut-gpw-2026)). It acted as issue sponsor for Quercus fund certificates until April 2026, when KDPW records show it ceased that role for one fund ([KDPW](https://www.kdpw.pl/uploads/documents/resolutions/2026/0367-2026.pdf)). Revenue is market-cycle dependent and the firm is tiny against XTB, mBank, PKO BP DM; no scale moat. The main-market move was done without a public offer ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/debiut-ipo/nwai-debiut-na-gpw)).
thesis.main_shareholders: New World Holding SA (parent; percentage not retrieved) per company profile data ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/NWA)); full structure is in the 2025 annual report ([NWAI report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/1595_20260317_200300_Raport_roczny_NWAI_2025_2_WD.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Parent-controlled (subsidiary of New World Holding SA), so controlling-holder dynamics apply; small free float. Earnings are cyclical with equity-market turnover and small-cap IPO activity. Share price jumped ~7% on first main-market day to PLN 35.6 and rose >140% in ~six months per press ([Comparic](https://comparic.pl/akcje-brokera-z-gpw-rosna-o-20-w-kilka-dni-i-ponad-140-w-pol-roku-czy-xtb-wyrasta-nowy-konkurent/)), implying momentum-driven valuation risk. Share-count figures differ across sources (1,746,583 vs 1,786,723 shares).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (CEO Mateusz Walczak and board member Magdalena Graca; holdings not retrieved) ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/debiut-ipo/nwai-debiut-gpw-2026)).

thesis.business_description: Catalyst Media Group plc (AIM, UK) is a holding company whose principal asset is a 20.54% stake in Sports Information Services (Holdings) Ltd (SIS), which supplies data, content and virtual/e-sports products to the global betting industry, accounted for as an equity-accounted associate.
thesis.competitive_position: Pure minority holding in one associate; value depends on SIS, whose revenue was GBP 104.9m in the period to 30 Sept 2025 with a GBP 0.6m operating loss ([Investegate](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/catalyst-media-group--cmx/interim-results-/9499140)). SIS has a leading position in betting-shop content but faces UK gambling tax and rights-cost headwinds ([Investegate](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/catalyst-media-group--cmx/final-results-for-30-june-2025-and-notice-of-agm/9311338)). CMG has no control over SIS.
thesis.main_shareholders: Lombard Odier Asset Management (Europe) about 26.3-26.9%, Melvin Lawson about 17.2-17.3%, and Harwood Capital about 16.5%, per Simply Wall St (undated); top holders own over 95% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/commercial-services/aim-cmx/catalyst-media-group-shares/ownership)).
thesis.red_flags: Single non-controlled asset concentration (SIS) with a March 2026 update flagging margin and rights headwinds likely to affect the FY outturn ([Stockopedia](https://www.stockopedia.com/share-prices/catalyst-media-LON:CMX/news/urn:newsml:reuters.com:20260331:nRSe7069Ya)); extremely concentrated register limits free float; shares were previously suspended on AIM during SIS-related negotiations in 2023 ([LSE](https://www.lse.co.uk/rns/CMX/re-suspension-u2efo998o13wqk4.html)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Melvin Lawson about 17.2% per Simply Wall St; whether he is a director was not confirmed in sources seen

thesis.business_description: Kościan-based Polish children's clothing group owning the Coccodrillo, Lemon Explore, Petit Bijou and Broel brands plus Fikołki Playrooms, selling through its own store network in Poland and abroad; a 2021 report also lists the Buslik children's supermarket chain in Belarus.
thesis.competitive_position: Established Polish children's-apparel brand owner with vertically integrated own-brand retail; trailing-twelve-month revenue about PLN 266.9M but net profit only about PLN 2.9M (down 93.5%) per a Feb 2026 snapshot ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/CDL/)). Brand recognition is the main asset; margins are exposed to fashion, cost inflation and competition from discount and large-chain retailers (no evidence of a hard moat). Brand portfolio per [Strefa Inwestorow IPO analysis](https://strefainwestorow.pl/artykuly/debiut-ipo/analiza-ipo-czy-warto-kupic-akcje-coccodrillo-czyli-spolki-cdrl-sa).
thesis.main_shareholders: Forsmart Ltd 41.68%, Tomasz Przybyła 21.66%, Marek Dworczak 20.97% (Stockwatch, data to 1 Oct 2026; Przybyła/Dworczak updates Aug 2026) ([Stockwatch](https://www.stockwatch.pl/gpw/cdrl,akcjonariat,kapitalizacja.aspx)); NN OFE about 6% per BiznesRadar ([BiznesRadar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/akcjonariat/CDL)). Bankier shows the same three holders at 88.81% of votes with 2024 dates ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/CDRL/akcjonariat)).
thesis.red_flags: Net profit collapse (about -93.5% on a TTM basis, Feb 2026 snapshot) ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/CDL/)). Three holders control about 84% of the capital, leaving a thin free float ([Stockwatch](https://www.stockwatch.pl/gpw/cdrl,akcjonariat,kapitalizacja.aspx)). Historic exposure to Belarus through the Buslik chain (2021 report) ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/wiadomosci/20211119/13-mln-zl-zysku-netto-grupy-cdrl-w-iii-kwartale)); current status of that exposure not verified. An extraordinary general meeting was called for 19 Aug 2026 (agenda not retrieved) ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art45021761-cdrl-spolka-akcyjna-wykaz-akcjonariuszy-posiadajacych-co-najmniej-5-liczby-glosow-na-nadzwyczajnym-walnym-zgromadzeniu-spolki-cdrl-s-a-zwolanym-na-dzien-19-sierpnia-2026-roku)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Management/founder holders: Marek Dworczak (CEO per [BiznesRadar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/akcjonariat/CDL)) 20.97% and Tomasz Przybyła 21.66% directly; Forsmart Ltd 41.68% (a 2014 IPO analysis said the two main shareholders held about 99% through a Cypriot company they control; the link to Forsmart is not confirmed in sources found).

thesis.business_description: London-based software provider of products and services for real-time financial market data processing and trading, selling to banks and financial institutions; fiscal year ends 30 June. FY2025 turnover was GBP 3.11M.
thesis.competitive_position: Micro-cap niche vendor in market-data software, small against Bloomberg/LSEG/FactSet-style incumbents; it relies on a small number of sticky institutional users and consulting work. FY to 30 June 2025: turnover GBP 3,106,991 (+6.8%), profit before tax GBP 987,390 (about -10%), EPS 7.05p, dividend 4.00p (2024: 3.75p); growth credited to a new high-end customer and the return of consulting revenue ([Final Results RNS](https://www.ticker.app/lse/ARC/rns/2025-09-10/Final-Results-for-the-year-ended-30-June-2025/6834Y), [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/arcontech-reports-revenue-growth-and-dividend-increase-amidst-competitive-market)). Switching costs for embedded users are a mild moat, but costs rose (staffing) and H1 FY26 revenue fell 4.7% to GBP 1,439,382 ([Investegate](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/arcontech-group--arc/interim-results-for-the-six-months-ended-31-dec-25/9410041)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Williams de Broe Ltd 15.94% of voting rights via Pershing Nominees per an RNS holdings notice (undated, may be stale) ([LSE RNS](https://www.lse.co.uk/rns/ARC/holdings-in-company-ns4sqrtlu3cewim.html)); Simply Wall St lists only small holders (IG Group 0.32%, Rathbones 0.29%, Peel Hunt 0.27%) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/software/aim-arc/arcontech-group-shares/ownership)). Holding notices were filed 26 Feb 2025 and 5 Feb 2026 (contents not retrieved).
thesis.red_flags: Revenue decline in H1 FY26 (-4.7%) and falling FY25 profit amid a challenging market ([Alliance News via LSE](https://www.lse.co.uk/news/arcontech-profit-falls-despite-revenue-rise-amid-challenging-market-p5ov5xjde7sy9r2.html)). Small scale, probable customer concentration (growth tied to one new high-end customer; concentration not quantified in sources found), AIM illiquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (director PDMR shareholding notices published 5-6 Feb 2026; holdings not retrieved) ([ticker.app](https://www.ticker.app/lse/ARC/rns/2026-02-05/DirectorPDMR-Shareholding/9576R)).

thesis.business_description: Koensk-based (Swietokrzyskie) producer, seller, renter and assembler of its own construction/industrial products (former Betomax Polska, renamed Jan 2025) for construction, industrial and infrastructure customers in Poland; group includes 100% subsidiary Pamexpol Sp. z o.o.
thesis.competitive_position: Regional niche manufacturer of concrete/construction products and related rental and assembly services, with no evident wide moat; 2024 revenue was PLN 88.6M for the company and PLN 103.5M for the group ([2024 management report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/51660304/DOC.20250527.51660304.5._Sprawozdanie_z_dzialalnosci_i_GK_za_2024-6.pdf)). Q1 2025 revenue was PLN 26.6M (+11% y/y) with net profit PLN 1.38M (-13%) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/capital-goods/wse-frb/forbuild-shares/news/forbuild-reports-first-quarter-2025-earnings)). Dependence on Polish construction cycle; management called 2025 a difficult year given the war in Ukraine.
thesis.main_shareholders: As of 27 Jan 2025: Maciej Pasturczak (with concert parties incl. Katarzyna Luczynska) 2,467,190 shares (20.55% of capital, 20.41% of votes); Piotr Pieta 17.64% of capital and 18.24% of votes; FRAM Fundacja Rodzinna 1,070,849 shares (8.92% of capital, 6.65% of votes) ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/FORBUILD/akcjonariat)). Later change-of-vote notices exist (Aug and Sep 2025) but contents were not retrieved ([Money.pl](https://www.money.pl/gielda/komunikaty/?isin=plbetmx00013)).
thesis.red_flags: Fragmented control with several blocks and family foundations; voting preference shares make votes differ from capital (FRAM 8.92% capital vs 6.65% votes) ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/FORBUILD/akcjonariat)). Share capital reduced from PLN 1.34M to PLN 1.20M (Series D shares cancelled, Jan 2025) ([2024 report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/51660304/DOC.20250527.51660304.5._Sprawozdanie_z_dzialalnosci_i_GK_za_2024-6.pdf)). Small-cap liquidity risk. No going-concern or auditor-qualification wording found.
thesis.insider_ownership: Maciej Pasturczak (with concert parties) 20.55% of capital and Piotr Pieta 17.64% as of 27 Jan 2025, both named as major holders ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/FORBUILD/akcjonariat)); their management/board roles were not confirmed in sources found.

thesis.business_description: Korbank S.A. (Wrocław, Poland) is a telecommunications operator providing data/telecom services to companies, institutions and housing estates in Poland and abroad, with a B2C customer-acquisition subsidiary (Korbank-Media Cyfrowe).
thesis.competitive_position: Small regional fibre/telecom operator competing with large incumbents; edge lies in local network assets and B2B contracts, with no national scale moat. Q3 2025 revenue was PLN 11.06m (+7.5%); trailing revenue was about PLN 41.7m with net income about PLN 5.1m (June 2025 snapshot) ([Stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/KOR/revenue/); [Korbank Q4 2025 report](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-02/20260216_230708_0000001274_0000064397.pdf)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Tymoteusz Biłyk 3,994,894 shares = 80.92% of capital and 88.13% of votes (as of 2012); Paweł Paluchowski 210,000 shares = 4.46% ([Parkiet - Korbank](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/235941-korbank)); Simply Wall St shows CEO ownership at 81.8% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/telecom/wse-kor/korbank-shares/management)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling shareholder holds about 81% of capital and 88% of votes, leaving a tiny free float and thin liquidity; controlling-holder dynamics (potential squeeze-out/delisting risk, none announced); register data dated 2012 for percentage detail.
