thesis.insider_ownership: Chairman/CEO Tymoteusz Biłyk about 81% of capital (80.92% in 2012 filing; 81.8% per Simply Wall St) ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/235941-korbank); [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/telecom/wse-kor/korbank-shares/management)).

thesis.business_description: Etropole (Bulgaria)-based maker of disposable dialysis products (capillary dialyzers, arterial-venous blood line sets, procedure kits, fistula needles), founded 1976, with about 96-98 employees and one subsidiary, Etropal Trade OOD ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bul/ETR/company); [MarketScreener](https://in.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ETROPAL-AD-64306703/company/)). FY2025 revenue was about 10.35m (up from 8.07m; currency assumed EUR) ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bul/ETR/financials/)).
thesis.competitive_position: Small niche medical-consumables producer in a market dominated by global dialysis majors; growth in 2025 (about +28% revenue) but profitability volatile: SeeNews reported a standalone net loss of EUR 367k in H1 2026 versus a profit a year earlier ([SeeNews](https://seenews.com/companies/etropal-ad-6212)). Regulatory certification and local manufacturing are the main barriers; no clear moat.
thesis.main_shareholders: Synthetica AD, subsidiary parent: 66.53% at 31 Dec 2011 ([MarketScreener](https://in.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ETROPAL-AD-64306703/news/Etropal-Financial-and-other-reports-Consolidated-annual-financial-report-40030522)) and 71.75% per [Capital.bg (2012)](https://www.capital.bg/biznes/kompanii/2012/02/02/1758594_etropal_otchita_po-malko_prodajbi_zaradi_zabaveni/); Evroins Romania 9.51% (2012). These figures are dated; the current register was not found.
thesis.red_flags: Controlling-holder dynamics (Synthetica AD majority holder, StockAnalysis lists Etropal as its subsidiary) and thin free float ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bul/ETR/company)); swing to a H1 2026 net loss ([SeeNews](https://seenews.com/companies/etropal-ad-6212)); history of sharp revenue falls (2012) ([Capital.bg](https://www.capital.bg/biznes/finansi/2012/11/28/1957317_etropal_otchete_silen_spad_na_prihodite/)); ownership data not current.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Polish asset-management group (Caspar Asset Management S.A.) running Caspar TFI, which manages the Caspar Parasolowy FIO umbrella fund and nine closed-end funds, plus individual portfolios; Poland only. Net AUM across the sub-funds and closed-end funds was about PLN 1.59bn at end-April 2026.
thesis.competitive_position: Small, boutique Polish fund manager: net AUM of PLN 244.5M in 5 Parasolowy FIO sub-funds and PLN 1,342.4M in 9 closed-end funds at end-April 2026, up from PLN 195.2M and PLN 1,239.2M at end-2025 ([Bankier ESPI](https://www.biznesradar.pl/wiadomosci/CASPAR-ASSET-MANAGEMENT,3), [Bankier ESPI Jan 2026](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art37355291-caspar-am-sa-wartosc-aktywow-pod-zarzadzaniem-caspar-asset-management-s-a)). Mostly closed-end funds for dedicated investors give sticky but concentrated AUM; no scale or brand moat versus large Polish TFIs. Management plans to simplify into a listed holding with asset management moved into Caspar TFI during 2026 ([Analizy.pl](https://www.analizy.pl/tylko-u-nas/40250/caspar-uklada-grupe-na-nowo-bez-alfy-aktywne-fundusze-nie-maja-po-co-istniec)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Piotr Przedwojski 28.58%, Leszek Kasperski 28.39%, Blazej Bogdziewicz 27.49% of votes at the GM, others 15.54% (Q1 2024 report) ([ESPI report](https://money2.wpcdn.pl/gielda/gpw/espi/129/6940801510307457_4.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Management turnover: president Hanna Kijanowska resigned effective 30 Sep 2025 ([Analizy.pl](https://www.analizy.pl/puls-rynku/40125/caspar-am-uzupelnia-zarzad-piotr-przedwojski-ma-objac-funkcje-prezesa)). Three founders hold ~84% of votes, leaving ~15.5% free float and thin liquidity. Revenue depends on AUM-based fees and a few closed-end funds, with business-model restructuring underway (TFI reorganisation in 2026).
thesis.insider_ownership: Three insiders hold ~84.5% combined: Przedwojski 28.58%, Kasperski 28.39%, Bogdziewicz 27.49% (Q1 2024) ([ESPI report](https://money2.wpcdn.pl/gielda/gpw/espi/129/6940801510307457_4.pdf)).

name: Fabryki Sprzetu i Narzedzi Górniczych Grupa Kapitalowa FASING S.A.

thesis.business_description: Katowice-based manufacturer of mining chains and related equipment (FASING group); chains are sold for mining, but also fishing, energy, sugar, cement and timber industries, with Polish coal mining as the core customer base.
thesis.competitive_position: Long-established niche producer of round-link chains for underground mining, a captive-market niche tied to Polish hard-coal producers; the company describes its activity as production of chains for mining, fishing, energy, sugar, cement and wood industries ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/wiadomosci/FASING,3)). Moat is installed relationships and certification in a small specialised market, but demand is exposed to the structural decline of Polish coal mining. Equity of ~USD 47M against market cap of ~USD 13M (per input data) suggests the market prices in weak returns on the asset base. Annual reports are published on the company site ([FASING 2023 report](https://www.fasing.pl/files/raporty_okresowe/19/consolidated_annual_report_of_2023.pdf)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Karbon 2 Sp. z o.o. and Anna Bik are the controlling holders: in August 2025 they announced a tender for 1,232,231 shares at PLN 12.50 ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/wiadomosci/FASING,3)), after Karbon 2 had earlier tendered for the 'remaining 38.22%' in 2021 at PLN 12.46 ([MarketScreener](https://in.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/FABRYKI-SPRZETU-I-NARZEDZ-11193955/news/Karbon-2-Sp-z-o-o-launched-a-tender-offer-to-acquire-remaining-38-22-stake-in-Fabryki-Sprzetu-i-N-36098858)); exact current percentages not retrieved.
thesis.red_flags: Controlling-holder dynamics: Karbon 2 / Anna Bik have repeatedly bid for the minority (2021 and 2025 tenders), pointing to possible further squeeze-out or delisting risk and a ceiling-like bid price (PLN 12.50) ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/wiadomosci/FASING,3)). Only 74,937 shares were reportedly acquired on 6 Oct 2025, i.e. minority holders largely declined ([Bossa filing](https://bossa.pl/sites/b30/files/2025-10/document/Informacja%20o%20liczbie%20akcji%20b%C4%99d%C4%85cych%20przedmiotem%20nabycia_FSG.pdf)). Thin free float (3,107,249 shares in issue per 2020 report) and end-market tied to declining Polish coal mining.
thesis.insider_ownership: Anna Bik (with Karbon 2 Sp. z o.o.) controls a majority of the shares; exact % not retrieved ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/wiadomosci/FASING,3)).

thesis.business_description: Greek manufacturer (Serres Industrial Estate) of office and home furniture, partition walls and filing systems, plus a die-cast aluminium/plastic components activity; sells in Greece, the Balkans and EU countries ([Simply Wall St profile](https://simplywall.st/stock/atse/drome); [Investing.com profile](https://m.uk.investing.com/equities/dromeas-company-profile)).
thesis.competitive_position: Long-established family-founded Greek office-furniture producer (founded 1979) with a branded product range and a Bulgarian marketing subsidiary as of 2013 ([Dromeas 2013 presentation](https://indico.cern.ch/event/298891/contributions/681930/attachments/562308/774620/DROMEAS_PRESENTATION_2013_ENG.pdf)). Moat is modest (local manufacturing/brand and projects); it is small versus international office-furniture groups, and it announced cooperations such as with Egger ([ATHEX/Euronext Athens announcement](https://athens.euronext.com/en/more-options/announcements/dromeas-expands-new-fields-dromeas-egger-road-strategic-cooperation)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Athanasios Papapanagiotou 46.60% and Ioannis Papapanagiotou 24.97% (Euronext Athens/ATHEX issuer data, based on shareholder notifications; [issuer page](https://athens.euronext.com/en/market-data/issuers/855)); a 2021 ATHEX notice also reports Ioannis Papapanagiotou at 24.97% direct and indirect ([Dromeas notice](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/DROMEAS-SA-6258970/news/Dromeas-nbsp-SHAREHOLDERS-INFORMATION-35692478/)). Remaining free float is roughly 28% by subtraction (34,720,000 shares outstanding).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling-family dynamics: the two Papapanagiotou holders together control about 71.6% (per the issuer page above), leaving a thin free float (about 28% by subtraction); the board proposed no dividend for 2024 ([Euronext Athens financial calendar 2025](https://athens.euronext.com/en/more-options/announcements/announcement-financial-calendar-2025-9)); aggregators disagree on FY2025 result (loss of EUR 0.74M vs profit), unverified against filed statements ([MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/DROMEAS-SA-6258970/news/Dromeas-nbsp-SHAREHOLDERS-INFORMATION-35692478/) for context).
thesis.insider_ownership: Papapanagiotou family: Athanasios 46.60% and Ioannis 24.97% (Euronext Athens issuer data, https://athens.euronext.com/en/market-data/issuers/855); Athanasios is chairman.

thesis.business_description: Malta-based IT company (formerly Datatrak IT Services) providing software development, application service provision and web-based services, with growth driven by its openFleet delivery-management platform; FY to 30 June 2025 revenue about EUR 12.87M.
thesis.competitive_position: Small Maltese software/IT services provider; FY2025 revenue growth of about 9% was driven by openFleet, and the company returned to a small profit (about EUR 118k vs a EUR 625k loss in 2023/24, per [Who's Who Malta](https://whoswho.mt/en/strict-discipline-drives-loqus-return-to-profitability); another source shows EUR 130k) ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/mse/LQS/revenue)). Limited moat: niche product exposure in a small domestic market.
thesis.main_shareholders: JFC Holdings Limited about 66.92% after buying a further about 6.74% in June 2026 (Company Announcement 249/2026, 10 Jun 2026) ([Malta Stock Exchange](https://cdn.borzamalta.com.mt/download/announcements/LQS249.pdf)). Earlier: JFC held 50%, then 59.4% after its 2025 voluntary takeover bid ([Who's Who Malta](https://whoswho.mt/en/jfc-holdings-becomes-majority-owner-of-loqus-holdings-with-59-4-stake)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder JFC Holdings (about 66.92%) is progressively increasing its stake and has said it may propose delisting from the Malta Stock Exchange Alternative Companies List (delisting/low-free-float risk) ([Who's Who Malta](https://whoswho.mt/en/jfc-holdings-becomes-majority-owner-of-loqus-holdings-with-59-4-stake)). Trading was suspended at the company's request around the bid (Aug 2025), and MFSA suspended trading in the shares in 2012 ([MaltaToday](https://maltatoday.com.mt/business/business_news/19648/mfsa-suspends-trading-in-shares-of-loqus-plc-20120716)). Thin profitability after prior losses.
thesis.insider_ownership: Controlling holder JFC Holdings Limited; a Who's Who Malta headline links the stake increase to Joe Fenech Conti ([Who's Who Malta](https://whoswho.mt/en/joe-fenech-conti-set-to-increase-stake-in-loqus-to-75-shareholding)). Individual director holdings not retrieved.

thesis.business_description: Nidaros Sparebank is an independent Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Klaebu (Trondheim area), founded 1858, whose equity certificates trade on Euronext Growth Oslo under NISB.
thesis.competitive_position: Small regional retail/SME savings bank in the Trondheim region with a local franchise rather than scale; FY2025 profit after tax NOK 43.5m (2024: NOK 35.0m) ([MFN](https://mfn.se/ob/a/nidaros-sparebank/nidaros-sparebank-arsrapport-for-2025-5aa87477)). It acquired the Personellservice Trondelag (PT) portfolio in 2026, and Q1 2026 profit was NOK 5.6m versus NOK 10.4m, hit by NOK 4m one-offs ([Quartr](https://quartr.com/events/nidaros-sparebank-nisb-q1-2026_FG1FbyNC)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Integration and IT migration one-off costs of about NOK 15m expected in 2026 temporarily lowering ROE ([Quartr](https://quartr.com/events/nidaros-sparebank-nisb-q1-2026_FG1FbyNC)); rate sensitivity (lower rates reduce NII); equity-certificate structure limits owner control; thin equity certificate liquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders about 17.2% and private companies 33.7% of shares, per Simply Wall St aggregate (undated) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/no/banks/ob-nisb/nidaros-sparebank-shares/ownership))

thesis.business_description: Mediterra S.A. (Greece) is the marketing arm of the Chios Mastiha Growers Association, developing, producing, distributing and retailing mastic-based confectionery, cosmetics, pharmaceutical and Greek food products through the 'mastihashop' chain and e-commerce.
thesis.competitive_position: Exclusive commercial channel for Chios mastic products via its parent association, which is a real supply-side advantage in a geographically unique product ([Mediterra/mastihashop](https://mastihashop.com/en/pages/h-etaireia); [Gum Mastic](https://gummastic.gr/en/company/history)). FY2024 revenue EUR 14.25M (+15.1%) with gross profit EUR 4.46M ([Stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/ath/MASTIHA/revenue/)); trailing net income about EUR 465K.
thesis.main_shareholders: Chios Gum Mastic Growers Association 54.21%, Zaitech Fund 28.18%, Korres S.A. Natural Products 5.13% ([Euronext Athens issuer page](https://athens.euronext.com/en/market-data/issuers/1177)); an older ATHEX profile showed 51.04% / 28.41% / 5.13%.
thesis.red_flags: Parent association controls over half the capital and Zaitech Fund another 28%, leaving a free float of about 12%; dependence on a single raw material from the association; low net margin (about 3%); latest annual figures not retrieved.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (the controlling holder is the producers' association, not management).

thesis.business_description: MakoLab S.A. (Łódź, Poland) is an IT services and software house (PKD 6201) delivering digital commerce, consulting and custom software to clients mainly in Poland and Europe, through subsidiaries such as MakoLab Consulting.
thesis.competitive_position: Small Polish IT services provider with a long track record (founded 1989 by Mirosław Sopek), with growth in 2025 coming from electrical and drugstore-sector clients ([ITWiz](https://itwiz.pl/makolab-zakonczyl-2025-rok-z-779-mln-zl-skonsolidowanych-przychodow-ze-sprzedazy/)). 2025 group revenue was PLN 77.9m (+4%), operating profit PLN 6.41m and net profit PLN 4.13m ([MakoLab reports for 2025](https://makolab.com/insights/MakoLab-reports-for-2025)). No structural moat beyond client relationships; competes in a commoditised IT-services market.
thesis.main_shareholders: Founder Mirosław Sopek is a named shareholder; large holders together reported at 53.57% of votes on about 6.99m shares, but the individual breakdown is dated 2016-17 ([Bankier shareholders page](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/new-connect/MAKOLAB/akcjonariat)).
thesis.red_flags: Key-person/leadership disruption: long-time CEO Wojciech Zieliński died at end-2025 and Mirosław Sopek is acting President ([ITWiz](https://itwiz.pl/makolab-zakonczyl-2025-rok-z-779-mln-zl-skonsolidowanych-przychodow-ze-sprzedazy/)); controlling-holder concentration and thin NewConnect liquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder Mirosław Sopek is a shareholder and supervisory board member/acting CEO; exact stake not verified ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/new-connect/MAKOLAB/akcjonariat)).

thesis.business_description: Romanian company listed on BVB (AeRO); data providers classify it in materials, but its exact business lines were not confirmed from filings seen. 2025 revenue was about RON 39.7m with net income RON 0.56m.
thesis.competitive_position: Business niche and market position could not be verified from sources retrieved; financials show revenue up 32.4% to RON 39.74m in 2025 and net income RON 562,502 (+220%), i.e. a ~1.4% net margin ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/MINO/)). Thin margin and 98% ownership by one investment company suggest no demonstrable moat; equity is small relative to market cap (USD 1.35m vs USD 12.7m).
thesis.main_shareholders: Longshield Investment Group S.A. 98.0184% (32,595,770 of 33,254,742 shares); legal entities 0.1474%; natural persons 1.8342% as of 30.06.2026 ([MINO H1 2026 report](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/MINO/MINO_20260819142544_Raport-semestrial-S1-2026.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Free float only ~2% (natural persons 1.83%, legal entities 0.15%) per the H1 2026 report, creating severe illiquidity and squeeze-out/delisting risk ([H1 2026 report](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/MINO/MINO_20260819142544_Raport-semestrial-S1-2026.pdf)). Market cap (USD 12.7m) is about 9x book equity (USD 1.35m). Two extraordinary shareholder meetings were convened in June 2026 (23 and 30 June) whose agendas were not verified ([convocation](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/MINO/MINO_20260525113706_RO622003-Convocator-AGEA-MINDO-30-06-2026.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Cofidur S.A. is the holding company of Cofidur EMS, a French electronic manufacturing services (EMS) subcontractor operating from the Mayenne/Dordogne area, generating consolidated sales of about EUR 83.8m in 2025.
thesis.competitive_position: Mid-sized French EMS subcontractor in a competitive, cyclical contract-manufacturing niche with no evident moat beyond customer relationships and industrial know-how. FY2025 consolidated sales were EUR 83.8m, up 5.3% ([Boursedirect, Cofidur 2025 sales](https://www.boursedirect.fr/fr/actualites/categorie/chiffre-d-affaires/cofidur-le-chiffre-d-affaires-progresse-en-2025-boursier-378453fc7137423b638385565081416318357748)); an independent write-up argues the stock trades at a significant discount to hard assets ([Dismissed Europe Substack](https://dismissedeurope.substack.com/p/cofidur-trading-at-a-significant)).
thesis.main_shareholders: EMS Finance held 49.51% of capital as of May 2021, then was sold to Dordogne Mayenne Developpement (SAS owned 100% by Cofidur operating managers); current full register not verified ([AMF notice, 12 May 2021](https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/AMF/ACT/2021/05/FCACT055566_20210512.pdf); [AMF notice, 6 July 2021](https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/AMF/ACT/2021/07/FCACT056273_20210706.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling-holder dynamics: management-owned vehicle took over the ~49.5% anchor stake as part of a succession plan ([AMF notice, 6 July 2021](https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/AMF/ACT/2021/07/FCACT056273_20210706.pdf)); very low free float and liquidity on Euronext Growth; thin net margin (2025 net income reported around EUR 1.0m on EUR 83.6m sales by aggregators) and cyclical EMS exposure ([Boursedirect](https://www.boursedirect.fr/en/news/value/cofidur-sa-FR0013257409-ALCOF-EUR-ALXP)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Dordogne Mayenne Developpement (100% owned by Cofidur operational managers; reported as seven people in a secondary source) is the successor holder of the former EMS Finance 49.5% stake; Laurent Dupoiron is listed as chairman/CEO of Cofidur SA and chairman of DMD ([AMF notice, 6 July 2021](https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/AMF/ACT/2021/07/FCACT056273_20210706.pdf); [MarketScreener](https://www.zonebourse.com/insider/LAURENT-DUPOIRON-A3AXTO/)).

thesis.business_description: Krakow-based developer of logistics and manufacturing software (Qguar WMS Pro, TMS, TMS Mobile, MES, APS, YMS), selling licences, implementation, training and support mainly to Polish companies.
thesis.competitive_position: Niche Polish vendor of warehouse and transport management systems competing against international suites and local integrators; recurring support and implementation work gives some stickiness but no network-effect moat. Revenue was PLN 53.69M in 2024 (+5.07%) per StockAnalysis ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/QNT/)); Craft.co lists ~PLN 56.8M for 2025, unverified ([Craft](https://craft.co/quantum-software-s-a)). Products include Qguar WMS Pro and Qguar TMS ([Value at Risk](https://valueatrisk.substack.com/p/wsparcie-procesow-logistycznych-i)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Quantum Assets sp. z o.o.: 675,421 registered series A shares (privileged voting) = 49.49% of capital plus 295,491 bearer shares = 21.65% of capital (13.97% of votes), per Q1 2026 report as cited by Parkiet ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/technologie/art45124001-quantum-software-moze-zniknac-z-gieldy-jakie-sa-scenariusze)); Tomasz Hatala ~4.62% (2022 Stockwatch data) ([Stockwatch](https://www.stockwatch.pl/gpw/QUANTUM,akcjonariat,dane-finansowe.aspx)).
thesis.red_flags: Possible delisting / takeover: Parkiet reports Quantum Software 'may disappear from the exchange' and that the lead shareholder does not rule out a majority investor or selling its stake; a tender for up to ~73 thousand shares at PLN 38 ran 27 Aug - 24 Sep ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/technologie/art45124001-quantum-software-moze-zniknac-z-gieldy-jakie-sa-scenariusze)). Controlling-holder dynamics: Quantum Assets holds ~71% of capital with privileged registered shares, leaving minorities little influence. Limited free float and liquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Tomasz Hatala is the main shareholder directly and via Quantum Assets; board members Ozog, Jedra, Mnich are also significant holders (older undated source) ([Value at Risk](https://valueatrisk.substack.com/p/wsparcie-procesow-logistycznych-i)); Quantum Assets holds ~71.1% of capital ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/technologie/art45124001-quantum-software-moze-zniknac-z-gieldy-jakie-sa-scenariusze)).

thesis.business_description: Nordic consumer health company selling branded natural health products/supplements through retail and online; H1 2026 net sales were SEK 296.2m (+3.3%) with net profit SEK 4.4m ([Inderes/New Nordic Q2 2026](https://www.inderes.se/en/releases/new-nordic-healthbrands-ab-publ-interim-report-q2-january-june-2026)); markets are the Nordics with Norway currently difficult.
thesis.competitive_position: Established Nordic brand owner exposed to Nordic retail channels; the Q1 2026 report says the Norwegian market is expected to stay challenging while the other Nordic markets look positive ([Q1 2026 report](https://news.bequoted.com/newsroom/new-nordic/pressreleases/interim-report-q1-2026-22706/)). Restructuring at the LIFE health food retail chain in Norway has caused further losses for New Nordic (Q2 2026 report), indicating channel concentration; management expects the New Nordic Extracts initiative to contribute positively to earnings in 2027 ([Q3 2026 report](https://www.placera.se/telegram/avanza/2_d562ad6d-4357-496e-aa19-38d946315997.html)). Moat is brand-based and modest.
thesis.main_shareholders: Nomination committee holders Marinus Blabjerg Sorensen (Fjord Capital ApS), Niclas Johansson and Alexandre Pergament (Vitalco S.A.) plus CEO Karl Kristian Bergman Jensen's Vaccinium Holding ApS represent about 80% of votes ([Inderes, valberedning 2026](https://www.inderes.se/en/releases/new-nordics-valberedning-infor-arsstamma-2026)). Older Affarsvarlden-reported ownership tables showed Vaccinium Holding ApS about 38.1% (2023) and Marinus Blabjerg Sorensen about 37.4% (2022) ([Affarsvarlden](https://www.affarsvarlden.se/aktie/new-nordic-healthbrands)); current per-holder percentages not verified.
thesis.red_flags: Very concentrated ownership (~80% of votes with nomination-committee holders), implying small free float ([Inderes](https://www.inderes.se/en/releases/new-nordics-valberedning-infor-arsstamma-2026)). Norwegian market weakness and LIFE retailer restructuring losses; Q1 2026 was a loss before H1 turned to SEK 4.4m profit ([Q2 2026](https://www.inderes.se/en/releases/new-nordic-healthbrands-ab-publ-interim-report-q2-january-june-2026)). Earnings relief from New Nordic Extracts not expected until 2027.
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Karl Kristian Bergman Jensen via Vaccinium Holding ApS (about 38.1% in 2023, dated) and chairman Marinus Blabjerg Sorensen via Fjord Capital ApS (about 37.4% in 2022, dated) ([Affarsvarlden](https://www.affarsvarlden.se/aktie/new-nordic-healthbrands)).

thesis.business_description: Websolute S.p.A. (Pesaro, Italy) is the only Italian digital agency listed on Euronext Growth Milan; it provides digital marketing, e-commerce, web and AI-based services to over 700 active clients, mostly medium-to-large Italian companies and national branches of multinationals ([Websolute overview](https://websolute.com/oven/attachment/19.%20WEBSOLUTE.pdf)). 2025 consolidated production value was EUR 22.8m (2024: EUR 24.1m) ([FY2025 press release](https://www.websolute.com/oven/attachment/2026%2003%2031%20WEBSOLUTE%20-%20CS%20CDA%20FY%202025_def_.pdf)).
thesis.competitive_position: Mid-sized Italian digital agency with notable clients (Segafredo, Carrefour, Fondazione Lega del Filo d'Oro on generative-AI projects) per [Trend-Online](https://www.trend-online.com/2026/06/12/migliori-agenzie-di-marketing-italiane-del-2026/); competes with global and boutique agencies, so no strong moat beyond client relationships. 2025 group result swung to a loss of EUR 661,538 attributable to the group (2024: profit EUR 499,998); a 2026-2028 industrial plan was approved ([filing](https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-04/20260430_183277.pdf)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Dec 2022 filings: Lyra S.r.l. (Lamberto Mattioli) 19.91%, W S.r.l. (Claudio Tonti) 17.97%, Innovative-RFK S.p.A. 12.21% ([emarketstorage](https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2022-12/20221212_123670.pdf)); treasury shares 10.22% as of Aug 2025 ([Websolute buyback notice](https://www.websolute.com/oven/attachment/2025%20Websolute%20-%20CS%20ACQUISTO%20AZIONI%20PROPRIE%2018_08_22_08%20diffuso%20il%2022_08_2025.pdf)). Holdings are dated; current register not retrieved.
thesis.red_flags: Group net loss in 2025 (EUR 0.66m) and declining production value; ongoing share buyback with treasury stock at 10.2% reduces free float ([buyback notice](https://www.websolute.com/oven/attachment/2025%20Websolute%20-%20CS%20ACQUISTO%20AZIONI%20PROPRIE%2018_08_22_08%20diffuso%20il%2022_08_2025.pdf)); founder/blockholder concentration (about 50% across three holders in 2022); a sharp share-price sell-off was reported by [Borsainside](https://www.borsainside.com/news/crollo-monstre-per-le-azioni-websolute-cosa-sta-succedendo-e-perche-e-sell-off/) (date not verified).
thesis.insider_ownership: Chairman Lamberto Mattioli via Lyra S.r.l. 19.91% and director Claudio Tonti via W S.r.l. 17.97% (Dec 2022, dated) ([emarketstorage](https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2022-12/20221212_123670.pdf)).

thesis.business_description: Greek distributor of diagnostic instruments, reagents and laboratory/clinical-research equipment (Medicon Hellas S.A., HQ Gerakas, Attica), serving hospitals and clinical and research labs in Greece. Revenue about EUR 18M.
thesis.competitive_position: Describes itself as a market leader in Greek diagnostics, supplying instruments, tests and procedures to clinical and research laboratories ([Medicon company profile](https://mediconsa.com/en/company-profile)). It is a distributor, so its position rests on supplier agreements and service relationships rather than proprietary technology; no strong moat evident. 2024 revenue was ~EUR 18.1M with net income ~EUR 1.37M and about 4.42M shares ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/ath/MEDIC/)); 2025 interim sales were EUR 17.954M vs EUR 18.375M, a decline ([financialreports.eu](https://financialreports.eu/filings/medicon-hellas-sa/interim-quarterly-report/2026/39117566/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Revenue softening (EUR 17.95M vs EUR 18.38M) ([financialreports.eu](https://financialreports.eu/filings/medicon-hellas-sa/interim-quarterly-report/2026/39117566/)). Concentrated ownership: AGM of 30 June 2026 had 66.5% of capital voting, consistent with a controlling block and limited free float ([Euronext Athens filing](https://athens.euronext.com/sites/default/files/hermes_3/2026-06/el/c6bb3c28-2298-42f2-bb3c-28229872f22d/873_4854_2026_Greek_1.pdf)). Dependence on public-hospital customers and Greek payment cycles not verified in sources found. Thin liquidity (market cap ~EUR 10-12M).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: French company (HQ Corbas, near Lyon) distributing vaping products (e-liquids, devices) in France, listed on Euronext Growth Paris since June 2021; describes itself as a reference player in vaping product distribution.
thesis.competitive_position: One of the French vaping distributors, positioned as a reference player in the segment in a shrinking, heavily regulated market; 2025 revenue was EUR 57.5M (-5.2% vs EUR 60.7M), net profit EUR 1.0M, EBITDA down 38% to EUR 2.5M (4.4% of sales) ([Kumulus Vape results](https://groupe.kumulusvape.fr/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/CP-Resultats-2025_vDef.pdf), [Boursorama](https://www.boursorama.com/bourse/actualites-amp/kumulus-vape-ca-2025-a-57-4-m-eur-kumulus-vape-resiste-dans-un-contexte-de-forte-adversite-et-prepare-son-rebond-d16f3374e1017737e8d183ef65c0c71d)). Gross financial debt EUR 3.5M vs cash EUR 5.2M at 31 Dec 2025. Brand and distribution network are the only moat; no pricing power evident.
thesis.main_shareholders: Founder Remi Baert (CEO), Astrid Menut and Rokh Vision were the main selling shareholders at the 2021 IPO ([Euronext](https://www.euronext.com/fr/about/media/euronext-press-releases/kumulus-vape-sintroduit-en-bourse-sur-euronext-growth-paris)); current percentages not retrieved.
thesis.red_flags: Regulatory risk for vaping in France (the company cites persistent regulatory uncertainty and weak consumption) ([Boursorama](https://www.boursorama.com/bourse/actualites-amp/kumulus-vape-ca-2025-a-57-4-m-eur-kumulus-vape-resiste-dans-un-contexte-de-forte-adversite-et-prepare-son-rebond-d16f3374e1017737e8d183ef65c0c71d)); falling profitability (net profit down from EUR 2.6M in 2024 to EUR 1.0M; dividend cut to EUR 0.10) ([BourseDirect](https://www.boursedirect.fr/fr/actualites/categorie/resultats/kumulus-vape-le-benefice-tombe-a-1-me-en-2025-dividende-ramene-a-0-10e-boursier-76a4c23d9ee6b383de384134305664b760b309ac)); founder-led governance; a September 2025 off-market block buyback of 289,631 shares from a historic shareholder at EUR 3.6271 (EUR 1.05M) ([Kumulus Vape](https://groupe.kumulusvape.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Copie-de-Rachat-bloc.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder and CEO Remi Baert is a main shareholder; exact % not retrieved ([Euronext](https://www.euronext.com/fr/about/media/euronext-press-releases/kumulus-vape-sintroduit-en-bourse-sur-euronext-growth-paris)).

thesis.business_description: Biogened S.A. (Łódź, Poland) is a pharmaceutical and dermocosmetics company selling prescription and OTC medicines, dietary supplements and pharmacy-channel dermocosmetics (Dermedic brand), mainly in Poland.
thesis.competitive_position: Mid-sized Polish pharmacy-channel player in a crowded generics/dermocosmetics market; differentiation rests on the Dermedic brand and partly patent-protected formulas, with no evident structural moat ([Stockanalysis company profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/BGD/company); [Biogened profile at Gemini.pl](https://gemini.pl/producent/biogened)). Reported 2024 revenue was about PLN 110.9m, up about 16% ([Stockanalysis revenue](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/BGD/revenue/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Bioniq Limited 400,000 shares = 16.28% of 2,456,319 shares, with other named holders 144,714 shares = 5.89%, per the Q4 2025 quarterly report ([Biogened Q4 2025 report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/1185_20260216_124600_Raport-Kwartalny-za-4Q2025.pdf)); full list not verified.
thesis.red_flags: Very small free float (reported 5.89%) and concentrated register imply thin liquidity; market-listing venue is reported inconsistently (WSE main vs NewConnect) across data vendors ([Bankier shareholders page](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/new-connect/BIOGENED/akcjonariat)). Share count/market cap in the input appears inconsistent with the reported 2,456,319 shares and should be verified.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Paphos Stone C Estates Plc (Cyprus Stock Exchange) owns and manages the 5-star Asimina Suites Hotel in Yeroskipou, Paphos, Cyprus; it is a subsidiary of Constantinou Bros Hotels Public Company Limited.
thesis.competitive_position: Single-asset hotel owner in the Paphos tourism market with no scale or pricing power beyond its property, relying on the Constantinou Bros group for management ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/cy/consumer-services/cse-stone/paphos-stone-c-estates-shares)). 4,690,000 shares in issue; market cap about EUR 10.0m at EUR 2.14 ([Stockopedia](https://www.stockopedia.com/share-prices/paphos-stone-c-estates-CSE:STONE)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Constantinou Bros Hotels Public Company Limited (parent; percentage not seen in search results) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/cy/consumer-services/cse-stone/paphos-stone-c-estates-shares)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling-parent dynamics and related-party dealings with Constantinou Bros group; very thin trading (TradingView shows no trades) ([Stockopedia](https://www.stockopedia.com/share-prices/paphos-stone-c-estates-CSE:STONE)); single-asset seasonal tourism exposure.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Logismos Information Systems S.A. (Pylaia, Thessaloniki, Greece; founded 1986, ATHEX-listed since March 2003) is an integrator of information systems and IT solutions.
thesis.competitive_position: Small regional Greek IT systems integrator with ATHEX listing since 2003 ([ATHEX](https://athexgroup.gr/stock-company-profile/-/select-stock/949)); no evident scale moat versus larger Greek integrators, and a small free float given concentrated holdings. The company bought back own shares via Eurobank Equities in Nov 2025 ([ATHEX](https://athens.euronext.com/sites/default/files/hermes_3/2025-11/el/4b7a38f5-a08b-4d11-ba38-f5a08b2d1175/953_8213_2025_Greek_1.pdf)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Concentrated ownership: top 3 holders own 59.11% per Simply Wall St (undated) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gr/software/ath-logismos/logismos-information-systems-shares/ownership)), limiting free float and creating controlling-holder dynamics; share count only about 4.72m. No auditor qualification seen in sources.
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders about 59% in aggregate per Simply Wall St (undated) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gr/software/ath-logismos/logismos-information-systems-shares/ownership))

thesis.business_description: S.C. Bermas S.A. (Suceava, Romania) brews and sells beer on the Romanian domestic market, with beer about 99% of sales and main brands Bermas Pils (11.5 Plato) and Solca (11 Plato).
thesis.competitive_position: Small regional Romanian brewer competing against multinational brewers; no evident moat beyond local brands and distribution. 2025 net turnover was RON 39.69m (-0.67% y/y) and the company reports its full 2026 beer output already contracted for sale ([Bermas Annual Report 2025](https://bvb.ro/infocont/infocont26/BRM_20260318080306_Raport-anual-2025.pdf)). 2024 net profit was RON 1.6m, up 41.7% ([ZF](https://www.zf.ro/burse-fonduri-mutuale/bursa-bermas-a-incheiat-anul-trecut-cu-o-crestere-de-42-pe-profit-si-22773547)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Asociatia Victoria Bermas about 30.87%; Asociatia PAS Bermas about 20.8%; Vivat Construct about 13.6%, per BVB/Bursa.ro shareholder data as of September 2025 ([Bermas Annual Report 2025](https://bvb.ro/infocont/infocont26/BRM_20260318080306_Raport-anual-2025.pdf); [Bursa.ro](https://www.bursa.ro/bermas-va-distribui-catre-actionari-aproape-tot-profitul-anului-trecut-42705947)); 2026 register not verified.
thesis.red_flags: Single-product concentration (beer ~99% of sales) and demand weakness from July 2025 noted in the annual report ([Annual Report 2025](https://bvb.ro/infocont/infocont26/BRM_20260318080306_Raport-anual-2025.pdf)); H1 2025 showed a loss of RON 0.16m ([Bursa.ro](https://www.bursa.ro/bermas-loss-of-016-million-lei-in-the-first-half-lower-than-that-of-january-june-2024-48977652)); the register is dominated by two associations plus one company holder (about 65% combined), limiting free float; the company previously ran a buyback of up to 10% of shares ([Bursa.ro](https://www.bursa.ro/bermas-vrea-sa-si-rascumpere-10-procente-din-actiuni-de-pe-bursa-si-sa-ia-credite-de-cel-mult-6-milioane-lei-8216649)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Qwamplify (Levallois-Perret, France; Euronext Growth Paris) is a digital marketing and media agency group; it sold its Nordic subsidiaries (effective 1 July 2025) and its Qwamplify Pro activity (effective 1 January 2026).
thesis.competitive_position: Mid-sized French digital-marketing/media agency with no scale moat and a shrinking perimeter: 2025 revenue was EUR 27.1M, down 18% (down 14% like-for-like), with operating income of EUR 0.99M after impairment and net cash of EUR 5.8M ([ABCBourse](https://www.abcbourse.com/marches/qwamplify--resultats-annuels-2025-chiffre-d-affaires-et-marge-brute-t1-2026-vd_695515), [ABCBourse](https://www.abcbourse.com/marches/qwamplify-reste-rentable-en-2025-et-propose-un-dividende-malgre-un-debut-2026-di_695545)). Q3 2026 revenue was EUR 5.6M, down 2.5% like-for-like ([ABCBourse](https://www.abcbourse.com/marches/qwamplify-annonce-un-chiffre-daffaires-t3-2026-de-5-6-m-et-une-marge-brute-de_704525)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Revenue decline of 18% in 2025 after disposals ([ABCBourse](https://www.abcbourse.com/marches/qwamplify--resultats-annuels-2025-chiffre-d-affaires-et-marge-brute-t1-2026-vd_695515)); treasury shares at 9.97% of capital after buybacks (Sept 2025 release) ([ABCBourse](https://www.abcbourse.com/marches/qwamplify--resultats-s1-2025_674735)); founder-led (Cédric Reny) with Eiffel Investment Group named as a main shareholder in a 2019 AMF filing, current stakes not verified ([AMF filing 2019](https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/AMF/ACT/2019/12/FCACT049492_20191220.pdf)); Euronext Growth liquidity; reported share-count figures conflict across filings (5.68M vs 17.5M).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (founder and CEO Cédric Reny; stake not retrieved).

thesis.business_description: Birmingham, UK manufacturer and distributor of luxury bathroom fittings and architectural ironmongery, selling to UK and international (including US) customers from a single UK facility; AIM-listed.
thesis.competitive_position: Closely held luxury-niche manufacturer with a premium brand and UK production but small scale (revenue about GBP 14.8M) and exposed to UK property-market and US tariff conditions ([Samuel Heath annual report FY2025](https://www.samuel-heath.com/app/uploads/sites/3/2025/09/Annual_Report_and_Accounts_Yr_ended_31-03-25.pdf); [Demystified Value](https://demystifiedvalue.substack.com/p/samuel-heath-and-sons-plc-hsm-a-nano)). FY to 31 Mar 2026 revenue was flat at GBP 14.826M (GBP 14.769M FY2025), with US tariffs passed on to customers and a tougher second half; the full-year dividend was held at 13.0625p ([Investegate RNS](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/heath-samuel-sons--hsm/final-results-notice-of-agm-dividend/9689942)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Per the company's AIM Rule 26 page (Feb 2025): Samuel Heath Discretionary Will Trust about 18% (455,800 shares); C A Heath 14.94% (378,710 shares); G S Heath 14.94% (378,710 shares); earlier version also listed VOB&T UK Limited 12.21% and S A Perkins (nee Heath) 10.76% ([Samuel Heath investor relations](https://samuel-heath.com/investor-relations/director-and-significant-shareholdings)).
thesis.red_flags: Family-concentrated register (Heath family trust and individuals hold well over half) with limited free float and liquidity ([Samuel Heath investor relations](https://samuel-heath.com/investor-relations/director-and-significant-shareholdings)). Profitability volatile: a tougher second half in FY2026 with RNS profit for the year of GBP 204k versus GBP 888k, while a press report cites a higher pre-tax figure, so the numbers conflict ([Investegate RNS](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/heath-samuel-sons--hsm/final-results-notice-of-agm-dividend/9689942)). Exposure to US tariffs and UK taxation changes affecting international clients. Single-site operations.
thesis.insider_ownership: Heath family holdings through the Samuel Heath Discretionary Will Trust (about 18%) and individuals C A Heath and G S Heath (14.94% each); A R Buttanshaw (chair) is a trustee of the trust ([Samuel Heath investor relations](https://samuel-heath.com/investor-relations/director-and-significant-shareholdings)).

thesis.business_description: Romanian river-transport and ship-repair company based in Braila on the Danube (founded 1903), listed on the Bucharest Stock Exchange main market under BRNA.
thesis.competitive_position: Small Danube transport/shipyard operator in a cyclical, capital-intensive niche with no evident moat beyond its Braila yard and fleet. Results swung sharply: net loss of RON 16.08M for 2025 vs a profit of RON 96,656 in 2024 ([2025 annual report](https://www.bvb.ro/info/Raportari/BRNA/BRNA_20260319133617_2025-Raport-anual-Romnav-SA.pdf)); the H1 2025 loss was RON 11.74M vs a RON 6.58M profit a year earlier ([BVB H1 2026 report listing](https://m.bvb.ro/FinancialInstruments/SelectedData/NewsItem/BRNA-Raport-semestrial-S1-2026/2C0BE)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Net loss of RON 16.08M in 2025 versus a RON 96,656 profit in 2024 ([2025 annual report](https://www.bvb.ro/info/Raportari/BRNA/BRNA_20260319133617_2025-Raport-anual-Romnav-SA.pdf)), i.e. a large swing relative to the very small market cap. At the 2024 AGM shareholders present held 80.77% of capital, suggesting a concentrated holder base, though holders are not named in the retrieved text ([BVB AGOA resolution](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/BRNA/BRNA_20240416083432_RC-hotarare-AGOA.pdf)). Thin liquidity on BVB.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Triboo S.p.A. (Euronext Milan) is an Italian digital company in e-commerce, digital marketing and integrated communication services.
thesis.competitive_position: Mid/small Italian digital services group that in 2025 shrank its operating perimeter by closing less profitable partnerships and improved margins ([FinanzaOnline](https://www.finanzaonline.com/?p=778339)); no durable moat evident in outsourced e-commerce/marketing services. Net debt was EUR 16.4m ([Teleborsa](https://www.teleborsa.it/News/2026/06/01/triboo-l-assemblea-approva-il-bilancio-2025-e-nomina-il-cda-3.html)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Net debt EUR 16.4m against a small market cap; business perimeter being reduced; new board appointed at the 29 May 2026 AGM, mandate to the 2026 accounts ([Teleborsa](https://www.teleborsa.it/News/2026/06/01/triboo-l-assemblea-approva-il-bilancio-2025-e-nomina-il-cda-3.html)). A buyback of up to 2% was approved ([FinanzaOnline](https://www.finanzaonline.com/notizie/triboo-cda-delibera-avvio-programma-di-acquisto-azioni-proprie-per-massimo-il-2-del-capitale)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Norofert S.A. (Romania) produces biofertilizers/organic agricultural inputs and has grown US operations, which drove 2025 profit growth; listed on BVB AeRO since 3 March 2020.
thesis.competitive_position: Niche Romanian biofertilizer producer with expansion in the US ([Bursa.ro](https://www.bursa.ro/norofert-388222profit-in-crestere-in-2025-pe-fondul-operatiunilor-din-sua388221-09837850)); no demonstrated moat beyond product and founder-led execution, and growth is funded by bonds and equity raises: a RON 15m bond programme in Dec 2024 ([Romania Insider](https://www.romania-insider.com/business/norofert-bond-bucharest-exchange-december-2024)), RON 7m new bonds in Jan 2025 ([Business Forum](https://www.businessforum.ro/finance/20250127/norofert-issues-a-new-set-of-bonds-worth-ron-7-million-1326)) and a planned RON 9m share capital increase reported in Feb 2026.
thesis.main_shareholders: Vlad-Andrei Popescu (chairman/CEO) shown at 31.38% (6.54m shares) on a market-data page, undated and with a share base that may be outdated ([Primet](https://www.primet.ro/informatii-piata-cotatii-bursa?simbol=nrf)); at the 2020 listing: Popescu 38.69%, Ileana Popescu 20.79%, Marian Marius Alexe 10.24% ([Financial Intelligence](https://financialintelligence.ro/actiunile-norofert-intra-la-tranzactionare-pe-smt-piata-aero/); dated). April 2026 AGM: holders of 11,051,237 shares (52.98% of capital) voted ([BVB report 25/2026](https://www.bvb.ro/info/Raportari/NRF/NRF_20260429155435_RO-NRF-Raport-Curent-25-2026.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: GEM Global Yield LLC SCS signed a share purchase agreement (27 Jul 2026) allowing it to buy NRF shares from chairman Popescu up to USD 15m over three years, a potential overhang ([BVB report 35/2026](https://www.bvb.ro/info/Raportari/NRF/NRF_20260727085027_EN-NRF-Current-Report-35-2026.pdf)); leverage via multiple bond issues (NRF25, NRF29) and shareholder loans (Popescu RON 1.7m interest-free loan due 18 May 2027, BVB report 25/2026); founder-controlled with share-count inconsistencies between reports (17.38m shares in March 2026 vs about 20.9m implied by the April 2026 AGM).
thesis.insider_ownership: Vlad-Andrei Popescu (founder/chairman) about 31-39% depending on date (see above); 2020 listing also named Ileana Popescu 20.79%.

thesis.business_description: Operator of the Lithuanian crematorium (Lietuvos krematoriumas) in Kedainiai, Lithuania, listed on Nasdaq Vilnius since 2015; also owned funeral-service assets (sold end-2025).
thesis.competitive_position: Operates what Baltic press describes as the country's only crematorium, giving it a niche position with high local barriers (permitting, capex), though revenue is flat at about EUR 1.9M ([Baltic Times](https://www.baltictimes.com/lithuanian_firm_to_invest_heavily_in_country_s_only_crematorium); [Scoris](https://scoris.lt/en/imone/301950535)). 2025 revenue was EUR 1.86M (-3%); at end-2025 UAB Rekviem LT and the Kaunas farewell-home building were sold for a total of EUR 4M ([audited 2025 results](https://www.finanznachrichten.de/nachrichten-2026-03/67961719-k2-lt-audited-financial-statements-for-the-year-2025-399.htm)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Very small and illiquid company (about 311.8k shares) with flat revenue; board member Vidas Andrikis sold his entire stake and left the board effective 31 Dec 2024 ([MarketScreener](https://ca.marketscreener.com/insider/VIDAS-ANDRIKIS-A2CURN/experience/)); end-2025 disposal of funeral-service business reduces diversification ([audited 2025 results](https://www.finanznachrichten.de/nachrichten-2026-03/67961719-k2-lt-audited-financial-statements-for-the-year-2025-399.htm)). Single-site operating dependence.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Przedsiebiorstwo Hydrauliki Silowej HYDROTOR S.A. (Tuchola, Poland, est. 1945) produces and regenerates power hydraulics components, mainly hydraulic cylinders (about half of 2023 sales) and pumps, for agricultural, municipal and transport machinery makers; subsidiary Agromet ZEHS Luban also makes cylinders.
thesis.competitive_position: Mid-sized Polish hydraulic cylinder manufacturer serving OEMs in agricultural machinery, municipal and transport equipment ([Biznesradar/StockAnalysis profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/HDR/company/)); cylinders were 49.7% of 2023 sales and pumps about 14% ([Marketscreener](https://in.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/PRZEDSIEBIORSTWO-HYDRAULI-11193970/company/)). Moat is long OEM relationships and in-house production/regeneration capability, but the business is cyclical and exposed to farm-machinery demand; revenue fell 12.5% to PLN 110.0m in 2024 ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/HDR/revenue/)) and was about PLN 114.9m in 2025 per an aggregator ([AlphaSpread](https://www.alphaspread.com/security/wse/hdr/financials/income-statement/revenue)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Mariusz Lewicki 17.9%, Ryszard Bodziachowski 16.9%, GAMMA PKO TFI SA (fund) 15.1% per Simply Wall St (undated) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/capital-goods/wse-hdr/przedsiebiorstwo-hydrauliki-silowej-hydrotor-shares/ownership)); AGM lists of shareholders above 5% are published as ESPI notices ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art26697321-hydrotor-zwza-26-06-2021-r-lista-akcjonariuszy-powyzej-5)).
thesis.red_flags: Cyclical end-market (agricultural/municipal machinery) with revenue down 12.5% in 2024 ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/HDR/revenue/)); management dividend recommendation was cut to the lowest since 2011 in an earlier year ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/90873,zarzad-hydrotor-rekomenduje-najnizsza-dywidende-od-2011-r)). Concentrated holder group (three holders ~50%) limits free float. No going-concern or auditor qualification seen in sources.
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Mariusz Lewicki 17.9% and Ryszard Bodziachowski 16.9% per Simply Wall St (undated) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/capital-goods/wse-hdr/przedsiebiorstwo-hydrauliki-silowej-hydrotor-shares/ownership)); Lewicki listed as CEO on Biznesradar ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/wiadomosci/HDR)).

name: Société Française de Casinos Société Anonyme

thesis.business_description: French casino operator listed on Euronext Paris; its casinos are located at Gruissan (with hotel), Port-la-Nouvelle, Chatel-Guyon and Collioure, plus related hotel/restaurant activity.
thesis.competitive_position: Small regional operator of licensed casinos in southern/central France; the moat is local gaming licences and regional catchment rather than scale. For the year ended 31 October 2025, gross consolidated revenue was EUR 22.41M (EUR 22.92M in 2024), group net profit EUR 1.105M (EUR 1.359M) and EBITDA EUR 2.96M (13.2% margin) ([Bourse Direct](https://www.boursedirect.fr/fr/actualites/categorie/chiffre-d-affaires/societe-francaise-de-casinos-beneficiaire-de-1-11-me-sur-l-exercice-boursier-c94eb08d9f3eb7549592b7bb098b371ded23ba40); [ABC Bourse](https://www.abcbourse.com/marches/resultats-annuels-2024-2025_690509)).
thesis.main_shareholders: SAS Casigrangi (Groupe Philippe Ginestet / Stelsia Casino group) held 81.21% of SFC's capital per the 2022 annual report; it took control with 75.07% in December 2020 ([World Casino Directory](https://news.worldcasinodirectory.com/groupe-philippe-ginestet-subordinate-completes-sfc-acquisition-90871); [European Gaming](https://europeangaming.eu/portal/latest-news/2021/01/12/84495/casigrangi-completes-purchase-of-75-stake-in-sfc/)).
thesis.red_flags: Pending change of control: a September 2026 report says Merkur.com AG signed a final agreement for 95% of Casigrangi (from Groupe Philippe Ginestet and DOFA, at EUR 6.19 per SFC share), with DOFA keeping 5% under put/call options ([SCCG Management](https://sccgmanagement.com/sccg-articles/2026/09/21/merkur-signs-final-agreement-for-95-percent-stake-in-casigrangi-to-control-societe-francaise-de-casinos/)); controlling holder with about 81% leaves a very small free float; casino licensing/regulatory dependence; FY2025 net profit declined about 19%.
thesis.insider_ownership: Controlling holder Casigrangi (Groupe Philippe Ginestet) 81.21% per the 2022 annual report ([World Casino Directory](https://news.worldcasinodirectory.com/groupe-philippe-ginestet-subordinate-completes-sfc-acquisition-90871)); current management holdings not disclosed.

thesis.business_description: French small-cap (Euronext Growth Paris, ISIN FR0010654087) whose revenue comes mainly from thermal-printing activities plus bakery-equipment/dough-automation interests; the solenoid-valve and cylinder activity was permanently stopped on 30 April 2025.
thesis.competitive_position: Niche industrial/equipment supplier with shrinking activity and no demonstrated moat: 2025 consolidated revenue was about EUR 6.1M (-39%) with an operating loss of EUR 348k vs a EUR 1.11M profit in 2024 ([Bourse Direct](https://www.boursedirect.fr/fr/actualites/categorie/resultats/txcom-cale-en-2025-pas-de-dividende-boursier-6d4092bfad6c24ca531ecb6299a9e0999a1fdf96)); management expects a further decline of about 50% in parent-company sales in H1 2026 ([Bourse Direct](https://www.boursedirect.fr/fr/actualites/categorie/resultats/txcom-les-comptes-virent-au-rouge-la-contraction-d-activite-va-se-poursuivre-boursier-bd70c21b91993b61ac58f4d71bd5c773690d20f6)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Kitis 70.44% with a free float of 29.56% ([Ideal Investisseur](https://www.ideal-investisseur.fr/actions/txcom-FR0010654087-societe.html)); about 1,231,860 shares outstanding ([TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/fr:altxc/statistics)).
thesis.red_flags: Sharp revenue and profit deterioration with guided further decline in H1 2026 and no dividend for 2025 ([Bourse Direct](https://www.boursedirect.fr/fr/actualites/categorie/resultats/txcom-cale-en-2025-pas-de-dividende-boursier-6d4092bfad6c24ca531ecb6299a9e0999a1fdf96)); bakery subsidiary BCR was placed in liquidation at 30 September 2025 and the valves business was shut; controlling holder owns about 70% leaving a small float; governance reshuffle in September 2025 (CEO Philippe Clavery resigned as chairman, succeeded by Killian Clavery) ([Euronext](https://live.euronext.com/fr/products/equities/company-news/2025-09-05-evolution-gouvernance-txcom)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Romanian manufacturer (Targu Mures / Sangeorgiu de Mures) of induction heating equipment for surface hardening, forging pre-heating, melting and dedicated heating solutions; sells mainly to export markets (Germany, France, Hungary, Tunisia, Scandinavia, Mexico, others).
thesis.competitive_position: Niche industrial engineering manufacturer of induction heating systems, founded by engineers from ICPE Bucharest's Targu Mures branch and listed on BVB since June 2017 ([Transylvania Now](https://transylvanianow.com/designed-and-built-in-transylvania-used-by-factories-worldwide/)). Competes against larger European induction-heating specialists (e.g. EMA Indutec, Rayteq per CB Insights peer lists) ([CB Insights](https://www.cbinsights.com/company/aages-targu-mures/alternatives-competitors)); moat is engineering know-how and customised systems rather than scale. FY2024 revenue was RON 58.5M (+27%) per Simply Wall St, while trailing figures later show revenue ~RON 43.5M and net income down ~71% ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/AAG/), [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/ro/capital-goods/bvb-aag/sc-aages-shares/news/sc-aages-full-year-2024-earnings-eps-ron113-vs-ron067-in-fy)).
thesis.main_shareholders: AAGES Head Invest SRL (controlled by Gabor Molnar) ~55% ([ZF](https://www.zf.ro/burse-fonduri-mutuale/aages-targu-mures-plus-6-5-joi-pe-fondul-unui-profit-de-3-2-mil-lei-20246337)); Gabor Jozsef Molnar directly ~10.55% and Sytec Finance GmbH ~5%, RCC Consult ~4% (older IPO-era breakdown, may be outdated) ([Profit.ro](https://profit.ro/povesti-cu-profit/financiar/piata-de-capital/exclusiv-aages-intra-astazi-la-tranzactionare-cum-arata-emitentul-si-ce-planuri-are-actionarul-majoritar-17041332)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlled by a majority holder (~55% via Head Invest) so minority holders have limited influence. Earnings volatility: trailing net income down ~71% YoY per StockAnalysis ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/AAG/)). Cyclical, export-dependent industrial demand; no data found on customer concentration. Thinly traded BVB micro-cap.
thesis.insider_ownership: Gabor Molnar controls ~55% through AAGES Head Invest SRL plus ~10.55% directly (older breakdown) ([ZF](https://www.zf.ro/burse-fonduri-mutuale/aages-targu-mures-plus-6-5-joi-pe-fondul-unui-profit-de-3-2-mil-lei-20246337)); 2026 AGM report notes Molnar and Doki Janos Tibor abstaining on 971,822 shares (9.72%) ([BVB](https://bvb.ro/infocont/infocont26/AAG_20260527142948_Raportul-curent-pentru-Hot-AGA-din-27-05-2026.pdf)).

thesis.business_description: Kesla Oyj (Joensuu, Finland; founded 1960) makes forestry cranes and machine attachments for forestry and material handling, sold in Finland and internationally; it launched a Kesla Defence product line in January 2025.
thesis.competitive_position: Small Finnish niche manufacturer; 2025 net sales were EUR 34.4M versus EUR 44.3M in 2024 and operating profit was negative ([Kesla 2025 annual report release](https://mb.cision.com/Public/22458/4334931/ba50b554e43822d9.pdf)). It discontinued its wood chipper group (rights sold in December 2025) and plans to divest the tractor attachment group to focus on Kesla Defence ([Cision](https://news.cision.com/kesla-oyj/r/kesla-sells-the-product-rights-of-its-previously-discontinued-wood-chipper-product-group-to-lithuani,c4284557)). Cyclical forestry demand and no evidenced scale moat.
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Operating loss in 2025 and repeated guidance cuts ([Inderes forum](https://forum.inderes.com/t/kesla-porssin-potentiaalisin-pien-yhtio/2187/115)); an Inderes Q4'25 note headline refers to financing concerns ([Inderes](https://www.inderes.dk/research/kesla-q425-forsvar-lysner-udsigterne-men-finansiering-bekymrer)). 2026 guidance: net sales EUR 38-45M with operating margin between -2% and +2% ([Inderes](https://www.inderes.dk/research/kesla-q425-forsvar-lysner-udsigterne-men-finansiering-bekymrer)). Product-group divestments add execution risk; small market cap (about EUR 8-10M) limits liquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders about 37.3% of shares per category breakdown on Simply Wall St (names not given) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/fi/capital-goods/hel-kelas/kesla-oyj-shares/ownership)).

thesis.business_description: Bialystok-based industrial automation, electrical engineering and robotics contractor founded in 1993, serving energy, chemical and industrial customers; owns 100% of ELREM Sp. z o.o. (acquired 2015).
thesis.competitive_position: Regional industrial-automation integrator with references such as Grupa Azoty, PGE, Enea and Energa, so project-based revenue is tied to large Polish energy and chemical clients rather than a durable moat ([EMIS / sector profile](https://emis.cn/php/company-profile/PL/APS_SA_en_2432228.html); [Automatyka Online](https://automatykaonline.pl/en/Articles/Services/20-lat-innowacji-firmy-APS)). It was one of the first Podlasie companies to debut on NewConnect. It has been recognised for innovation in the sector ([Automatyka Online](https://automatykaonline.pl/switchlanguage/to/en/Z-branzy/APS-laureatka-Innowacji-2014)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Historic Parkiet table (undated, 5,296,839 shares and 8,696,251 votes): Boguslaw Lacki about 23.24% of votes; Jerzy Buslowski and Marcin Proskien about 12.17% of votes each; Jaroslaw Skorulski about 7.96%; Piotr Krukowski about 6.40%; a more recent snapshot shows Buslowski with 540,116 shares (10.19% of capital) ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/230121-automatyka-pomiary-sterowanie)). Official 5% lists for the AGMs of 28 Jun 2024 and 27 Jun 2025 exist but were not readable ([FinancialReports](https://financialreports.eu/companies/automatyka-pomiary-sterowanie-spolka-akcyjna/)).
thesis.red_flags: Voting preference: 8.70M votes vs 5.30M shares, so founders/insiders control more votes than capital ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/230121-automatyka-pomiary-sterowanie)). Project-based revenue with exposure to large state-linked energy/chemical customers. NewConnect-listed micro-cap with thin liquidity. Ownership data is partly dated. No going-concern or auditor-qualification wording found.
thesis.insider_ownership: Founders/management-linked holders listed in Parkiet table (e.g. Jerzy Buslowski, Boguslaw Lacki, Marcin Proskien) hold roughly 12-23% of votes each, undated; exact roles not confirmed in sources found ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/230121-automatyka-pomiary-sterowanie)).

name: Koszalinskie Przedsiebiorstwo Przemyslu Drzewnego Spólka Akcyjna

thesis.business_description: Szczecinek-based Polish sawmill and wood-processing group producing sawn timber (conifer and hardwood), structural timber, glued panels, railway sleepers and briquettes, sold mainly in Poland and export markets ([KPPD 2024 management report](https://www.bankier.pl/static/att/emitent/2025-03/KPPD-Sprawozdanie-Zarzadu-za-rok-2024_202503281992660879.xhtml)).
thesis.competitive_position: Regional sawmill and glued-panel producer that originated from a state-owned enterprise privatised in the 1990s ([KPPD 2020 management report](https://www.bankier.pl/static/att/emitent/2021-03/KPPD_Sprawozdanie_Zarzadu_2020_202103221389078436.xhtml)); it is a commodity-type processor with no evident brand or technology moat and is exposed to timber-price and energy-cost cycles. The company is not the Kronospan board/MDF plant that also operates in Szczecinek (a separate group).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: The President's 2024 letter calls 2024 one of the most difficult years in the company's history and says management is working to protect liquidity ([KPPD 2024 President's letter](https://www.bankier.pl/static/att/emitent/2025-03/KPPD-List-Prezesa-2024_202503281992660879.xhtml)); cyclical commodity exposure; small market cap with limited liquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Norwegian regional savings bank (Hoeland og Setskog Sparebank, trading as HS Bank) whose equity certificates are listed on Euronext Oslo Bors (HSPG); lending is mainly residential mortgages and housing construction, with gross loans of NOK 7.5bn in Q3 2024.
thesis.competitive_position: Small local savings bank with a community franchise but no scale advantage versus large Norwegian banks; CET1 was 16.7% in Q3 2024 (16.6% a year earlier) ([Q3 2024 report](https://live.euronext.com/sites/default/files/company_press_releases/attachments_oslo/2024/10/31/630854_2024%20Q3%20Kvartalsrapport%20med%20revisjonsberetning.pdf)) and 18.56% at end-2023. Pre-provision result was NOK 18.7M in Q1 2025 vs NOK 20.1M a year earlier ([Q1 2025 report](https://www.hsbank.no/-/media/banker/hsbank/dokumenter/regnskap/2025-Q1-Kvartalsrapport.pdf)). Market cap was about NOK 117M ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/no/banks/ob-hspg/hland-og-setskog-sparebank-shares/ownership)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: The Finanstilsynet supervisory report (June 2024, based on a 2023 inspection) said the bank has had high non-performing loans and large loan losses over time ([Finanstilsynet](https://www.finanstilsynet.no/49ebb3/contentassets/69fee16587794c0b9eb9a5f461612931/tilsynsrapport-holand-og-setskog-sparebank.pdf)). Concentrated exposure to housing and construction lending. As a savings bank, equity certificate holders hold only part of total equity (the rest is primary capital/ownerless), limiting shareholder claims; tiny equity-certificate market cap implies low liquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: Administrative director John Sigurd Bjoerknes bought certificates in March 2026 and now holds 2,320 equity certificates ([MFN](https://www.mfn.se/ob/a/holand-og-setskog-sparebank/hspg-meldepliktig-handel-497c2a31)).

thesis.business_description: Katowice-based Polish contractor providing installation services in the power industry (founded 2012), including work on gas power plant projects such as a contract with Sener Bonatti CCPP GmbH.
thesis.competitive_position: Project-based power-sector installation contractor with revenue that grew 56.3% to PLN 132.4M in 2023, but lumpy, contract-dependent earnings and no durable moat ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/JWW/); [StockAnalysis company profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/JWW/company)). A 2026 filing refers to an amendment of its contract with Sener Bonatti CCPP GmbH ([Financial filings summary via StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/JWW/)). Voting structure: 14.8M votes against about 11.0M shares ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/JWWINVEST/akcjonariat)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Voting preference: 14,800,000 votes at the AGM versus about 11.0M shares, so some holders control more votes than capital ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/JWWINVEST/akcjonariat)). Lumpy revenue and counterparty/contract-amendment risk on large power-plant EPC-type contracts ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/JWW/)). Prior ESPI notices on changes to rights attached to securities ([Parkiet ESPI](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art26644961-jww-invest-s-a-informacja-o-zmianie-praw-z-papierow-wartosciowych-emitenta)). Shareholder structure could not be verified.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Transgex S.A. (Oradea, Romania) prepares geological projects and carries out deep drilling for geothermal-water and related resources across the Western Plain of Romania; it is transferring its oil and gas drilling activity (Bentec 350 AC rig) to Foraj Sonde Videle.
thesis.competitive_position: Regional drilling contractor with customer concentration risk (OMV Petrom contract disclosed in 2023, [BVB](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/TRNG/TRNG_20230614144342_Raport-curent-contract-TRNG-OMV-PETROM.pdf)). 2025 turnover RON 80.33m, down 23.22%, with net profit RON 2,050,684 ([Termene](https://termene.ro/firma/202255); [BVB AGM 21 Apr 2026](https://www.bvb.ro/info/Raportari/TRNG/TRNG_20260421153804_RC-HAGOA-21-04-2026.pdf)); H1 2025 profit RON 543,380 versus RON 1,501,467 in H1 2024 ([BVB H1 2025](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/TRNG/TRNG_20250923140935_TRNG-Raport-semestrul-I-2025.pdf)). Disposal of the drilling rig business shrinks the core.
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Disposal of the core drilling activity to Foraj Sonde S.A. Videle on a going-concern transfer, subject to EGM approval (28 Sep 2026) ([BVB](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/TRNG/TRNG_20260821121724_RC-Convocare-AGEA-28-29-09-2026.pdf)); falling revenue (-23% in 2025); multiple litigation reports filed on BVB (2022-2026, including a March 2026 ruling in FIMA vs Transgex) ([BVB](https://m.bvb.ro/info/Raportari/TRNG/TRNG_20260311160236_Raport-curent-litigiu-solutie-d-23214-271-2025-FIMA-vs-TR.pdf)); an EGM was also convened for 7 Dec 2026.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Coral Products PLC (Wythenshawe, Manchester, UK) is a plastics products manufacturer listed on AIM; in February 2026 it bought the assets of failed competitor AAC Cyroma Limited from its liquidators.
thesis.competitive_position: UK niche plastics manufacturer with order flow sensitive to consumer spending; in April 2026 it warned a proportion of expected sales had been delayed ([LSE.co.uk](https://www.lse.co.uk/news/coral-products-orders-decline-amid-reduced-consumer-spending-w575ytp4wpe15lj.html), [Stockopedia trading update](https://www.stockopedia.com/share-prices/coral-products-LON:CRU/news/reg-coral-products-plc-trading-update-urn:newsml:reuters.com:20260420:nRST1608Ba/)). No evidenced moat; the AAC Cyroma asset purchase ([Investegate](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/coral-products--cru/acquisition-of-the-assets-of-aac-cyroma-limited/9431347)) adds capacity but integration risk.
thesis.main_shareholders: Matt and Kelly Staples: aggregate beneficial interest in 6,725,000 shares per a holding notice of 3 February 2023 (latest figure found; percentage and current stake unconfirmed) ([Shares Magazine / LSE RNS](https://www.sharesmagazine.co.uk/news/market/LSE20230207114602_4667249/holdings-in-company)).
thesis.red_flags: AIM trading suspension from 7:30am on 2 November 2026 because the audit of accounts for the year ended 30 April 2026 is delayed and audited accounts cannot be published by the 31 October 2026 AIM Rule 19 deadline; company expects publication by 30 November 2026 ([Investegate RNS Temporary Suspension](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/coral-products--cru/temporary-suspension/9849137), [The Business Desk](https://www.thebusinessdesk.com/northwest/?p=2181848)). Sales delays warned in April 2026 and shares fell sharply ([LSE.co.uk](https://www.lse.co.uk/news/coral-products-orders-decline-amid-reduced-consumer-spending-w575ytp4wpe15lj.html)). Past suspensions/delays: results delayed in 2020 ([Investegate](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/coral-products--cru/extension-to-publication-of-final-results-update/6386631)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (Staples holding noted above; their role at the company was not verified in the sources).

thesis.business_description: InTiCa Systems SE (Passau, Germany) develops and manufactures inductive components (coils, transformers, chokes) for automotive/e-mobility ('Mobility') and 'Industry' customers; FY2025 group sales were about EUR 68.5m (2024: EUR 70.6m) with EBIT of EUR -1.5m ([Boerse-Online](https://www.boerse-online.de/dpa-afx/eqs-news-intica-systems-se-geschaeftsbericht-2025-veroeffentlicht-bestaetigung-der-vorlaeufigen-zahlen-deutsch-526108.html)). Mobility grew while the Industry segment declined ([Newsworthy](https://www.newsworthy.ai/curated/intica-systems-reports-2025-results-with-mobility-growth-offset/202630521)).
thesis.competitive_position: A small Tier-2 automotive supplier of customised inductive parts with an order backlog of about EUR 80.3m ([Newsworthy](https://www.newsworthy.ai/curated/intica-systems-reports-2025-results-with-mobility-growth-offset/202630521)); customer-specific design-ins give some stickiness but margins are thin and EBIT has been negative two years running (EUR -0.6m in 2024, EUR -1.5m in 2025). No strong moat evident; exposed to automotive cycle and large OEM/Tier-1 purchasing power.
thesis.main_shareholders: PRINTad Verlags-GmbH (part of Optima Group, owned by Dr Axel Diekmann) held 29.99% ([Noerr press release](https://www.noerr.com/en/press/noerr-advises-optima-group-on-takeover-offer-for-intica-systems-ag); date of release not confirmed). Simply Wall St: top 3 holders own 60.92%; private companies 55.8%, individual insiders 5.08%, general public 39.1% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/de/tech/etr-is7/intica-systems-shares/ownership)).
thesis.red_flags: Two consecutive years of negative EBIT; net loss about EUR 2.3m in 2025 (single aggregator: [FinancialFilings](https://financialfilings.com/companies/intica-systems-ag/)); cash only EUR 1.0m at end-2025 (EUR 1.9m prior) with EUR 5.5m undrawn credit lines ([Boersengefluester](https://app.boersengefluester.de/en/newswire/DE0005874846/intica-systems-se/provisional-figures-for-2025-published-revised-guidance-confirmed-2303134)); Industry segment decline; guidance had to be revised in 2025; controlling-holder dynamics (29.99% stake sits just below the 30% mandatory-offer threshold); management change (board member Bernhard Griesbeck left in 2025, [Boerse-Online](https://www.boerse-online.de/dpa-afx/eqs-news-intica-systems-se-bernhard-griesbeck-legt-sein-amt-als-mitglied-des-vorstands-nieder-deutsch-457049.html)). No going-concern wording or auditor qualification found.
thesis.insider_ownership: Simply Wall St shows individual insiders at 5.08% ([source](https://simplywall.st/stocks/de/tech/etr-is7/intica-systems-shares/ownership)); individual names not confirmed.

thesis.business_description: Opole (Poland) power-sector contractor performing construction, assembly and major overhauls at power plants and industrial facilities; contracts include a PLN 29.98m turbine-set overhaul for PGE GiEK (2023) and a PLN 128.8m boiler pressure-part assembly for two 900 MW units at Opole (2016) ([money.pl company page](https://www.money.pl/gielda/spolki-gpw/plremak00016,o_firmie.html)). H1 2026 revenue fell 35.3% y/y with a net loss of PLN 11.68m ([Comparic](https://comparic.pl/prawie-100-w-gore-na-1-sesji-wielki-wlasciciel-rusza-po-reszte-akcji-czy-gpw-straci-kolejnego-gieldowego-weterana/)).
thesis.competitive_position: Established Polish energy-construction contractor reliant on a small number of utility and industrial projects; recent results are weak with trouble on a key contract cited in coverage ([Comparic](https://comparic.pl/prawie-100-w-gore-na-1-sesji-wielki-wlasciciel-rusza-po-reszte-akcji-czy-gpw-straci-kolejnego-gieldowego-weterana/)). Controlling holder Zarmen is itself an industrial contractor (Elektrobudowa, Koksownia Czestochowa Nowa), which may bring group work but also overlap. Moat limited to qualifications and references.
thesis.main_shareholders: Zarmen sp. z o.o. 1,548,594 shares, 51.62% of shares and votes (as listed 17 Aug 2026) ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/notowania/spolki/PLREMAK00016/akcjonariat)); OFE PZU 'Zlota Jesien' 13.40% and Allianz Polska OFE 7.89%, others 27.09% per an undated [Comparic](https://comparic.pl/prawie-100-w-gore-na-1-sesji-wielki-wlasciciel-rusza-po-reszte-akcji-czy-gpw-straci-kolejnego-gieldowego-weterana/) article.
thesis.red_flags: Pending tender offer: Zarmen announced a call (about 5 Oct 2026) for the remaining 1,451,406 shares (48.38%) at PLN 20.05 per share; shares nearly doubled on the news; delisting not announced but possible if the offer succeeds ([Comparic](https://comparic.pl/prawie-100-w-gore-na-1-sesji-wielki-wlasciciel-rusza-po-reszte-akcji-czy-gpw-straci-kolejnego-gieldowego-weterana/)). H1 2026 net loss PLN 11.68m, revenue -35.3%, book value PLN 17.57 per share; problems with a key contract; controlling holder at 51.62%.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (controlling holder is Zarmen sp. z o.o., 51.62%).

thesis.business_description: Agroliga Group Plc is a Cyprus-registered holding company with operations in Ukraine producing sunflower oil, cereals, and dairy cattle/milk and meat products, with a trading arm (Liga Trade); 2025 revenue was reported at about EUR 42.2m (-24%).
thesis.competitive_position: Mid-sized Ukrainian agri-processor facing war-related operating risk and commodity price swings, with no verified moat ([StockAnalysis profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/AGL/company); [Agroliga FY2025 consolidated financial statements](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/1677_20260320_170500_%D0%A1FS_AGROLIGA-GROUP-PLC_31.12.2025-signed.pdf)). Revenue 2025 of about EUR 42.2m is down 24% y/y per a press summary of the filing ([UkrAgroConsult](https://ukragroconsult.com/ru/news/agroliga-vyshla-v-pribyl/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Auditor raised a going-concern doubt (MarketScreener headline) and earlier-year audit reports cited material uncertainty tied to martial law in Ukraine; FY2025 audit report is headed by a qualified opinion per search summary of the filing ([MarketScreener](https://m.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/AGROLIGA-GROUP-PLC-47418924/news/Agroliga-Group-Plc-Auditor-Raises-Going-Concern-Doubt-43337202/); [FY2025 financial statements](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/1677_20260320_170500_%D0%A1FS_AGROLIGA-GROUP-PLC_31.12.2025-signed.pdf)); war-zone asset and operating risk in Ukraine; ownership very concentrated (reportedly top two holders 83.33%, unverified), limiting free float.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

name: WODKAN Przedsiebiorstwo Wodociagów i Kanalizacji S.A.

thesis.business_description: Water-supply and sewage-collection utility for the city of Ostrow Wielkopolski (Poland), also selling water and collecting sewage wholesale for the neighbouring Ostrow rural, Przygodzice and Raszkow communes; listed on NewConnect.
thesis.competitive_position: Regional municipal water utility with an effectively local-monopoly position in its service area; the moat is the regulated network and municipal ownership, not pricing power. Net sales were about PLN 52.6M in 2025 vs PLN 49.5M in 2024 per the annual-report table ([WODKAN 2025 annual report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/1965_20260410_104800_raport_roczny_2025.pdf)), but the operating margin has fallen from 6.8% to 0.3% over three years per a data aggregator ([AlphaSpread](https://www.alphaspread.com/security/wse/wod/profitability/ratio/operating-margin)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Per the 2025 annual report (structure at 31.12.2025): Centrum Rozwoju Komunalnego S.A. 32.68% of shares and votes; Bank Ochrony Srodowiska S.A. 29.48% (1,509,090 of 5,118,675 shares); Gmina Miasto Ostrow Wielkopolski (city) 25.29% ([WODKAN 2025 annual report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/1965_20260410_104800_raport_roczny_2025.pdf); see also [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/utilities/wse-wod/wodkan-przedsiebiorstwo-wodociagow-i-kanalizacji-shares/ownership)).
thesis.red_flags: Operating margin has collapsed to about 0.3% from 6.8% three years earlier ([AlphaSpread](https://www.alphaspread.com/security/wse/wod/profitability/ratio/operating-margin)). Control sits with three related institutional/municipal holders (CRK group, a state-owned bank and the city); the annual report names the city as dominant entity and CRK as parent of the capital group ([WODKAN 2025 annual report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/1965_20260410_104800_raport_roczny_2025.pdf)), so the free float is small and minority holders have little influence. NewConnect (alternative market) listing with thin liquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Petards Group plc (UK) supplies rail, defence and law-enforcement technology: Petards Rail (eyeTrain on-train camera systems), Petards Defence, and Affini (acquired 2024); brands include eyeTrain, ProVida and QRO ([Investegate FY2025 results](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/petards-group--peg/final-results-for-the-year-ended-31-december-2025/9520306)). FY2025 revenue GBP 14.9m (+24%) with an order book of GBP 9.2m. UK-focused.
thesis.competitive_position: A niche UK rail/defence/policing technology supplier with a sizeable installed base of passenger-rail vehicles supporting service and upgrade revenue, and a GBP 2.2m contract from the Rheinmetall BAE Systems joint venture ([Stockopedia](https://www.stockopedia.com/share-prices/petards-LON:PEG/news/reg-petards-group-plc-final-results-for-the-year-ended-31-december-2025-urn:newsml:reuters.com:20260415:nRSO4777Aa/)). Moat is installed-base and certification stickiness; it is lumpy, depends on few large public-sector/rail customers and is sub-scale.
