thesis.main_shareholders: Simply Wall St (about Feb 2026): El-Khereiji Financial Company WLL ~14.2%, Aberdeen Group ~7.1%, Philip J Milton & Co ~6.5%; top 25 holders ~80.7% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/software/aim-peg/petards-group-shares/ownership)). In 2022: El-Khereiji 15.24%, Charwell Investments 8.99% ([Substack](https://turningroughstones.substack.com/p/petards-group-promising-british-nanocap)).
thesis.red_flags: Net debt (before leases) of GBP 1.34m at end-2025 ([FY2025 results](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/petards-group--peg/final-results-for-the-year-ended-31-december-2025/9520306)); lumpy contract revenue and dependence on UK rail operators/defence programmes; concentrated shareholder base (top 3 about 28%) and AIM small-cap liquidity; earlier performance weakness at Petards Rail (recovery only in FY2025).
thesis.insider_ownership: Chairman Raschid Abdullah reported at about 6.06% after buying 200,000 shares (undated, [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/petards-group-chairman-increases-shareholding)); director Geraint Charles Davies bought 100,000 shares in Feb 2026 ([Stockopedia/Simply Wall St insider data](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/software/aim-peg/petards-group-shares/ownership)).

thesis.business_description: UK AIM-listed capital-goods group (sector per [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/capital-goods/aim-lpa/lpa-group-shares)); FY to 30 Sep 2025 revenue was about GBP 21.5m (FY2024 GBP 23.5m) with an operating loss of about GBP 0.6m ([LSE/Sharecast summary](https://www.lse.co.uk/news/lpa-group-reports-narrower-full-year-operating-loss-o5mvkczqpx8sotb.html)).
thesis.competitive_position: Small UK engineering/electrical systems supplier whose revenue is project- and order-intake-driven; the Sep 2025 trading update cut FY revenue by about GBP 3.0m to c. GBP 21.5m with an adjusted PBT loss of about GBP 1.3m, and FY2026 revenue is guided to c. GBP 27m with adjusted PBT of GBP 0.6m ([Hargreaves Lansdown](https://www.hl.co.uk/shares/stock-market-news/aim-and-small-cap-news/small-cap-news/lpa-group-lowers-fy-guidance)). Limited scale and lumpy orders mean no clear moat.
thesis.main_shareholders: Peter Gyllenhammar AB (via Bronsstadet AB) 29.11% / 3,933,500 voting rights after 10 Dec 2024 TR-1 ([Investing.com](https://ng.investing.com/news/company-news/peter-gyllenhammar-ab-ups-stake-in-lpa-group-to-2911-93CH-1669822)); Simply Wall St later shows Peter Gyllenhammar AB 30.4%, Aberdeen Group plc 4.6%, Marilyn Porter 3.97% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/capital-goods/aim-lpa/lpa-group-shares/ownership)).
thesis.red_flags: Recent profit warning (Sep 2025) and losses, with FY2026 recovery dependent on order intake ([HL](https://www.hl.co.uk/shares/stock-market-news/aim-and-small-cap-news/small-cap-news/lpa-group-lowers-fy-guidance)). Banking facilities were refinanced and a property was disposed of ([LSE RNS](https://www.lse.co.uk/rns/LPA/successful-refinancing-of-banking-facilities-ro870hd62bw9bxp.html)), indicating balance-sheet management. A single holder near 30% has been steadily building a stake since 2021 ([Investing.com](https://ng.investing.com/news/company-news/peter-gyllenhammar-ab-ups-stake-in-lpa-group-to-2911-93CH-1669822)), raising controlling-holder/takeover-bid dynamics (Takeover Code 30% threshold).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (Peter Gyllenhammar AB is an external investor holder; management holdings not found).

thesis.business_description: Warsaw-based financial-information group (founded 2000 by Przemyslaw Szalbierz and Grzegorz Raupuk) running the Analizy.pl fund-analysis and rating platform, financial conferences, and the KupFundusz fund-distribution subsidiary, serving the Polish investment-fund market.
thesis.competitive_position: Specialised provider of investment-fund data, ratings and events with a recognised niche brand in Poland, but small and tied to the fund-industry cycle ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/AOL/company)). Group revenue was PLN 12.9M in 2024 (+PLN 1.5M), with the conferences segment up 26.8% ([2024 consolidated annual report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/51287969/DOC.20250407.51287969.Skonsolidowany_raport_roczny_2024_New_Connect_final-0.pdf)). Management letter says 2025 consolidated net profit again exceeded PLN 2.3M ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/145864,list-do-akcjonariuszy-grupy-analizy-online-2025)); Q1 2025 revenue fell 8.6% y/y ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/diversified-financials/wse-aol/analizy-online-shares/news/analizy-online-reports-first-quarter-2025-earnings/amp)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Grzegorz Raupuk 236,811 shares (19.34%) as of 2026-01-31; 'others' 27.22% shown on the same page; total 1,224,082 shares ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/new-connect/ANALIZY/akcjonariat); [Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/229601-analizy-online)). Earlier ESPI notices recorded reductions of holdings below 25% (Apr 2021) and below 20% (Feb 2022) ([Parkiet ESPI](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art35751941-analizy-online-s-a-zmniejszenie-stanu-posiadania-akcji-analizy-online-s-a-ponizej-20-00)). The rest of the register was not retrieved.
thesis.red_flags: Founder-led, tiny share base (1.22M shares) with thin liquidity on NewConnect ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/229601-analizy-online)). Revenue is tied to Polish fund-industry sentiment and event demand; Q1 2025 profit fell 40% y/y ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/diversified-financials/wse-aol/analizy-online-shares/news/analizy-online-reports-first-quarter-2025-earnings/amp)). Founder stake has been sold down from 46.4% (2010) to 19.34% ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/new-connect/ANALIZY/akcjonariat)). No going-concern or auditor-qualification wording found.
thesis.insider_ownership: Grzegorz Raupuk (co-founder and management board member) 19.34% as of 31 Jan 2026 ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/new-connect/ANALIZY/akcjonariat)); co-founder Przemyslaw Szalbierz and CEO Michal Duniec sit on the management board (holdings not retrieved) ([2024 annual report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/51287969/DOC.20250407.51287969.Skonsolidowany_raport_roczny_2024_New_Connect_final-0.pdf)).

thesis.business_description: Genomed S.A. (Warsaw, Poland; formerly DNA Serwis Sp. z o.o., founded 2007) provides genetic diagnostic testing, including whole-exome sequencing (WES), in Poland.
thesis.competitive_position: Specialist Polish genetic-testing laboratory with growing volumes but no verified moat; 2025 revenue was PLN 29.1m (+26.6% from PLN 23.0m), net profit PLN 3.4m and EBITDA PLN 4.9m, with growth attributed to WES and newer tests ([Genomed 2025 annual report](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-05/20260526_145737_0000002908_0000075520.pdf)). A dividend of PLN 1.50 per share (~PLN 1.9m) was approved from 2025 profit ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/GENOMED/wiadomosci)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Diagnostyka SA 562,984 shares = 42.60% of capital and 22.16% of votes (2021 notification); Anna Maria Boguszewska-Chachulska 124,500 shares = 6.45% / 9.22% (ZWZ list dated 2026-06-30; column basis unclear) ([Bankier shareholders](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/new-connect/GENOMED/akcjonariat); [Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/233881-genomed)).
thesis.red_flags: Large strategic holder Diagnostyka (42.6% of capital in 2021 data) creates controlling-holder dynamics; multiple share classes with preferential voting (1,321,301 shares vs 1,929,301 votes) ([Bankier shareholders](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/new-connect/GENOMED/akcjonariat)); NewConnect listing with limited liquidity. Shareholder data partly dated.
thesis.insider_ownership: Anna Maria Boguszewska-Chachulska is listed with 6.45% of capital/9.22% of votes ([Bankier shareholders](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/new-connect/GENOMED/akcjonariat)); her management role was not verified.

thesis.business_description: Magna Polonia S.A. (Warsaw; formerly Narodowy Fundusz Inwestycyjny Magna Polonia) is a Polish investment/holding company that has focused on private equity and venture-type investments in new technologies, infrastructure, automation and energy efficiency, with a deal size of EUR 0.5-10m.
thesis.competitive_position: Small listed investment holding with no operating moat; value rests on its portfolio and on a long-running claim against Emitel (owned by Cordiant Digital Infrastructure), where a Polish outlet reports courts awarded Magna over PLN 200m in damages in total, which Emitel does not accept ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/art36545691-przejecie-emitela-czeka-na-decyzje-msw)). Portfolio details seen are dated (2011-2012) ([Marketlog/EMIS profiles](https://www.emis.cn/php/company-profile/PL/Magna_Polonia_SA_en_1454005.html)); share capital PLN 13.92m ([2023 report](https://www.bankier.pl/static/att/emitent/2024-04/magnapolonia-szd-2023-12-31-pl_202404220484622873.xhtml)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Mariusz Obszański notified an increase of his existing stake in votes at the general meeting (art. 69 notice 10/2026; stake size not seen in results) ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/154957,magna-polonia-sa-10-2026-zawiadomienie-w-trybie-art-69-ustawy-o-ofercie-publicznej)); older data: Rasting Limited 52.5% (March 2012) and Cezary Gregorczuk 9.94% (March 2014) ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/new-connect/06MAGNA/akcjonariat)), which may no longer be current.
thesis.red_flags: Value heavily dependent on the outcome/collectability of the Emitel damages dispute ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/art36545691-przejecie-emitela-czeka-na-decyzje-msw)); takeover rumours involving Cordiant were addressed by the board on 23 Oct 2025, which said it was not aware of any takeover information ([Money.pl](https://www.money.pl/gielda/komunikaty/7226099198797953.html)); concentrated holders and active stake building (art. 69 notice) ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/154957,magna-polonia-sa-10-2026-zawiadomienie-w-trybie-art-69-ustawy-o-ofercie-publicznej)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Lithuania-based tour operator (registered in Kaunas) selling package holidays in Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia; the group served about 239 thousand passengers on EUR 201m revenue in 2024.
thesis.competitive_position: One of the leading Baltic outbound package-tour operators, but the CEO cited intense competition and excess travel supply when 2025 consolidated revenue fell 16.1% to EUR 168m ([Novaturas 12M 2025 results](https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/NOVATURAS-AB-Unaudited-12-Month-Results-of-the-Novaturas-Group-for-2025-9090035.html)). The model is asset-light with no evident moat beyond brand and charter-seat purchasing scale, so margins are cyclical and thin. Half-year losses were reported to have narrowed threefold in H1 2025 ([Parkiet/ESPI](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art42880311-novaturas-ab-novaturas-announces-its-half-year-results-losses-reduced-threefold-profitability-expected-for-second-half)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Turkish businessman Neset Kockar: 23.2% bought in April 2025 ([Novaturas announcement](https://www.novaturasgroup.com/news/733/55/Novaturas-announces-a-23-2-share-sale-agreement-with-Turkish-businessman-N-Kockar/)); after the 21 July 2026 capital increase he held 11,821,620 shares, i.e. 65.31% of shares and votes, and notified a mandatory tender offer for the remaining shares ([Novaturas notification](https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/NOVATURAS-AB-Notification-about-the-intention-to-submit-a-non-competitive-mandatory-tender-offer-9173988.html)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder (65.31%) with a mandatory tender offer pending, so squeeze-out/delisting and a very small free float are possible ([notification](https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/NOVATURAS-AB-Notification-about-the-intention-to-submit-a-non-competitive-mandatory-tender-offer-9173988.html)). Revenue fell 16.1% in 2025 and H1 2025 was loss-making ([results](https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/NOVATURAS-AB-Unaudited-12-Month-Results-of-the-Novaturas-Group-for-2025-9090035.html)). Audit of 2025 statements was delayed, with publication pushed to no later than 11 May 2026, and the AGM had to be repeated (12 June 2026) ([audited FS notice](https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/NOVATURAS-AB-Regarding-the-publication-of-the-audited-annual-financial-statements-of-AB-Novaturas-for-2025-and-the-auditor-s-report-9126106.html)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Agros Development Company 'Proodos' Public Ltd (incorporated 1979, Agros, Cyprus) owns the Rodon Hotel in Agros village and holds real-estate/development interests, listed on the Cyprus Stock Exchange.
thesis.competitive_position: Single-asset mountain-resort hotel owner in Cyprus with no meaningful moat beyond the property and location; the Rodon hotel is the key asset targeted by the 2024-25 takeover ([Cyprus Mail on Rodon acquisition proposal](https://cyprus-mail.com/2024/09/27/investors-eyeing-rodon-hotel-in-agros-acquisition-proposal-under-view); [Cyprus Mail on 87.85% stake](https://cyprus-mail.com/2025/03/11/investor-secures-87-85-per-cent-of-rodon-hotels-parent-company)). The company paid a EUR 338,148 dividend from 2022 profits in July 2025 ([Cyprus Mail](https://cyprus-mail.com/2025/07/29/agros-development-company-pays-e338148-dividend-from-2022-profits)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Balram Chainrai 87.85% after a CySEC-approved public offer completed in March 2025 (another filing shows 87.82% of voting rights) ([Cyprus Mail](https://cyprus-mail.com/2025/03/11/investor-secures-87-85-per-cent-of-rodon-hotels-parent-company)). Pre-offer 2023 holders: Universal Life 17.30%, Apeiteion Foundation 15.98%, Antonis Pissarides 11.79%, Nicos Hadjiosif 9.32% ([CBN](https://www.cbn.com.cy/article/2023/11/27/745237/tourism-the-major-shareholders-in-cyprus-listed-companies)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder Balram Chainrai at ~87.85% leaves a free float of roughly 12%; below the 90% squeeze-out threshold, and the offeror reportedly stated no intention to delist, but a later squeeze-out/delisting cannot be ruled out ([Cyprus Mail](https://cyprus-mail.com/2025/03/11/investor-secures-87-85-per-cent-of-rodon-hotels-parent-company); [CBN public offer](https://cbn.com.cy/article/2024/12/10/810497/balram-chainrai-submits-public-offer-to-acquire-up-to-100-of-rodon-hotel)); dividends paid late (2022 profits paid in 2025); illiquid single-asset hotel business.
thesis.insider_ownership: 2023 pre-offer: chairman Antonis Pissarides 11.79% and board member Nicos Hadjiosif 9.32% ([CBN](https://www.cbn.com.cy/article/2023/11/27/745237/tourism-the-major-shareholders-in-cyprus-listed-companies)); whether they tendered into the 2025 offer not verified.

thesis.business_description: MDI Energia S.A. (Poland) is mainly a general contractor/EPC for renewable-energy projects, building photovoltaic farms, wind farms and biogas plants; revenue was PLN 201.3m in 2024 and PLN 245.4m TTM to Q3 2025 ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/MDI/revenue/); [StockAnalysis profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/MDI/company/)). Poland only; recent contracts include a package for 74 PV farms ([GramwZielone](https://www.gramwzielone.pl/?p=101770)).
thesis.competitive_position: A small Polish OZE EPC contractor in a competitive, low-margin construction niche; wins depend on tender/contract flow (e.g. PV farm packages, a letter of intent with GAZ-SYSTEM in April 2026 per [money.pl](https://www.money.pl/gielda/komunikaty/?isin=plnfi1000012)). No structural moat; revenue is project-driven with limited visibility, though top-line growth has been solid.
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Management turnover: entire management board dismissed/replaced in Sept 2022 and a board member resigned in Jan 2026 ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art36981091-mdi-energia-s-a-odwolanie-i-powolanie-czlonkow-zarzadu-spolki-na-wspolna-kadencje); [money.pl](https://www.money.pl/gielda/komunikaty/?isin=plnfi1000012)); low-margin EPC model with project concentration; micro-cap valuation vs revenue (market cap USD ~8.8m vs ~PLN 245m TTM revenue) signals market scepticism about profitability. FY2025 annual report was published 24 April 2026 ([money.pl](https://www.money.pl/gielda/komunikaty/7278785071936065.html)); auditor opinion not retrieved.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Pitesti (Arges, Romania) producer of spirits/wine products (tuica, distilleries and vinification) listed on BVB as VIAG; under insolvency proceedings since 2011 with plans to sell or lease distilleries and other assets to repay debts.
thesis.competitive_position: Regional drinks producer with ageing assets and no visible moat; the business has been restructuring through insolvency, with Profit.ro reporting plans to sell or lease the Pitesti production unit, the Samara and Domnesti distilleries and the Costesti vinification sector to raise cash ([Profit.ro](https://profit.ro/povesti-cu-profit/agribusiness/vinalcool-arges-vrea-sa-vanda-sau-sa-inchirieze-mai-multe-active-ca-sa-achite-din-datorii-15431315)). A later headline claims the company exited insolvency after seven years ([Profit.ro](https://profit.ro/insider/companii/producatorul-tuicii-pitesti-controlat-marian-dragusin-candidat-psd-pc-iesit-insolventa-dupa-7-ani-vara-compania-reluat-planul-vanzare-inchiriere-distilarii-face-rost-bani-18078821)), not confirmed by a dated official source.
thesis.main_shareholders: D.G.M. New Planet RO / D.G.M. International Pitesti (controlled by Marian Dragusin) about 82.86% (EMIS) / almost 83% (Profit.ro); remaining shares held by individuals ([EMIS](https://www.emis.com/php/company-profile/RO/Vinalcool_Arges_SA_en_1500236.html); [Profit.ro](https://profit.ro/insider/companii/producatorul-tuicii-de-pitesti-controlat-de-marian-dragusin-fost-candidat-psd-pc-reia-planul-de-vanzare-sau-inchiriere-de-distilarii-pentru-a-face-rost-de-banii-cu-care-sa-iasa-din-insolventa-17037160)).
thesis.red_flags: Insolvency proceedings since 2011 with asset-sale plan to repay creditors ([Profit.ro](https://profit.ro/povesti-cu-profit/agribusiness/vinalcool-arges-vrea-sa-vanda-sau-sa-inchirieze-mai-multe-active-ca-sa-achite-din-datorii-15431315)); ASF flagged late publication of the 2024 annual report ([ASF](https://asfromania.ro/uploads/articole/attachments/696f39c9283e6987079366.pdf)); controlling holder with about 83% leaves about 17% free float; politically exposed controlling shareholder per press ([Profit.ro](https://profit.ro/insider/companii/producatorul-tuicii-de-pitesti-controlat-de-marian-dragusin-fost-candidat-psd-pc-reia-planul-de-vanzare-sau-inchiriere-de-distilarii-pentru-a-face-rost-de-banii-cu-care-sa-iasa-din-insolventa-17037160)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Marian Dragusin (General Manager / Chairman per [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/it/stocks/ro/food-beverage-tobacco/bvb-viag/sc-vinalcool-arges-shares/management)) controls about 83% via D.G.M. entities ([Profit.ro](https://profit.ro/insider/companii/producatorul-tuicii-de-pitesti-controlat-de-marian-dragusin-fost-candidat-psd-pc-reia-planul-de-vanzare-sau-inchiriere-de-distilarii-pentru-a-face-rost-de-banii-cu-care-sa-iasa-din-insolventa-17037160)).

thesis.business_description: Sintofarm S.A. (Bucharest; BVB ticker SINT) is a Romanian company historically making pharmaceutical preparations; it announced in 2015 a plan to exit medicines production for real-estate development; 2025 revenue was ~RON 12.9M.
thesis.competitive_position: Micro-cap with a modest, slow-growing revenue base (2025 revenue ~RON 12.88M, +4.3%) ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/SINT/revenue/)) and small profit (RON 308,047 retained plus RON 18,974 to legal reserve) ([AGOA resolutions 22 Apr 2026](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/SINT/SINT_20260422190755_Raport-curent-22-04-2026-Hot-AGAO-455-Sintofarm.pdf)). Strategy shift away from medicines toward real estate is reported ([ZF](https://www.zf.ro/burse-fonduri-mutuale/sintofarm-bucuresti-renunta-la-medicamente-pentru-dezvoltare-imobiliara-14891882)); no clear moat identified.
thesis.main_shareholders: Ontrest Trading Ltd 27.99464% and Interfinance Capital Investments Ltd 26.26900% of 3,860,764 shares ([H1 2022 report](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/SINT/SINT_20220830120232_Raport-semestrul-I-an-2022.pdf)); in the 2019 report also Iberestate International Holding 15.36976% and SIF Muntenia 13.00727% ([2019 board report](https://sintofarm.ro/fisiere/aga/AGA-aprilie-2020/RAPORT-CONS-ADM-2019.pdf)). Current (2025/26) holdings not verified.
thesis.red_flags: Ownership data is dated (2022/2019) and may have changed; two holders control ~54% ([H1 2022](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/SINT/SINT_20220830120232_Raport-semestrul-I-an-2022.pdf)); very thin profit relative to market value; stagnating business and strategic uncertainty (pharma exit/real estate) ([ZF](https://www.zf.ro/burse-fonduri-mutuale/sintofarm-bucuresti-renunta-la-medicamente-pentru-dezvoltare-imobiliara-14891882)); AGM excluded shareholder-director votes from quorum ([BVB](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/SINT/SINT_20260422190755_Raport-curent-22-04-2026-Hot-AGAO-455-Sintofarm.pdf)); illiquid ATS-listed stock.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Danish space-hardware and services company (Nasdaq First North Denmark since May 2019) targeting commercial aerospace and defence customers such as ESA and NASA; 2025 revenue DKK 18.9m.
thesis.competitive_position: Niche space-technology supplier with small revenue (DKK 18.9m), EBITDA of DKK -2.0m and a net loss of DKK 3.5m in 2025 ([annual report announcement](https://www.inderes.fi/releases/danish-aerospace-company-as-issues-annual-report-for-2025)). Management says further product-development investment is needed to win aerospace and defence contracts ([rights issue announcement](https://www.inderes.fi/releases/danish-aerospace-company-as-to-initiate-a-fully-guaranteed-rights-issue-with-gross-proceeds-of-dkk-247-million)). Moat limited to specialised space heritage; no scale.
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Loss-making with equity of only DKK 4.7m at end-2025 ([annual report announcement](https://www.inderes.fi/releases/danish-aerospace-company-as-issues-annual-report-for-2025)); needed a DKK 24.7m fully guaranteed rights issue at DKK 3.00 per share in March-April 2026, with guarantees covering about DKK 15.2m and 18.01% of new shares ([results](https://www.inderes.dk/en/releases/danish-aerospace-company-as-raises-dkk-247-million-in-rights-issue)); prolonged customer payment terms hurt working capital; listed on First North (not an EU regulated market); board chair change noted between 2025 announcements and annual report signature.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Wroclaw-based energy-efficiency/ESCO company (founded 2009) active in cogeneration and trigeneration, waste-heat recovery, cooling, renewables and energy storage (BESS) for industrial clients in Poland; fiscal year ends 30 June.
thesis.competitive_position: Small Polish ESCO and cogeneration project developer/operator, niche in industrial energy-saving services. It has a long-term contract to manage a cogeneration unit (10 years, ~PLN 2.75m annual revenue) ([BiznesRadar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/91494,db-energy-bedzie-zarzadzac-jednostka-kogeneracyjna-dla-bwi-poland-technologies)). Revenue in FY to 30 June 2025 was PLN 30.06m, down 33.3% y/y ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/DBE/revenue/)), indicating lumpy project-based sales and no clear moat.
thesis.main_shareholders: Piotr Danielski 26.86% of shares / 28.58% of votes ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/notowania/spolki/PLDBENR00017/akcjonariat)); earlier Bankier table (April 2023) listed Piotr Danielski ~27%, Krzysztof Piontek ~23%, Dominik Brach ~23% ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/DBENERGY/akcjonariat)).
thesis.red_flags: Revenue fell 33.3% in FY2024/25 to PLN 30.06m ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/DBE/revenue/)); lumpy project revenue; founder trio controls roughly 70%+ of shares ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/DBENERGY/akcjonariat)) with free float ~27% (2023 data); auditor opinion and debt levels not verified from sources seen.
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder/management holders Piotr Danielski 26.86%, plus Krzysztof Piontek and Dominik Brach each ~23% as of April 2023 (their current stakes not verified) ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/notowania/spolki/PLDBENR00017/akcjonariat); [Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/DBENERGY/akcjonariat)).

thesis.business_description: KLON S.A. (Nowa Swieta, Wielkopolska, Poland; NewConnect ticker KLN) processes hardwood at two plants, producing sawn timber, glued panels, furniture and flooring components and offering wood drying, planing and gluing services.
thesis.competitive_position: Small regional hardwood processor serving furniture/flooring/construction inputs ([Stockwatch](https://www.stockwatch.pl/gpw/klon,wiadomosci,dane-finansowe.aspx), [Money.pl](https://www.money.pl/gielda/spolki-gpw/plklon000010,o_firmie.html)). Commodity-like products with raw-material cost exposure; no evidence of a moat.
thesis.main_shareholders: MERA S.A. (NewConnect-listed) described as dominant shareholder, with 61.4267% of capital after a partial sale in a 2018 notice ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/235851-klon)); T5 sp. z o.o. (Robert Traka) 3,934,541 shares / 16.79% as of 2022-04-12 ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/KLON/akcjonariat)). Both dated; current split unverified.
thesis.red_flags: Controlling-holder dynamics (MERA S.A. dominant) and shifting stakes by T5/Traka (37.94% in a 2021 filing vs 16.79% in 2022) ([Parkiet ESPI](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art26546491-klon-s-a-zawiadomienie-o-zmianie-udzialu-w-glosach-ogolem), [Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/KLON/akcjonariat)); related-party exposure to the parent group; NewConnect illiquidity; EGM resolutions on 9 Jan 2026 and AGM lists show ongoing corporate actions not analysed ([NewConnect](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/415_20260109_122000_Treść-uchwał-NWZ-KLON-SA-09.01.2025.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Robert Traka via T5 sp. z o.o. 16.79% as of 2022-04-12 ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/KLON/akcjonariat)); his management role not confirmed.

thesis.business_description: Swedish developer, manufacturer and seller of products for the automation and security industries (subsidiaries Kentima AB and Kentima Control R&D AB), listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market; 2025 group revenue SEK 72.95M (+35% from SEK 54.2M) ([Kentima AGM 2026 presentation](https://cdn.bequoted.com/media/1/bb9f6fe0-7f7f-4732-8bd2-0829334bb270/Presentation-Kentima-Arsstamma-2026.pdf); [Kentima year-end report 2025](https://cdn.bequoted.com/media/1/fbe46428-3969-4778-ba0c-5a5b0bf13190/KentimaHoldingAB_Bokslutskommunike_2025.pdf)).
thesis.competitive_position: Small niche supplier in access/automation and security components in the Nordic market; competes against much larger industrial-automation groups, so moat is limited to product niche and customer relationships. Growth of 35% in 2025 shows momentum but off a small base ([Kentima year-end report 2025](https://cdn.bequoted.com/media/1/fbe46428-3969-4778-ba0c-5a5b0bf13190/KentimaHoldingAB_Bokslutskommunike_2025.pdf)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Kent Nilsson (founder/CEO) via companies and a foundation: 8,119,430 shares, 27.84% of capital and 39.79% of votes at 31 Dec 2025 ([Kentima year-end report 2025](https://cdn.bequoted.com/media/1/fbe46428-3969-4778-ba0c-5a5b0bf13190/KentimaHoldingAB_Bokslutskommunike_2025.pdf)); at 31 Dec 2024 the top owners together held about 68.9% of capital and 76.2% of votes out of 29,162,111 shares (Kentima 2024 reporting as summarised in search; other holders not named).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling-holder dynamics: founder/CEO holds about 39.8% of votes through differentiated share classes; the company reported a loss per share of SEK 0.076 in FY2024 versus a profit of SEK 0.058 in FY2023 ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/software/sto-kenh/kentima-holding-shares/news/kentima-holding-full-year-2024-earnings-kr0076-loss-per-shar)); no dividend for 2025; small scale and low liquidity on First North; CEO share purchases and sales logged by Affarsvarlden in Nov 2025 and Mar 2026.
thesis.insider_ownership: Kent Nilsson (founder, CEO) 27.84% of capital / 39.79% of votes at 31 Dec 2025 (Kentima year-end report 2025, https://cdn.bequoted.com/media/1/fbe46428-3969-4778-ba0c-5a5b0bf13190/KentimaHoldingAB_Bokslutskommunike_2025.pdf).

thesis.business_description: Sofia-based Bulgarian manufacturer and seller of hygiene and cosmetic products in Bulgaria and abroad; controlled by Harisson Management Limited (Malta), which launched a squeeze-out of the remaining minority in 2026.
thesis.competitive_position: Long-established Bulgarian household/cosmetics brand with a domestic niche but no evident global moat; competes against multinational FMCG groups ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/bg/household/bul-arom/aroma-ad-shares/information)). Share capital was tripled earlier from BGN 5.16M to BGN 15.5M ([FFBH](https://www.ffbham.bg/en/post/aroma-to-triple-capital-to-bgn-15-5m-158997868995877)). With the controlling holder already above 95%, trading liquidity is minimal and the investment case now rests on squeeze-out terms.
thesis.main_shareholders: Harisson Management Limited (Malta) directly holds 8,056,189 shares; together with related parties and persons acting in concert it holds 14,940,038 shares = 96.438% of capital and 96.955% of votes, per the squeeze-out offer document registered with the Bulgarian FSC on 27 March 2026 ([BSE Sofia offer document](https://download.bse-sofia.bg/prospekt/AROM-/Squeeze-out202605/1_Aroma_Squeeze-out-Part%20I-final.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Pending squeeze-out: the offer covers 551,791 shares at EUR 0.95 per share ([BSE Sofia offer document](https://download.bse-sofia.bg/prospekt/AROM-/Squeeze-out202605/1_Aroma_Squeeze-out-Part%20I-final.pdf)); FSC Decision 238-TP of 14 Apr 2026 found gaps and inconsistencies that had to be corrected, including whether the minimum-price rule applies ([FSC](https://www.fsc.bg/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/238.pdf)). Delisting risk once the squeeze-out completes (sister company Aroma Real Estate was delisted in Jan 2020 after a Harisson squeeze-out ([SeeNews](https://seenews.com/news/aroma-real-estate-delists-from-bulgarian-stock-exchange-684315))). Controlling-holder dynamics with free float of about 3.6% of capital. An earlier Profit.bg item reported trading suspended during a dispute between former and current shareholders ([Profit.bg](https://www.profit.bg/article/2024012320274771640)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Controlled by Harisson Management Limited and related parties (96.438% of capital, 96.955% of votes); individual management holdings not disclosed (Simply Wall St shows insiders about 0.008%, undated) ([BSE Sofia offer document](https://download.bse-sofia.bg/prospekt/AROM-/Squeeze-out202605/1_Aroma_Squeeze-out-Part%20I-final.pdf)).

thesis.business_description: Polish restaurant group (Mex Polska S.A.) operating and franchising casual-dining and street-food concepts including The Mexican, Prosty Temat, PanKejk, Pizzanova, Spoko Taco and Pijalnia Wodki i Piwa, in Poland.
thesis.competitive_position: Mid-sized Polish restaurant operator with a portfolio of own brands, growing by opening at least six new venues a year (seven opened Jan-Sep 2025) ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/spolki/mex-poland-wyniki-2025-q3), [Wiadomosci Handlowe](https://www.wiadomoscihandlowe.pl/franczyza-w-handlu/franczyza-gastronomiczna/przychody-mex-polska-urosly-o-15-proc-rdr-grupa-nie-dala-sie-wplywowi-kiepskiej-pogody-2528667)). Preliminary 2025 consolidated revenue was PLN 127.29M, +19.05% y/y, a record ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/wiadomosci/20260112/mex-polska-szacuje-ze-w-25-skonsolidowane-przychody-wzrosly-rdr-o-1905-proc-do)). Brand ownership gives some differentiation but restaurants carry no durable moat; dividend policy now at least 30% of net profit, with the board recommending 50% of 2025 net profit ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/147655,zarzad-mex-polska-rekomenduje-przeznaczenie-na-dywidende-50-zysku-netto-za-2025-r)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Management-linked family foundations MEX Fundacja Rodzinna and OSTOJA Fundacja Rodzinna (Pawel Kowalewski, CEO, is president of OSTOJA); they sold 763,300 shares at PLN 3.60 in a Feb 2026 ABB; exact current % not retrieved ([Inwestycje.pl](https://inwestycje.pl/gielda/dwoch-akcjonariuszy-mex-polska-sprzedalo-w-abb-763-300-akcji-spolki-po-36-zl-szt/)). Familiar S.A. SICAV-SIF, formerly a significant holder, agreed on 22 Dec 2025 to sell all its shares ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/142407,koniec-impasu-w-akcjonariacie-mex-polska-familiar-s-a-sicav-sif-sprzeda-wszystkie-akcje)); 763,300 shares were bought at PLN 4.50 by two shareholders ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/wiadomosci/20260218/akcjonariusze-mex-polska-zakupili-lacznie-763300-akcji-spolki-w-cenie-45-zl-za)).
thesis.red_flags: Governance: a long-running shareholder dispute with Familiar S.A. SICAV-SIF, including lawsuits against the company and related entities that the Dec 2025 settlement made conditional on withdrawal ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/142407,koniec-impasu-w-akcjonariacie-mex-polska-familiar-s-a-sicav-sif-sprzeda-wszystkie-akcje)). Controlling-holder dynamics: management-linked foundations hold a large block; free float being increased only recently. Restaurant sector exposure to wage, rent and food-cost inflation (not quantified in sources found). Small equity base (USD 4.1M per input).
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Pawel Kowalewski is president of OSTOJA Fundacja Rodzinna, a holder; he and Andrzej Domzal reportedly each bought 381,650 shares at PLN 4.50 (Feb 2026) ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/wiadomosci/20260218/akcjonariusze-mex-polska-zakupili-lacznie-763300-akcji-spolki-w-cenie-45-zl-za)).

thesis.business_description: Mostostal Plock S.A. is a Polish manufacturer of steel structures and industrial installations, whose main customers are petrochemical and chemical companies such as PKN Orlen, Pfleiderer Grajewo, Grupa Lotos and Anwil ([Stockwatch](https://www.stockwatch.pl/gpw/MOSTALPLC,analiza-techniczna,dane-finansowe.aspx)). Poland-based.
thesis.competitive_position: A niche regional steel-fabrication contractor for refinery/chemical plants with heavy dependence on a few industrial clients; the company states it is working to win orders to fully utilise its processing capacity ([Bankier filing, Q1 2025](https://www.bankier.pl/static/att/emitent/2025-05/Pozostale-informacje-2025-03-31-0-pl_202505121900567339.xhtml)), implying spare capacity and limited pricing power. No structural moat; bid-based, cyclical contracting. Historically linked to the Mostostal Warszawa group, now controlled by Acciona.
thesis.main_shareholders: Latest hard data found is old: at 31 Dec 2011 Mostostal Warszawa SA held 48.66% of capital and 52.65% of votes; circa 2015 PTE PZU ~11% and Nationale-Nederlanden OFE ~10% ([Bankier notice](https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/MOSTALPLC-Zwolanie-Zwyczajnego-Walnego-Zgromadzenia-Mostostal-Plock-S-A-7664735.html); [Wynagrodzenia.pl](https://wynagrodzenia.pl/zarobki-menedzerow/mostostal-plock-spolka-akcyjna)). Current register not verified. Mostostal Warszawa is itself majority held by Acciona Construccion Polonia (about 62.13%, [The Corner](https://thecorner.eu/companies/acciona-considering-takeover-bid-for-polish-subsidiary-mostostal-to-avert-risk-of-bankruptcy/126532/)).
thesis.red_flags: Customer concentration in the Orlen/chemical sector ([Stockwatch](https://www.stockwatch.pl/gpw/MOSTALPLC,analiza-techniczna,dane-finansowe.aspx)); under-used production capacity; board changes and a statute amendment in August 2025 ([Stockwatch](https://www.stockwatch.pl/gpw/mostalplc,notowania,dane-finansowe.aspx)); controlling-holder dynamics: former parent Mostostal Warszawa has faced bankruptcy risk and an Acciona recapitalisation/tender ([The Corner](https://thecorner.eu/companies/acciona-considering-takeover-bid-for-polish-subsidiary-mostostal-to-avert-risk-of-bankruptcy/126532/)); share price roughly doubled in two months ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/budownictwo/art41846201-mostostal-plock-kontynuuje-passe-w-dwa-miesiace-wartosc-sie-podwoila)), indicating volatility/low liquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Botosani (Romania)-based agricultural commodity company operating grain storage (listed capacity ~269,500 t) and cereal trading; 2025 turnover was about RON 209m.
thesis.competitive_position: Regional grain storage and trading operator with large storage capacity relative to its size ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/CBOT/company/)). 2025 turnover of RON 209.2m yielded profit of only RON 647,792 (0.3% margin) ([Termene.ro](https://termene.ro/firma/8278020)), so it is a low-margin commodity intermediary with no visible moat beyond storage assets.
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Razor-thin net margin (0.3%) on RON 209m turnover ([Termene.ro](https://termene.ro/firma/8278020)); share capital increased in March 2026 to RON 11,901,603 (1,034,922 shares) ([BVB notice](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/CBOT/CBOT-Info_Dep_C_09032026_maj_cap_soc.pdf)); shareholder structure and free float not verified; commodity price/working-capital exposure typical for grain traders.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Polish software company developing geographic information systems (GIS) and digital-map products, including MapInfo Pro distribution, MapaMap and emapa, sold in Poland; 2024 revenue about PLN 6.74M ([Optigis 2024 management report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/51165823/DOC.20250321.51165823.Sprawozdanie_Zarzadu_z_dzialalnosci_Optigis_2024_final-1.pdf); [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/OPI/company)).
thesis.competitive_position: Niche Polish GIS/digital-mapping provider with a reseller position for MapInfo and own web-mapping products; competes with Esri partners, Google/OpenStreetMap-based tools and Polish public-sector GIS vendors. Moat is limited to customer relationships and local data/product know-how; scale is very small (sales PLN 5.93M in 2023 to PLN 6.74M in 2024, +13.8%, per [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/OPI/company)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Magna Polonia S.A. 42,593,119 shares, 64.09% of capital ([Magna Polonia group report 2022](https://www.bankier.pl/static/att/emitent/2023-04/magnapolonia-szd-ssf-2022-12-31-pl_202304201911308935.xhtml)); Polish State Treasury 11,155,041 shares, about 16.8% (aggregator, [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/software/wse-opi/optigis-shares/ownership)). Total shares and votes 66,458,256. A June 2026 over-5% AGM list exists ([money.pl](https://www.money.pl/gielda/spolki-gpw/plimags00013,emitent,1.html)) but its contents were not seen.
thesis.red_flags: Controlled by Magna Polonia (about 64%), a holding itself subject to takeover rumours (Cordiant Digital Infrastructure, Nov 2025, outcome not found); about 83% held by two holders limits free float; NewConnect-listed with thin liquidity; very small revenue base; book equity only about USD 2.2M.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Aktien-Brauerei Kaufbeuren AG (Kaufbeuren, Bavaria; fiscal year ends 30 September) is today a real-estate holding company engaged in leasing, management and acquisition of properties and operates a photovoltaic plant; the historical brewery business was spun off.
thesis.competitive_position: Small property-holding shell of a former brewery (founded 1308) with local real-estate assets; no operating moat, income depends on rents ([Alphaspread](https://alphaspread.com/security/xmun/abk/summary), [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aktienbrauerei_Kaufbeuren), [Inside.beer](https://www.inside.beer/news/detail/germany-american-investor-buys-915-of-aktienbrauerei-kaufbeuren)). Net income for FY to 30.09.2025 was about EUR 830.5k per Alphaspread.
thesis.main_shareholders: JP's Nevada Trust (John Paul DeJoria): about 95.00%, free float about 5.00% per boerse.de ([boerse.de](https://www.boerse.de/unternehmensprofil/Aktien-Brauerei-Kaufbeuren-AG-Aktie/DE0005013007)); JP's Nevada Trust acquired 91.54% in 2017 ([EQS / ROK Stars](https://eqs-news.com/news/corporate/rok-stars-plc-announce-jps-nevada-trust-completes-acquisition-of-aktienbrauerei-kaufbeuren-aktiengesellschaft-ag/1025647)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder ~95% leaves ~5% free float: extreme illiquidity and squeeze-out/delisting risk (German squeeze-out threshold is 95%). Historic insolvency of the brewing operation under self-administration is reported (date not verified) ([Leinetal24](https://www.leinetal24.de/wirtschaft/aktienbrauerei-kaufbeuren-ist-insolvent-mehr-als-die-haelfte-der-jobs-faellt-weg-zr-94467110.html)). Related-party and governance concentration: board and supervisory board include Kendrick family and associates ([boerse.de](https://www.boerse.de/unternehmensprofil/Aktien-Brauerei-Kaufbeuren-AG-Aktie/DE0005013007)). AGM convened for 22.07.2026 ([boerse.de](https://www.boerse.de/nachrichten/EQS-HV-Aktienbrauerei-Kaufbeuren-AG-Bekanntmachung-der-Einberufung-zur-Hauptversammlung-am-22072026-in-Kaufbeuren-mit-dem-Ziel-der-europaweiten-Verbreitung-gemaess-121-AktG/38383516)).
thesis.insider_ownership: James Kendrick (Vorstand) and Jonathan Kendrick, John Duncan Richards, Uwe Beck (Aufsichtsrat) listed; shareholding of individuals not disclosed; controlling holder is JP's Nevada Trust ~95% ([boerse.de](https://www.boerse.de/unternehmensprofil/Aktien-Brauerei-Kaufbeuren-AG-Aktie/DE0005013007)).

thesis.business_description: UK strategic communications group providing corporate events, brand experiences and film production, with North America cited by management as its largest growth opportunity; revenue GBP 29.5M for the 18 months to 31 Dec 2025.
thesis.competitive_position: Small events/communications agency with revenue up 7% to GBP 29.5M and underlying pre-tax profit GBP 797k (vs GBP 387k) over the 18 months to Dec 2025 ([AJ Bell](https://www.ajbell.co.uk/news/articles/aeorema-reports-revenue-underlying-profit-rise-strong-18-months), [LSE](https://www.lse.co.uk/news/aeorema-reports-revenue-underlying-profit-rise-in-strong-18-months-umpy52bclk7kt7n.html)). Project-based, relationship-driven business with low switching costs; no structural moat evident. Cash GBP 2.2M at 31 Dec 2025 and GBP 4.1M at announcement ([Stockopedia](https://www-proxy.stockopedia.com/share-prices/aeorema-communications-LON:AEO/news/reg-aeorema-comms-plc-final-results-urn:newsml:reuters.com:20260518:nRSR6139Ea/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Highly concentrated register: top-25 holders own about 94% and individual insiders about 60.8% per Simply Wall St (illiquid AIM stock) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/media/aim-aeo/aeorema-communications-shares/ownership)). Project-based revenue with a change of year-end (18-month period) makes year-on-year comparison harder; dividend cut to 4p total vs 6p the prior year ([AJ Bell](https://www.ajbell.co.uk/news/articles/aeorema-reports-revenue-underlying-profit-rise-strong-18-months)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders about 60.8% in aggregate (named insiders not retrieved) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/media/aim-aeo/aeorema-communications-shares/ownership)).

thesis.business_description: Formerly Triceps.pl; producer and distributor of dietary supplements, sports nutrition and healthy food in Poland and abroad, sold through own stores in several European countries and online (7-nutrition.com).
thesis.competitive_position: Small niche sports-nutrition and supplements brand competing with larger Polish and international supplement makers, with no evident moat beyond brand and its own retail/online channels ([StockAnalysis company profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/7FT/company)). Q2 2025 revenue was PLN 8.68M (+33.9% y/y); trailing-12-month revenue PLN 27.6M and net profit PLN 1.13M as of mid-2025 ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/7FT/)). A dividend of PLN 0.31 per share from 2025 profit was approved in mid-2026 ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/7FIT/wiadomosci)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Per Bankier table dated 28 Feb 2025: Michal Wasilewski 914,175 shares (51.00% of capital, 65.49% of votes); Arkadiusz Bala 350,040 shares (19.52% capital, 13.75% votes); Sone sp. z o.o. with SO International Ltd 9.82% capital / 6.91% votes; Michal Kopiczynski 7.75% / 5.46% ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/7FIT/akcjonariat)). Share capital was cut to 1,545,415 shares after redemption of series A shares approved 3 Dec 2024, so current percentages may differ.
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder Wasilewski has about 51% of capital but about 65% of votes through voting-preference shares ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/7FIT/akcjonariat)). Very small share base (about 1.5-1.8M shares) and equity, so thin liquidity. Series A share redemption in Dec 2024 changed the share base. Management board mandates were due to expire 30 June 2026 ([Q3 2025 report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/173472-7fit-sa-raport-za-iii-kwartal-2025.pdf)). No going-concern wording found in search results.
thesis.insider_ownership: Michal Wasilewski (management board member) 51.00% of capital and 65.49% of votes; CEO Arkadiusz Bala 19.52% of capital / 13.75% of votes, per Bankier table of 28 Feb 2025 ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/7FIT/akcjonariat); [Q3 2025 report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/173472-7fit-sa-raport-za-iii-kwartal-2025.pdf)).

thesis.business_description: BHB Brauholding Bayern-Mitte AG (Ingolstadt, Germany) is a holding whose operating subsidiary Herrnbraeu GmbH brews beer and runs brewery inns in the Ingolstadt, Munich, Regensburg, Nuremberg and Augsburg region, plus 50% of Herrnbraeu Italia S.r.l. for Italian sales ([Boerse-Online ad hoc](https://www.boerse-online.de/dpa-afx/eqs-adhoc-bhb-brauholding-bayern-mitte-ag-bhb-beabsichtigt-erwerb-einer-minderheitsbeteiligung-an-der-hbi-immobilien-gmbh-dem-erwerber-von-anteilen-an-der-gesellschaft-und-acht-gastronomieobjekten-deutsch-347129.html)). FY2025 revenue EUR 17.5m (2024: EUR 18.3m) ([Boerse-Online](https://www.boerse-online.de/dpa-afx/eqs-news-bhb-brauholding-bayern-mitte-ag-legt-zahlen-fuer-das-geschaeftsjahr-2025-vor-deutsch-510487.html)).
thesis.competitive_position: A small regional Bavarian brewer/pub operator in a structurally declining German beer market (sales volume -3.0% in 2025, within guidance). Local brand and owned pub tied outlets give a modest regional niche but no scale advantage. Balance sheet is solid (equity EUR 10.5m, 63% ratio) but EBIT was only about EUR -16k in 2025 (2024: EUR -237k), below its guided range ([Boerse-Online](https://www.boerse-online.de/dpa-afx/eqs-news-bhb-brauholding-bayern-mitte-ag-legt-vorlaeufige-zahlen-fuer-das-geschaeftsjahr-2025-vor-deutsch-501504.html)).
thesis.main_shareholders: HBI Immobilien GmbH (Ingolstadt regional investor group) acquired 1,059,962 shares = 34.2% from BBI Buergerliches Brauhaus Immobilien AG ([Boerse-Online, Dec 2023](https://www.boerse-online.de/dpa-afx/eqs-adhoc-bhb-brauholding-bayern-mitte-ag-hbi-immobilien-gmbh-erwirbt-1059962-aktien-der-bhb-brauholding-bayern-mitte-ag-deutsch-337843.html)); an undated profile site lists HBI at 35.8% ([Boersengefluester](https://app.boersengefluester.de/en/c/profile/p/DE000A1CRQD6)). Management held 9.70% in 2014 (older data, [EQS research](https://irpages2.eqs.com/Download/Research/20140807_BHB_Update.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Reciprocal cross-holding / related-party structure: BHB took a 35% stake in HBI (EUR 2.8m) while HBI bought 34.2% of BHB and eight brewery-inn properties of subsidiary Herrnbraeu ([Feb 2024 ad hoc](https://www.boerse-online.de/dpa-afx/eqs-adhoc-bhb-brauholding-bayern-mitte-ag-bhb-beabsichtigt-erwerb-einer-minderheitsbeteiligung-an-der-hbi-immobilien-gmbh-dem-erwerber-von-anteilen-an-der-gesellschaft-und-acht-gastronomieobjekten-deutsch-347129.html)); EBIT near break-even and below guidance in 2025 (preliminary, unaudited); declining beer volumes; controlling ~34-36% holder and small free float on Munich m:access.
thesis.insider_ownership: Management held 9.70% as of mid-2014 ([EQS research](https://irpages2.eqs.com/Download/Research/20140807_BHB_Update.pdf)); current insider holding not confirmed.

thesis.business_description: Suntech S.A. (Warsaw, Poland; founded 1996) is a software house delivering agile software solutions for telecommunications, banking, energy and transport clients in Poland and abroad.
thesis.competitive_position: Small B2B software developer with long-standing telecom/banking clients, but project-based revenue and no evident moat. FY2025 revenue was about PLN 36.3m (-19%) and net profit PLN 0.62m (-80%), with Q2 and Q3 2025 revenue down 29% and 28% y/y ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/software/wse-sun/suntech-shares/past); [Stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/SUN/revenue/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Piotr Saczuk and Wojciech Franczak are listed on the company's investor page; share capital is 15,940,000 shares with 20,940,000 votes (privileged shares) ([Suntech investors](https://suntech.pl/en/investors/shareholders)); an older Bankier table (Nov 2020) showed large holders at 57.85% of shares and 68.26% of votes ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/SUNTECH/akcjonariat)); current percentages not verified.
thesis.red_flags: Sharp revenue and profit decline in 2025; privileged voting shares give founders control (20.94m votes vs 15.94m shares); small free float on NewConnect.
thesis.insider_ownership: Founders/management Piotr Saczuk and Wojciech Franczak listed as shareholders; exact percentages not verified ([Suntech investors](https://suntech.pl/en/investors/shareholders)).

thesis.business_description: Polish investment company (Grempco S.A., registered office Lozienica near Goleniow) managing a portfolio of capital investments in high-tech companies in construction engineering: GRYFITLAB Sp. z o.o. (R&D lab) and FLUID DESK Sp. z o.o. (CAD/BIM software for installation design).
thesis.competitive_position: Essentially a holding whose value is driven by FLUID DESK, a CAD/BIM engineering software niche; in May 2025 FLUID DESK signed an exclusive distribution agreement for its BIM platform in mainland China ([money.pl](https://www.money.pl/gielda/spolki-gpw/plgrmpc00016,o_firmie.html)). Tiny operation (3 employees per Bankier) with 24,612,300 shares; Bankier shows 2025 net revenue of PLN 263k and net profit of PLN 2,543k (unverified, likely valuation gains rather than operating income) ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/GREMPCO/wyniki-finansowe/jednostkowy/roczny)). No moat at the holding level.
thesis.main_shareholders: Katarzyna Monika Nikodemska: 19,810,000 shares = 80.49% of shares and 81.10% of votes (only holder above 5%) per the Q3 2025 interim report ([Grempco Q3 2025 report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/173334-grempco-iiiq2025.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder owns ~80.5%, leaving ~19.5% free float and very thin liquidity ([Grempco Q3 2025 report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/173334-grempco-iiiq2025.pdf)). Single-member management board (Dorota Sumislawska is also reported to chair the supervisory board in a 2023 report), a governance concentration. Value depends on unlisted subsidiaries; earnings can be mark-to-market gains rather than cash.
thesis.insider_ownership: Katarzyna Monika Nikodemska holds 80.49% (controlling shareholder; relation to management not established in sources) ([Grempco Q3 2025 report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/173334-grempco-iiiq2025.pdf)).

thesis.business_description: Chorzow-based Polish financial services firm offering factoring (disclosed and reverse), loans, receivables purchase and debt collection, aimed mainly at SMEs.
thesis.competitive_position: Small niche factoring/receivables-finance provider in Poland with no clear moat; it competes with bank factoring units and larger specialists ([Stockanalysis company profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/INS/company)). It has made venture-type co-investments (e.g. ADVISERO with LT Capital) ([Parkiet ESPI](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art27600341-indos-s-a-wspolna-inwestycja-indos-sa-oraz-lt-capital-w-spolke-advisero)). Aggregator data show 2025 revenue of about 22.1M (PLN), unverified against the company statements ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/INS/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: VAKaT Fundacja Rodzinna 2,224,166 shares (31.20% of capital, 19.21% of votes); Ireneusz Glensczyk together with RIVA Fundacja Rodzinna w organizacji 62.47% of shares and 76.89% of votes (table undated, latest entry 2025-06-03) ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/234961-indos); [Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/INDOS/akcjonariat)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling-holder dynamics: Glensczyk/RIVA group holds about 62% of shares but about 77% of votes (voting preference), and a family foundation (VAKaT) is also a large holder ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/234961-indos)). Exchange notices show a 'correction of prior-year results' dated 2025-07-21, content not retrieved ([Bankier ESPI list via search](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/INDOS/wyniki-finansowe)). Leverage-funded factoring business; Q1 2025 net profit fell to about PLN 62k from about PLN 548k ([Q1 2025 report](https://www.bankier.pl/static/att/ebi/2025-05/0000168222_202505150000159105.pdf)). No going-concern or auditor qualification found.
thesis.insider_ownership: Chair/founder-linked group (Ireneusz Glensczyk with RIVA Fundacja Rodzinna w organizacji) holds 62.47% of shares and 76.89% of votes per undated Parkiet table ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/234961-indos)); exact roles of each named holder not confirmed.

thesis.business_description: Warsaw-listed Polish book publisher (Muza S.A. group); books are the main revenue source, with a 50% interest in a children's publishing subsidiary.
thesis.competitive_position: Established Polish trade-book publisher with a recognised imprint but a shrinking top line in a small, fragmented market with no clear moat beyond author/catalogue rights. Consolidated 2025 revenue was PLN 42.4M vs PLN 46.1M in 2024, with operating profit of PLN 3.4M vs PLN 5.4M ([Bankier annual results](https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/MUZA-Wyniki-finansowe-RR-2025-9125545.html)); H1 2025 group revenue fell to PLN 19.0M from PLN 23.5M ([H1 2025 management report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/52550354/DOC.20250930.52550354.zal02_sprawozdanie_zarzadu_srodrocznego_skonsolidowanego_sprawozdania_na_30062025_signed.pdf)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Malgorzata Czarzasty 880,007 shares (26.92%, entry dated Oct 2023) and Tomasz Skrok 447,501 shares (13.69%, April 2025) per [Stockwatch](https://www.stockwatch.pl/gpw/muza,akcjonariat,dane-finansowe.aspx); Muza S.A. treasury shares 52,489 (1.87%) per [Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/MUZA/akcjonariat). Percentages vary by date; verify in the latest annual report.
thesis.red_flags: Falling revenue (-8% in 2025) and operating profit down about 38% ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/MUZA-Wyniki-finansowe-RR-2025-9125545.html)); concentrated holders (two holders about 40%) and small float; largest shareholder and vice-president Malgorzata Czarzasty is the wife of the Sejm Marshal, i.e. a political-exposure and related-party perception factor ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/wiadomosci/MUZA)); Simply Wall St shows a 'new risk' flag in June 2026 ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/media/wse-mza/muza-shares/past)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Malgorzata Czarzasty (largest shareholder and vice-president) about 26.92% per [Stockwatch](https://www.stockwatch.pl/gpw/muza,akcjonariat,dane-finansowe.aspx) and [Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/wiadomosci/MUZA).

thesis.business_description: French (Malakoff) designer, producer and distributor of wood-heating products under the EO2 and PIKS brands, including wood pellets, densified logs and bulk pellets; about 76 employees.
thesis.competitive_position: Niche French wood-pellet and biomass heating distributor with a regional brand and distribution footprint, but exposed to winter weather and pellet price swings; no clear moat ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/epa/ALEO2/company)). FY2025-26 revenue reached EUR 35.6M (vs 30.2M, +18%) with positive EBITDA of EUR 2.2M, but a net group loss of EUR 1.3M versus EUR 93k loss a year earlier ([Boursorama/Actusnews, 2 Jul 2026](https://www.boursorama.com/bourse/actualites-amp/eo2-resultats-annuels-2025-2026-7f4a56862c20e9d6e8fbc2263fb5ce80)). Management wants to reduce weather exposure by growing energy services.
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Net loss widened to EUR 1.3M despite 18% revenue growth, and results depend on weather ([Boursorama](https://www.boursorama.com/bourse/actualites-amp/eo2-resultats-annuels-2025-2026-7f4a56862c20e9d6e8fbc2263fb5ce80)). Market cap only about EUR 6.5M with about 2.1M shares on Euronext Growth, implying thin liquidity ([Extraetf](https://extraetf.com/ch/stock-profile/FR0010465534)). Shareholder structure could not be verified, so concentration or controlling-holder risk is unknown.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Astileu (Bihor county, Romania) manufacturer of building materials - lime, red brick and roof tile, and classified under refractory products manufacturing (CAEN 2320) - listed on the BVB AeRO market; 1,447,266 shares outstanding.
thesis.competitive_position: Small regional Romanian building-materials/refractory producer with about 61-73 employees (sources differ) ([Termene.ro](https://termene.ro/firma/98716-HELIOS-SA), [Economedia](https://economedia.ro/?p=218858)). Local production and site resources are the only visible advantage; no evidence of a durable moat. Declining 2025 turnover (about -5.8%) per aggregators ([Termene.ro](https://termene.ro/firma/98716-HELIOS-SA)).
thesis.main_shareholders: DNTL Project SRL (Cluj-Napoca) about 79.4% ([Economedia](https://economedia.ro/?p=218858)); Paval Holding reported just under 6% ([ZF](https://www.zf.ro/burse-fonduri-mutuale/surpriza-fratii-paval-dedeman-fac-investitie-bursa-valori-bucuresti-22541173)); dates of both disclosures not confirmed.
thesis.red_flags: Controlled by DNTL Project SRL (about 79.4%), leaving a very small free float and weak liquidity on the AeRO market; the controlling holder's dynamics vs minorities are unverified. 2025 turnover fell about 5.8% ([Termene.ro](https://termene.ro/firma/98716-HELIOS-SA)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Riga (Latvia) healthcare provider (Latvijas Juras medicinas centrs, ticker LJM1R) running a hospital at Patversmes iela 23 and outpatient/inpatient services (specialist consultations, physiotherapy, rehabilitation, diagnostics); about 364 employees.
thesis.competitive_position: Small private hospital/clinic operator in Riga, historically a state enterprise formed from several Riga medical institutions, competing with larger Latvian health groups; no clear moat beyond licensed capacity and state-payer contracts. 2025 revenue was about EUR 10.29M (+1%) and profit about EUR 241k, vs EUR 10.19M and EUR 185k in 2024 and a EUR 624k loss in 2023 ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/mun/UOM/revenue); [Scoris](https://scoris.eu/company/LV/40003306807)); description per [LSM](https://www.lsm.lv/raksts/zinas/ekonomika/20.07.2026-veselibas-centru-apvienibai-lauj-iegut-izskirosu-ietekmi-par-latvijas-juras-medicinas-centru.a655645/).
thesis.main_shareholders: Ilze Birka 17.50% and Martins Birks 17.50% are listed as the largest shareholders in the company's 2025 Q4 report ([Nasdaq Baltic Q4 2025 report](https://nasdaqbaltic.com/market/upload/reports/ljm/2025_q4_lv_las.pdf)). AS Veselibas centru apvieniba has received Competition Council clearance to acquire decisive influence ([LSM, July 2026](https://www.lsm.lv/raksts/zinas/ekonomika/20.07.2026-veselibas-centru-apvienibai-lauj-iegut-izskirosu-ietekmi-par-latvijas-juras-medicinas-centru.a655645/)).
thesis.red_flags: Change of control in progress: the Competition Council allowed AS Veselibas centru apvieniba to gain decisive influence over LJMC in July 2026 ([LSM](https://www.lsm.lv/raksts/zinas/ekonomika/20.07.2026-veselibas-centru-apvienibai-lauj-iegut-izskirosu-ietekmi-par-latvijas-juras-medicinas-centru.a655645/)); very thin margins (about 2% net) and a loss in 2023 ([Scoris](https://scoris.eu/company/LV/40003306807)); articles of association rewritten at an EGM on 18 December 2025 ([FinancialReports](https://financialreports.eu/companies/latvijas-juras-medicinas-centrs)); Second List listing with limited liquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Madkom S.A. (Gdynia, Poland) supplies and integrates proprietary software (SIDAS brand) for document management, e-archives and budget planning in local government units, plus IT system integration, e-delivery and data security services, almost entirely in Poland.
thesis.competitive_position: Niche supplier to Polish public administration with a small, thinly traded NewConnect listing and no evidence of a structural moat beyond customer relationships and installed software ([Money.pl company profile](https://www.money.pl/gielda/spolki-gpw/plmadkm00019,o_firmie.html); [Parkiet on Qumak investment](https://www.parkiet.com/technologie/art21367001-qumak-inwestuje-w-spolke-z-newconnect)). Revenue is lumpy and tender-driven: FY2024 revenue was about PLN 16.2m, down roughly 42% from about PLN 27.7m in 2023 ([StockAnalysis income statement](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/MAD/financials/income-statement/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Revenue fell about 42% in FY2024 ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/MAD/financials/income-statement/)); dependence on public-sector tenders and a thinly traded NewConnect listing ([Money.pl profile](https://www.money.pl/gielda/spolki-gpw/plmadkm00019,o_firmie.html)); a Supervisory Board change was announced and shareholding-change notifications were filed around April 2026, contents not verified ([Bankier ESPI](https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/MADKOM-Zmiana-na-stanowisku-Czlonka-Rady-Nadzorczej-MADKOM-SA-Madkom-Spolka-Akcyjna-8563657.html)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: ENENSYS Technologies SA (Cesson-Sevigne, near Rennes, France) supplies hardware and software for broadcast and media delivery; H1 2026 revenue EUR 5.9m (+20.8%), driven by the Media & Entertainment line.
thesis.competitive_position: Small French vendor in a niche technology market; H1 2026 results showed growth but a less favourable hardware-heavy mix, net loss of EUR 1.2m and EBITDA of EUR -0.8m ([AbcBourse](https://www.abcbourse.com/marches/enensys-technologies-renoue-avec-la-croissance-au-s1-2026-mais-la-rentabilite-r_703852)); net financial debt EUR 3.6m at 30 Jun 2026 versus EUR 4.9m at end-2025 ([Boursedirect](https://www.boursedirect.fr/fr/actualites/categorie/resultats/enensys-technologies-la-tresorerie-s-ameliore-au-1er-semestre-boursier-183dec60750f93c47ea8d171f0e840c8824b3af6)). IP-based product portfolio but no proven pricing power.
thesis.main_shareholders: Post-2021 restructuring (7,771,375 shares): Regis Le Roux, Iona Ventures, INN6 and SCI Factory FAC143 together 3,932,856 shares = 50.6%; bondholders about 17.2%; other shareholders about 30.8% ([AMF filing Nov 2021](https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/AMF/ACT/2021/11/FCACT057891_20211123.pdf)). Easybourse later shows founders 8.02% and free float 41.91% (basis unclear) ([Easybourse](https://www.easybourse.com/action-societe/enensys/profil/FR0013330792-25)); current figures should be confirmed against the 2025 annual report.
thesis.red_flags: Loss-making with negative EBITDA in H1 2026 and net financial debt of EUR 3.6m against thin equity; history of court-supervised restructuring in 2021 at Rennes commercial court (a business directory still shows 'collective procedure in progress', possibly stale) ([Journal des Entreprises](https://www.lejournaldesentreprises.com/entreprise/enensys-technologies)); founder-controlled with bondholders as a block; Euronext Growth liquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: Regis Le Roux (founder) and related vehicles held 50.6% together with other group vehicles after the 2021 capital operations; Iona Ventures (linked to Le Roux) bought EUR 170,967 of shares on 11 Oct 2024 (AbcBourse insider data).

thesis.business_description: Platige Image S.A. (Warsaw) is a Polish studio producing 3D animation, visual effects, cinematics and film/TV content (EMIS classifies it as motion-picture and video production); revenue was about PLN 151m in 2024 and PLN 151m TTM to Q3 2025 ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/PLI/revenue/); [EMIS](https://www.emis.cn/php/company-profile/PL/Platige_Image_SA_en_3633251.html)). Customers are largely international clients (not confirmed in sources).
thesis.competitive_position: A well-known Polish VFX/animation studio with founder-led creative talent (founders Sawko, Sikora and Baginski remain shareholders), giving a reputation-based niche in cinematics and VFX. Moat is human capital and portfolio, not structural; project-based revenue is lumpy and hiring costs are sensitive to the production market. Q3 2025 revenue was PLN 33.2m (+10.2% y/y) ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/PLI/revenue/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Total 3,529,420 shares / 5,389,420 votes. Jaroslaw Sawko via Moonlight Fundacja Rodzinna: 997,369 shares (28.25%), 1,827,369 votes (33.90%); Piotr Sikora via family foundation: 885,744 shares (25.09%), 1,715,744 votes (31.83%) ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/spolka/Platige_Image)); AGM list for 30 June 2026 ([Parkiet ESPI](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art44742451-platige-image-spolka-akcyjna-wykaz-akcjonariuszy-posiadajacych-co-najmniej-5-liczby-glosow-na-zwyczajnym-walnym-zgromadzeniu-platige-image-s-a-w-dniu-30-czerwca-2026-roku)); Tomasz Baginski ~7.27% of capital ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/media/wse-pli/platige-image-shares/ownership)).
thesis.red_flags: Control concentrated in two founder foundations (about 66% of votes combined) with preference-voting shares (5.39m votes on 3.53m shares), leaving minority holders little influence; project-based, lumpy revenue; micro-cap liquidity (market cap USD ~6.8m vs revenue ~PLN 150m). An extraordinary general meeting list of 5% holders was filed in autumn 2026 ([BiznesRadar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/151048,platige-image-sa-10-2026-wykaz-akcjonariuszy-posiadajacych-co-najmniej-5-liczby-glosow-na-nadzwyczajnym-walnym-zgromadzeniu-plat)) - purpose not verified.
thesis.insider_ownership: Founders Jaroslaw Sawko (33.90% of votes) and Piotr Sikora (31.83% of votes) hold through family foundations; Tomasz Baginski ~7.27% of capital (sources above).

thesis.business_description: Finnish training, coaching and leadership/sales-development firm; FY2025 net sales about EUR 8.4m and H1 2026 net sales EUR 4.3m (-5.0%) with operating result EUR 0.2m ([Inderes/H1 2026 report](https://www.inderes.fi/en/releases/trainers-house-group-half-year-report-1-january-30-june-2026)); operates mainly in Finland.
thesis.competitive_position: Niche Finnish expertise-services provider with a founder-brand (Jari Sarasvuo) in a fragmented, cyclical training market; H1 2026 sales fell 5.0% and Q2 fell 6.5%, though the company secured assignments worth over EUR 1m in June ([report](https://www.inderes.fi/en/releases/trainers-house-group-half-year-report-1-january-30-june-2026)). It has a strong balance sheet (equity ratio 69.3%, interest-bearing debt EUR 0.3m) but no structural moat beyond brand and relationships.
thesis.main_shareholders: Jari Sarasvuo about 34.2% of capital and votes; Saku Keskitalo about 4.0% per Inderes (Millistream data, around 2024) ([Inderes ownership](https://www.inderes.fi/en/companies/Trainers-House/ownership)); an interview puts Sarasvuo at 39% (undated) ([Yrittajat](https://www.yrittajat.fi/uutiset/sarasvuo-kasvatan-taas-varallisuuttani/)). A holder group with about 44.9% of votes backed the 2026 board slate ([Inderes AGM notice](https://www.inderes.fi/releases/kutsu-trainers-house-oyjn-varsinaiseen-yhtiokokoukseen-7)).
thesis.red_flags: Declining sales and thin operating result; 2026 guidance for operating result is only EUR 0.0-0.5m ([H1 2026 report](https://www.inderes.fi/en/releases/trainers-house-group-half-year-report-1-january-30-june-2026)). Founder/blockholder control (about 34-39% plus aligned holders at 44.9% of votes) and small free float. Dependence on the founder's brand.
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder Jari Sarasvuo about 34.2% (Inderes, ~2024; 39% in an undated interview) and board member re-elected 25 Mar 2026; board member Aarne Aktan holds via Great Expectations Capital Oy (stake size not found) ([Inderes AGM resolutions](https://www.inderes.fi/en/releases/resolutions-of-the-annual-general-meeting-of-trainers-house-plc-3)).

thesis.business_description: DGA S.A. (Poznan) is a consulting-investment company advising private firms and state/local-government bodies (business and transaction advisory, EU-funds acquisition) while also holding capital investments in listed companies and bonds; operations are in Poland.
thesis.competitive_position: A small Polish advisory niche with no evident moat; FY2024 revenue was only about PLN 2.32m, down 76% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/commercial-services/wse-dga/dga-spolka-akcyjna-shares/past)), and part of the value is investment assets such as an 8.14% stake in PTWP S.A. ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/new-connect/PTWP/akcjonariat)). A May 2026 current report describes a review of strategic options, including moving the advisory business into a new wholly-owned limited-liability company to separate it from investment assets ([Parkiet/ESPI](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art44420341-dga-sa-informacja-dotyczaca-procesu-przegladu-opcji-strategicznych)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Holders above 5% per exchange notifications: Jaroslaw Glowinkowski 5.01% (56,613 shares; crossed 5% on 30 Jul 2025) ([Stockwatch](https://www.stockwatch.pl/gpw/dga,akcjonariat,dane-finansowe.aspx); [Bankier ESPI](https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/DGA-Zawiadomienie-o-przekroczeniu-progu-5-ogolnej-liczby-glosow-w-Spolce-8986447.html)); Arkadiusz Pychinski 5.14% (58,100 shares per KDPW identification of 17 Jul 2025, company's knowledge) ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art42791901-dga-sa-zawiadomienie-o-zejsciu-ponizej-progu-5-ogolnej-liczby-glosow-w-spolce)). Stockwatch shows a named-holder total of 55.15% (623,239 shares) but the full table was not retrievable.
thesis.red_flags: Revenue collapse (-76% in FY2024); a strategic-options review with possible carve-out of the advisory business (May 2026 ESPI); very small free float among a dispersed register (largest named holders only about 5%); a 2026 AGM notice indicates minority shareholders have no supervisory-board representative ([financialreports.eu](https://financialreports.eu/filings/dga/agm-information/2026/48077250/)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (management shareholdings not found in search results; CEO listed by Biznesradar as Andrzej Glowacki, no stake found).

thesis.business_description: Bigben Interactive S.A. (France) is the parent of Nacon (video-game publishing and gaming accessories) and also sells mobile, audio and gaming accessories, holding 56.72% of Nacon's capital and 68.74% of its voting rights at 31 August 2026.
thesis.competitive_position: Historically a European consumer-accessories and gaming group, but its value is now largely tied to Nacon, which has itself been in judicial reorganisation since 2 March 2026, and Bigben's own restructuring depends on adoption of Nacon's plan ([Fortuneo - Nacon update](https://bourse.fortuneo.fr/actualites/nacon-fait-le-point-sur-la-procedure-de-redressement-judiciaire-1258243); [Option Finance](https://www.optionfinance.fr/info-financiere-en-continu/d/2026-09-22-bigben-avance-dans-sa-restructuration-financiere.html)). No durable moat is evident under distress; press reports EUR 395m of losses ([TradingSat](https://www.tradingsat.com/bigben-interactive-FR0000074072/actualites/bigben-interactive-395-millions-d-euros-de-pertes-et-des-actionnaires-bientot-ecrases-le-geant-francais-des-accessoires-de-jeu-video-bigben-joue-sa-survie-1171977.html)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Nord Sumatra Investissements (Bolloré-controlled) about 21.72% and Alain Falc about 14.06%, free float about 64%, per an undated AbcBourse profile ([AbcBourse](https://www.abcbourse.com/analyses/chiffres/BIGp)); these stakes are expected to be heavily diluted by the restructuring.
thesis.red_flags: Accelerated safeguard procedure (procédure de sauvegarde accélérée) opened 17 Aug 2026, extended to 17 Dec with a plan hearing on 9 Dec ([Fortuneo](https://bourse.fortuneo.fr/actualites/nacon-fait-le-point-sur-la-procedure-de-redressement-judiciaire-1258243)); debt-to-equity conversion and fresh-money capital increase (EUR 31m at Nacon, Bigben contributing EUR 16m and converting about EUR 19.5m of intragroup claims) mean massive dilution for existing shareholders ([Option Finance](https://www.optionfinance.fr/info-financiere-en-continu/d/2026-09-22-nacon-detaille-un-projet-entrainant-une-dilution-massive.html)); equity figure in the input (USD 366m) is likely stale given reported losses; Nacon suspended trading and filed for insolvency in Feb-Mar 2026 ([ABC Bourse](https://www.abcbourse.com/forums/msg1095193_nacon-fait-suspendre-la-cotation-de-ses-actions)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Alain Falc about 14.06% (undated AbcBourse profile) ([AbcBourse](https://www.abcbourse.com/analyses/chiffres/BIGp)); Maxime Falc not verified.

thesis.business_description: Warsaw-based IT services and system-integration company (listed since 2004; branches in Lublin and Poznan) serving banking, insurance, telecom, industry and government clients in Poland.
thesis.competitive_position: Mid-sized Polish IT integrator and reseller-partner (e.g. IFS, Quest, Fortinet partner directories) competing with much larger integrators; the moat is vendor certifications and long-term enterprise client relationships rather than proprietary technology ([IFS partner page](https://www.ifs.com/en/partners/find-a-partner/betacom), [money.pl profile](https://www.money.pl/gielda/spolki-gpw/plbtcom00016,o_firmie.html)). Consolidated 2025 revenue fell to PLN 146.7M from PLN 190.6M with net profit of PLN 1.36M (PLN 1.57M in 2024), i.e. a thin margin ([Bankier results](https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/BETACOM-wyniki-finansowe-9000191.html)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Marek Szewczyk about 24.27% (980,480 shares) ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/notowania/spolki/PLBTCOM00016/akcjonariat)); Jarosław Gutkiewicz about 9.99%; Antonio Zaragoza about 5.31%; Robert Frechowicz (president) about 11% ([money.pl company profile](https://www.money.pl/gielda/spolki-gpw/plbtcom00016,o_firmie.html); [Stockwatch](https://www.stockwatch.pl/gpw/Betacom,akcjonariat,dane-finansowe.aspx)). Some entries date from 2023, so current stakes should be checked.
thesis.red_flags: Revenue fell about 23% in 2025 and the group posted a net loss of PLN 358k in H1 2025 (vs a PLN 1,042k profit) ([Bankier / ESPI results](https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/BETACOM-wyniki-finansowe-9000191.html)); very thin net margin (about 0.9%). Concentrated shareholder base and low liquidity on the main market.
thesis.insider_ownership: President Robert Frechowicz about 11% per [money.pl](https://www.money.pl/gielda/spolki-gpw/plbtcom00016,o_firmie.html); Marek Szewczyk 24.27% (role not confirmed) per [Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/notowania/spolki/PLBTCOM00016/akcjonariat).

thesis.business_description: Computer Peripherals International S.A. (CPI, Athens; ticker SPI/CPI) distributes information-technology products and computer peripherals via a network of dealers and resellers in Greece, Cyprus and the Balkans; founded 1995 and listed on ATHEX since December 2000 ([ATHEX company profile](https://www.athexgroup.gr/company-profile/-/select-company/856)). FY ends 30 June; FY2025 revenue about EUR 18.8m ([FinancialFilings](https://financialfilings.com/companies/cpi-computer-peripherals-internal/)).
thesis.competitive_position: A small Greek IT distributor with a regional dealer network but no moat: low-margin distribution in a market dominated by larger vendors/distributors. Management describes a 'Revenue Decline and Corporate Transformation' year in FY2025 with a shift toward services and reduced operating costs ([ATHEX announcement](https://athens.euronext.com/en/node/962054)); FY2025 net loss about EUR 0.46m (EUR -0.043/share) vs a small profit in FY2024 ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/ko/stocks/gr/tech/ath-cpi/cpi-computer-peripherals-international-shares/past)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Simply Wall St (about Feb 2026): Bansara Ltd 25.4%, Aristides Papathanos 14.6%, Anastasios Michail 9.02% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gr/tech/ath-cpi/cpi-computer-peripherals-international-shares/ownership)); not cross-checked against the annual report or HCMC notifications.
thesis.red_flags: Revenue decline and loss in FY2025; thin equity (about EUR 2.6m on EUR 12.4m assets, i.e. high leverage, [FinancialFilings](https://financialfilings.com/companies/cpi-computer-peripherals-internal/)); no dividend; small-cap liquidity and concentrated holders (top 3 about 49%); ongoing restructuring. No going-concern or auditor-qualification wording found.
thesis.insider_ownership: Aristides (Aris) Papathanos 14.6% per Simply Wall St (CEO named Aris Papathanos in the results release; identity match not fully confirmed); executives hold stock options under a plan (118,300 new shares issued Sept 2023, [ATHEX bulletin](https://www.athexgroup.gr/en/more-options/announcements/securities-market-information-bulletin-05092023)).

thesis.business_description: Bucharest-based road goods transport company (Romania and abroad) that now earns significant income from property rental; 2025 revenue was about RON 1.15m with 7-13 employees (sources conflict).
