thesis.competitive_position: Marginal road-haulage operator with no subsidiaries ([Q1 2026 report](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/TRGI/TRGI_20260529135553_Raport-trimestrial-trimestrul-I-2026.pdf)) whose value appears to rest on real estate rather than operations; an older ASF-linked document notes significant rental income ([ASF](https://www.asfromania.ro/uploads/articole/attachments/6364edcb7454e837323950.pdf)). Q1 2026 turnover was RON 310,097 (+8.87% y/y). No moat.
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: A single holder reportedly controls 92.6721% (name not seen) ([EMIS](https://www.emis.cn/php/company-profile/RO/Transporturi_Auto_Giulesti_SA_en_1498797.html)), leaving a free float of about 7%; EGM called for 10/11 Dec 2026 includes a proposed sale of a property ([BVB](https://m.bvb.ro/FinancialInstruments/SelectedData/NewsItem/TRGI-Convocare-AGAE-10-11-decembrie-2026/C741F)); additional act no. 3 to a credit contract and an interim administrator appointed after the administrator resigned (2 July 2025) ([Tradeville](https://tradeville.ro/actiuni/TRGI/stiri)); no independent directors ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/ja/stocks/ro/transportation/bvb-trgi/sctransporturi-auto-giulesti-shares/management)); governance concentration and related-party/asset-sale risk.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

name: Casa de Bucovina - Club de Munte S.A.

thesis.business_description: Casa de Bucovina - Club de Munte S.A. (Romania) historically owned and ran a four-star hotel in Gura Humorului (operating since 2002) and tourism assets; it sold its hotel/tourism business and other real estate and is now merging into another Longshield group company.
thesis.competitive_position: No ongoing competitive position: the hotel and tourism activity was transferred/sold (the 2025 annual report states completion of the sale of hotel-related assets, April 2024 approval to transfer the business) ([BVB annual report 2025](https://www.bvb.ro/infocont/infocont26/BCM_20260327152002_RO-Raport-financiar-anual-2025.pdf)). The company is being absorbed into Bucur S.A. together with Semrom Oltenia ([BVB EGM 29 Apr 2026](https://bvb.ro/infocont/infocont26/BCM_20260429175130_BCM-Raport-curent-hotarari-AGEA-29-04-2026-ro.pdf)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Longshield Investment Group S.A. 73.9772% of share capital and votes, per the board's H1 2026 report ([BVB H1 2026](https://www.bvb.ro/infocont/infocont26/BCM_20260828135406_BCM-RO-Raportare-sem-I-2026.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder (Longshield, about 74%) initiated the merger into Bucur S.A.; minority holders face exchange-ratio and delisting risk; operating business sold, so the company is effectively an asset shell; free float only about 26%.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (Petre-Florian Dinu is general manager/chairman; no personal stake found).

thesis.business_description: Tesgas S.A. (Grupa TSG; NewConnect/WSE) provides services for the natural gas sector in Poland, focused on investment projects in gas transmission and distribution networks.
thesis.competitive_position: Construction/engineering contractor for gas infrastructure, a project-based niche with customer concentration toward gas network operators; no moat evidenced in sources found ([Financialreports.eu](https://financialreports.eu/companies/tesgas-sa/?page=8), [SII company profile](https://www.sii.org.pl/static/img/003672/TESGAS_najwazniejsze_informacje.pdf)). 2025 annual report published April 2026 ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/wiadomosci/TSG)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Włodzimierz Kocik 35.15% of capital, Marzenna Kocik 32.92%, Piotr Majewski 7.44% - undated company profile, who also form the management board; current stakes unconfirmed ([SII company profile](https://www.sii.org.pl/static/img/003672/TESGAS_najwazniejsze_informacje.pdf)). A list of >=5% holders for the 30.06.2026 AGM exists but contents were not retrieved ([ESPI via Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art44735311-tesgas-spolka-akcyjna-wykaz-akcjonariuszy-posiadajacych-co-najmniej-5-liczby-glosow-na-zwyczajnym-walnym-zgromadzeniu-akcjonariuszy-tesgas-s-a-w-dniu-30-06-2026-r)).
thesis.red_flags: Going-concern headline: a MarketScreener item titled 'TESGAS Spolka Akcyjna Auditor Raises Going Concern Doubt' appears in search results (date not confirmed) ([MarketScreener](https://in.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/TESGAS-S-A-11194090/news/TESGAS-Sp-lka-Akcyjna-Auditor-Raises-Going-Concern-Doubt-34777089)). Controlling-family concentration (~68% held by Kocik family per undated profile) and management-owned; low NewConnect liquidity; project-based revenues.
thesis.insider_ownership: Włodzimierz Kocik 35.15%, Marzenna Kocik 32.92%, Piotr Majewski 7.44% (management board members; undated) ([SII company profile](https://www.sii.org.pl/static/img/003672/TESGAS_najwazniejsze_informacje.pdf)).

thesis.business_description: S.C. Bucur Obor S.A. (Bucharest) owns and leases the Bucur Obor commercial complex under the ALMO block in Bucharest and is controlled by One United Properties through BO Retail Invest SRL.
thesis.competitive_position: Retail property owner with rental income as the business (single-asset status not verified); no operating moat beyond the property and tenant base, and the 2022 control sale was priced at RON 8.918/share (RON 64.9m for 54.4351%) ([Economedia](https://economedia.ro/one-united-properties-a-finalizat-preluarea-bucur-obor-pentru-649-milioane-de-lei.html); [One United Properties](https://www.one.ro/en/blog/one-united-properties-announces-the-conclusion-of-an-acquisition-of-a-majority-stake-in-bucur-obor-s-a/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: BO Retail Invest SRL (controlled by One United Properties) 54.4351% since the Feb 2022 closing; Gelu Manea 16% per a 2021 report; current register not verified ([Economedia](https://economedia.ro/one-united-properties-a-finalizat-preluarea-bucur-obor-pentru-649-milioane-de-lei.html); [Economica.net](https://www.economica.net/one-united-properties-cumpara-complexul-comercial-bucur-obor-de-sub-celebrul-bloc-almo_544507.html/amp)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlled by a property developer (One United Properties) which financed the stake purchase via a loan to BO Retail Invest, creating related-party and minority-holder dynamics ([Economedia](https://economedia.ro/one-united-properties-a-finalizat-preluarea-bucur-obor-pentru-649-milioane-de-lei.html)); a share capital increase was filed in October 2025 and a shareholding-threshold notification dated 5 Aug 2026, contents not verified ([BVB BUCU Q3 2025 declaration](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/BUCU/BUCU_20251027155926_Declaratie-persoane-responsabile-situatii-TIII-2025.pdf); [BVB threshold notification](https://m.bvb.ro/FinancialInstruments/SelectedData/NewsItem/BUCU-Notificare-prag-detineri-vot/BC8FD)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Greek listed Venture Capital Company (E.K.E.S.) regulated as an Alternative Investment Fund manager under Law 4209/2013; its purpose under Law 2367/1995 is to take stakes in other companies. Founded 2014, listed on the Athens main market on 31 July 2018.
thesis.competitive_position: Tiny listed venture-capital vehicle (about 735k shares, market cap roughly EUR 5M); the first use of the VC-company structure on the Athens exchange, with returns depending on underlying portfolio holdings rather than a moat ([Athex issuer page](https://www.athexgroup.gr/en/market-data/issuers/1419); [Stockopedia](https://www.stockopedia.com/share-prices/cnl-capital-ekes-aifm-ATH:CNLCAP)). It pays regular distributions, including EUR 0.15 per share and a remaining 2025 dividend of EUR 110,128.50 ([Powergame](https://www.powergame.gr/epichirisis/1360850/cnl-capital-dianomi-ypoloipou-merismatos-chrisis-2025-ypsous-110-12850-evro/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Holders of 5% or more of voting rights per the Athens exchange issuer page (undated): Michail Stasinopoulos 12.75%; CNL AEDOEE 6.67%; CNL Capital E.K.E.S. - AIFM itself 6.30% (own shares); Orasis Fund SPC 6.13% ([Athex issuer page](https://www.athexgroup.gr/en/market-data/issuers/1419)).
thesis.red_flags: Very small free-float company with only about 735k shares and thin liquidity ([Stockopedia](https://www.stockopedia.com/share-prices/cnl-capital-ekes-aifm-ATH:CNLCAP)). Related-party structure: manager entity CNL AEDOEE is itself a 6.67% shareholder, and the company holds 6.30% of its own shares ([Athex issuer page](https://www.athexgroup.gr/en/market-data/issuers/1419)). Portfolio valuation (unlisted holdings) is judgement-based; no going-concern or auditor-qualification wording found in search results.
thesis.insider_ownership: CNL AEDOEE (affiliated manager) 6.67% and Michail Stasinopoulos 12.75% per Athex issuer page; whether Stasinopoulos is a director not confirmed ([Athex issuer page](https://www.athexgroup.gr/en/market-data/issuers/1419)).

thesis.business_description: Sibiu (Romania) electrical-power infrastructure contractor (high-voltage substations and transmission lines); signed two contracts with Transelectrica worth over RON 142m for grid expansion ([Economica](https://www.economica.net/electromontaj-carpati-a-semnat-cu-transelectrica-doua-contracte-in-valoare-de-peste-142-de-milioane-de-lei-pentru-extinderea-infrastructurii-de-transport-a-energiei-electrice_838380.html/amp)).
thesis.competitive_position: Established Romanian grid contractor, ranked third by turnover among 31 active Sibiu firms in its CAEN 4222 class in 2025 per a registry-based source ([Termene.ro](https://termene.ro/firma/790600)); dependent on public utility tenders such as Transelectrica. Moat limited to qualifications/track record; the shareholder dispute below clouds governance.
thesis.main_shareholders: Grampet Logistics (Gruia Stoica's Grampet Group) acquired the 70.06% block (230,216 shares) previously held by Romelectro for about RON 14m ([Puterea.ro](https://www.puterea.ro/?p=300509)); Grampet is described as majority shareholder ([Financial Intelligence](https://financialintelligence.ro/grampet-logistics-noul-proprietar-al-electromontaj-carpati-sibiu-acuza-consiliul-de-administratie-ca-incearca-sa-creeze-prejudicii-societatii-solicitand-insolventa-companiei/)). Remaining holders not found.
thesis.red_flags: Governance conflict: the board filed a request for opening general insolvency proceedings at Tribunalul Sibiu on 11 April 2024 ([BVB current report](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/ELJA/ELJA-RC_11042024_depunere_la_Tribunalul_Sibiu_a_unei_cereri_privind_deschiderea_procedurii_insolventei.pdf)), which Grampet, the new majority holder, contested, accusing the board of harming the company and suing to annul AGM decisions ([Financial Intelligence](https://financialintelligence.ro/grampet-logistics-noul-proprietar-al-electromontaj-carpati-sibiu-acuza-consiliul-de-administratie-ca-incearca-sa-creeze-prejudicii-societatii-solicitand-insolventa-companiei/)). Controlling-holder is linked to Grampet Group, which has faced insolvency pressures elsewhere (Grampet Cargo Austria bankruptcy per [RailwayPro](https://railwaypro.com/wp/grampet-cargo-austria-in-bankruptcy)). Competition Council reviewed the takeover ([Forbes Romania](https://www.forbes.ro/consiliul-concurentei-analizeaza-preluarea-electromontaj-carpati-de-catre-grampet-logistics-grup-controlat-de-omul-de-afaceri-gruia-stoica-373820)). Very small free float (~328.6k shares).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (Gruia Stoica controls Grampet Logistics, the 70.06% holder).

thesis.business_description: Polish debt-collection and receivables-management group (Kancelaria Prawna - Inkaso WEC S.A. with the WEC capital group) serving corporate creditors, with additional micro-factoring/receivables purchase activity; operates in Poland and is listed on NewConnect (ticker KPI/KANCELWEC).
thesis.competitive_position: Small niche player in the fragmented Polish debt-collection market, competing with much larger listed collectors (e.g. KRUK, Kredyt Inkaso); no evident moat beyond client relationships and legal-services know-how. Revenue was reported at roughly PLN 16.3M for 2025 (+15%) by a data aggregator ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/KPI/revenue/)), and management has pointed to micro-factoring as a growth line ([money.pl](https://www.money.pl/gielda/wiadomosci/artykul/kancelaria-prawna---inkaso-wec-liczy-na,233,0,2125289.html)). Share capital is PLN 988,200 in 0.10 PLN shares, i.e. about 9.88M shares ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/KANCELWEC/akcjonariat)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: NewConnect (alternative market) listing with very small float and thin liquidity; Bankier's ownership table shows only about 7.25% of capital as 'Pozostali' (others) i.e. the holding is highly concentrated in a few holders ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/KANCELWEC/akcjonariat)). Company ran a buyback tender in 2025/2026 (250,000 shares at PLN 4.00 per Biznesradar, with 8.84M shares tendered, implying heavy oversubscription and low liquidity) ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/155320,inkaso-wec-sa-8-2026-podsumowanie-skupu-akcji-wlasnych)). Aug-2025 threshold-crossing notification filed (holder not identified) ([money.pl](https://www.money.pl/gielda/spolki-gpw/plkpwec00015,emitent,1.html)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Pazardzhik (Bulgaria) manufacturer of lead-acid batteries, founded 1960 ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bul/ELHM/company)); 2025 revenue was about EUR 15.4m (-7%) with a loss of EUR 0.5m ([Capital.bg](https://www.capital.bg/biznes/promishlenost/2026/03/04/4888949_elhim-iskra_spira_rabota_i_sukrashtava_200_dushi/)), selling mainly into export markets including Italy and Germany.
thesis.competitive_position: Mid-sized regional battery producer without cost leadership: the company itself cited falling industrial production in key export markets (Italy, Germany), rising competition from Turkey, China and India, and high electricity and labour costs when suspending production ([Capital.bg](https://www.capital.bg/biznes/promishlenost/2026/03/04/4888949_elhim-iskra_spira_rabota_i_sukrashtava_200_dushi/); [FFBH](https://www.ffbham.bg/en/post/elhim-iskra-to-cease-business-operations-negative--177278865627794)). Monthly sales fell double digits y/y through 2024-25 (e.g. Oct 2024 -34.8%) ([FFBH](https://www.ffbham.bg/en/post/elhim-iskra-s-oct-24-sales-were-down-34-8-yoy-management-projects-38-8-yoy-decline-in-nov-24-revenue-negative--173253071598918)). No durable moat.
thesis.main_shareholders: Stara Planina Hold AD is the majority owner ([SeeNews](https://seenews.com/companies/elhim-iskra-ad-260); [ffbham](https://www.ffbham.bg/en/post/elhim-iskra-bod-plans-buying-9-74-of-international-asset-bank-158997941248582)); exact percentage not found in search results (see company annual report/BSE filings).
thesis.red_flags: Board announced suspension of production from 23 March 2026 with dismissal of about 200 employees ([Capital.bg](https://www.capital.bg/biznes/promishlenost/2026/03/04/4888949_elhim-iskra_spira_rabota_i_sukrashtava_200_dushi/); [Novinite](https://www.novinite.com/articles/237335/200+Employees+Out+of+a+Job%3A+Battery+Manufacturer+Closure+Signals+Broader+Struggles+for+Bulgarian+Manufacturing)); on 17 April 2026 the board adopted a business restructuring plan to limit continuing losses ([FFBH](https://www.ffbham.bg/en/post/elhim-iskra-adopted-a-business-restructuring-plan-positive--177641039769015)). Continuing net losses, collapsing sales, controlling-holder group structure (Stara Planina Hold, related-party stakes such as International Asset Bank). 2024 capital-increase proposal up to BGN 110m ([SeeNews](https://SeeNews.com/news/elhim-iskra-plans-to-skip-dividend-for-2023-raise-capital-852953)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (board-member stake changes reported by [SeeNews](https://seenews.com/news/board-member-grows-stake-in-bulgarias-elhim-iskra-695789); amounts not retrieved).

thesis.business_description: S.C. Tusnad S.A. (Baile Tusnad, Romania; incorporated 1993) operates hotels and balneary/treatment facilities in the Baile Tusnad resort (Tusnad Hotel, O3zone hotel complex, treatment base), i.e. a tourism/HoReCa business in Romania.
thesis.competitive_position: Regional spa-resort hotel operator with a handful of owned properties; no evident moat beyond asset ownership and location, and results are small and thin (FY2025 revenue about RON 25.6m, Q1 2026 revenue RON 4.92m, down 11.3%, with trailing losses) ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/TSND/statistics/); [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/ro/consumer-services/bvb-tsnd/sc-tusnad-shares/past)). Shareholders approved the sale of the main hotel assets, so value depends on disposal prices rather than operating franchise ([RHN](https://rhn.ro/en/hotels-in-timisoara-and-baile-tusnad-put-up-for-sale/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Transilvania Investments Alliance (TRANSI, formerly SIF Transilvania) is described as majority shareholder, reported at 76.41% of capital ([Profit.ro](https://www.profit.ro/profitul-tau/oferta-pe-piata-cu-trecere-pe-linie-moarta-a-tusnad-sa-hoteluri-si-o-baza-de-tratament-la-vanzare-ce-spune-conducerea-fostei-sif-transilvania-despre-miscarile-de-iesire-22317134)); earlier reports gave SIF Transilvania 64.91% and SIF Oltenia 17.33%, and SIF Oltenia offered its 8.57% (25.86m shares) for sale at RON 0.11/share ([Profit.ro](https://profit.ro/povesti-cu-profit/financiar/piata-de-capital/dupa-o-vanzare-in-domeniul-hotelier-la-baile-felix-sif-oltenia-vrea-o-mutare-similara-la-baile-tusnad-21093287)). The 76.41% figure should be checked against the FY2025 annual report ([BVB](https://www.bvb.ro/info/Raportari/TSND/TSND_20260327174234_Raport-anual-2025.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder (TRANSI) drives strategy: the EGM it requested approved sale of the Tusnad Hotel (216 rooms), O3zone complex and treatment base, which could leave a shell or lead to liquidation/distribution ([RHN](https://rhn.ro/en/hotels-in-timisoara-and-baile-tusnad-put-up-for-sale/)). Loss-making on a trailing basis and no dividend history; one data provider notes no independent directors on the board ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/ro/consumer-services/bvb-tsnd/sc-tusnad-shares/health)). Small free float on BVB AeRO market.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (CEO ownership shown as n/a by Simply Wall St; management holdings not seen in sources)

thesis.business_description: Groupe JAJ (formerly JAJ Distribution; Montreuil, France) designs and distributes clothing, principally the SCHOTT brand, in France and for export; sales were EUR 28.8m in FY2023-24.
thesis.competitive_position: Family-controlled French apparel brand owner; Schott is a niche heritage workwear/outerwear label with a small distribution footprint and no verified moat ([StockAnalysis profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/epa/GJAJ/company); [Financialreports.eu](https://financialreports.eu/companies/groupe-jaj/)). FY2023-24 sales were EUR 28.78m (-8.8%) and H2 2024-25 sales EUR 11.88m (-12.3%), then nine-month 2025-26 sales rebounded to EUR 27.35m (+24.6%) with export growth ([Boursedirect, 9M 2025-26](https://www.boursedirect.fr/fr/actualites/categorie/divers/groupe-jaj-nette-amelioration-du-chiffre-d-affaires-sur-l-exercice-2025-2026-boursier-4ed34a10ddfed6bbf0ad6d38e0e3975f7f9eaa5f)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Historic AMF-reported holders: Maurice Jablonsky 39.17% and Joseph Jablonski 10.56% (2018 notice); after Joseph's death in 2019 the estate was treated as controlling, and a January 2026 AMF notice says the successional estate was dissolved, ending concert action among family members who now hold stakes individually (current percentages not verified) ([AMF notice 30 Jan 2026](https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/AMF/307/8888/01/FC307612285_20260130.pdf); [AMF notice 9 Jan 2019](https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/AMF/307/2019/01/FC307266698_20190109.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Founding-family control with an estate dissolution in January 2026 introduces succession and potential disposal risk ([AMF notice 30 Jan 2026](https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/AMF/307/8888/01/FC307612285_20260130.pdf)); volatile sales (-8.8% in FY2023-24, -12.3% in H2 2024-25, then +24.6%) ([Boursedirect](https://www.boursedirect.fr/fr/actualites/categorie/divers/groupe-jaj-nette-amelioration-du-chiffre-d-affaires-sur-l-exercice-2025-2026-boursier-4ed34a10ddfed6bbf0ad6d38e0e3975f7f9eaa5f)); small-cap Euronext liquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: Jablonski family members (Maurice Jablonsky, Joseph Jablonski's heirs, including Mathieu, Alain and Michel Jablonski) are the controlling/insider holders; the 2026 AMF notice lists individual family holdings of roughly 1% or less for several members ([AMF notice 30 Jan 2026](https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/AMF/307/8888/01/FC307612285_20260130.pdf)).

thesis.business_description: Roman, Neamt County (Romania) miller and bakery producer of flour and bread products; listed on BVB since 1996, privatised in 1997.
thesis.competitive_position: Small regional mill/bakery with 2025 turnover of RON 14.15m (+2.8%) and profit of RON 381,376 ([Termene.ro](https://termene.ro/firma/2053818); [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/MORA/revenue/)); about 82-90 employees depending on source. Commodity-input, low-differentiation business without a visible moat beyond local distribution.
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Extremely illiquid micro-cap (4,560,602 shares) ([Primet](https://primet.ro/actiuni/MORA)); concentrated ownership: two unnamed holdings of 14.83% and 13.95% reported by a data vendor ([EMIS](https://www.emis.cn/php/company-profile/RO/Morarit_Panificatie_Roman_SA_en_1487968.html)); a threshold notification for an acquisition of financial instruments was filed 20 May 2026 (crossing 7 May 2026) ([BVB filing](https://www.bvb.ro/info/Raportari/MORA/MORA_20260520124824_Raportare-procent.pdf)), indicating possible change in control dynamics; equity is only USD 1.15m vs USD 5.0m market cap.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: MPL Verbum S.A. (Poznań, Poland) designs and runs loyalty and motivational programmes for businesses (products such as Sales Booster, Level Up, Cashback, Lead.me, Loyalty 3.0), mainly in Poland; fiscal year ends in April.
thesis.competitive_position: Small niche B2B loyalty/incentive programme provider with long client relationships (CEO Marcin Katański has led it since 2003) but no strong moat. FY2024/25 revenue was about PLN 37.5m (+19%) with net income of about PLN 1.07m; a PLN 0.21/share dividend was approved ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/media/wse-ver/mpl-verbum-shares/news/mpl-verbum-full-year-2025-earnings-eps-z044-vs-z040-in-fy-20/amp); [Stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/VER/revenue/); [Parkiet AGM notice](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art43125931-mpl-verbum-spolka-akcyjna-zwolanie-zwyczajnego-walnego-zgromadzenia-akcjonariuszy-mpl-verbum-s-a-na-dzien-30-pazdziernika-2025r)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Marcin Katański 1,131,550 shares = 46.29%; Tadeusz Zieliński 783,000 shares = 32.03% (last change dated 2021-03-17; about 78.3% combined) ([Bankier shareholders](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/MPLVERBUM/akcjonariat)).
thesis.red_flags: Two holders control about 78% (free float about 22%) and the register data is dated 2021, so current stakes are unverified; thin NewConnect liquidity; project-based, client-concentrated revenue (not quantified).
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Marcin Katański 46.29% of shares (about 50% of votes) per Bankier, dated 2021 ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/MPLVERBUM/akcjonariat)).

thesis.business_description: S.C. Confectii Vaslui S.A. (Vaslui, Romania; founded 1965, listed 1997 on the BVB AeRO market) produces men's, women's and children's clothing; an aggregator reports 2025 revenue of about RON 17.9m, profit RON 2.26m and 206 employees.
thesis.competitive_position: Small Romanian garment maker (customer mix and export share not verified), with no evident moat and exposure to wage inflation and import competition ([Termene.ro profile](https://termene.ro/en/firma/826992-CONFECTII-VASLUI-SA); [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/COVB/company)). Company has paid dividends and in 2026 moved to consolidate the nominal value of its shares ([BVB board decision 81/29.07.2026](https://m.bvb.ro/FinancialInstruments/SelectedData/NewsItem/COVB-Hotararea-CA-nr-81-29-07-2026-consolidarea-valorii-nominale-a-actiunilor/C7B34)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: A single holder controlled 43,078,620 voting shares = 61.63% of the 69,898,725 shares at a 2022 EGM (holder not named in the snippet), implying controlling-holder dynamics and limited free float ([BVB COVB EGM report 2022](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/COVB/COVB_20220630153617_AGEA-30-06-PDF.pdf)); nominal value consolidation planned in 2026 and ASF has previously objected to a similar consolidation proposal ([Profit.ro](https://profit.ro/povesti-cu-profit/financiar/piata-de-capital/asociatia-investitorilor-reclama-reactia-slaba-a-asf-in-cazul-consolidarii-actiunilor-la-confectii-vaslui-15452581)); AeRO is a low-liquidity market.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Swedish designer of rugged mobile computers (Vaxjo), listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market since 2002; H1 2026 net sales were SEK 58.2m (-23%), Q2 SEK 30.0m (39.8m), with an operating loss of SEK 1.4m and net loss of SEK 2.2m ([H1 2026 report](https://www.placera.se/pressmeddelanden/jlt-mobile-computers-jlt-mobile-computers-ab-publ-publishes-interim-report-for-januaryjune-2026-20260812)); largest segment is warehouse and logistics.
thesis.competitive_position: Niche rugged-computer vendor competing with much larger players; order intake in H1 2026 was SEK 49.7m vs 81.5m, indicating weak demand, and component supply/pricing (notably DDR4 memory) remains challenging per the Q1 2026 report ([placera H1 2026](https://www.placera.se/pressmeddelanden/jlt-mobile-computers-jlt-mobile-computers-ab-publ-publishes-interim-report-for-januaryjune-2026-20260812); [Affarsvarlden](https://www.affarsvarlden.se/analys/jlt-mobile-computers-dags-att-rygga-vd)). Moat limited to vertical-specific ruggedised product and reseller relationships.
thesis.main_shareholders: Founder Jan Olof Olofsson is the largest holder (25.3% of capital and votes per [Affarsvarlden](https://www.affarsvarlden.se/aktie/jlt-mobile-computers); an Affarsvarlden analysis cites about 23% after he sold 1.1m shares to the CEO); Martin Gren via Grenspecialisten 10.4%; CEO Per Holmberg about 6.4% ([Affarsvarlden analysis](https://www.affarsvarlden.se/analys/jlt-mobile-computers-dags-att-rygga-vd)). Hedge fund Alcur, formerly about 10%, sold its entire holding in 2025.
thesis.red_flags: Sales and order intake falling sharply in 2026 (net sales -23%, order intake -39% in H1) with the company loss-making ([H1 2026 report](https://www.placera.se/pressmeddelanden/jlt-mobile-computers-jlt-mobile-computers-ab-publ-publishes-interim-report-for-januaryjune-2026-20260812)); component-price pressure (DDR4); interim report unaudited; concentrated ownership (founder plus Gren about 33-36%) and an option for the CEO to buy a further 1.1m shares from the principal owner, indicating an ongoing ownership transition ([Inderes release](https://www.inderes.fi/en/releases/jlt-mobile-computers-ceo-acquires-shares-from-the-companys-principal-owner)).
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Per Holmberg about 6.4% after buying 1.1m shares from founder Olofsson on 30 Dec 2025, plus a call option for another 1.1m shares and 200,000 staff options expiring 2027 ([Inderes release](https://www.inderes.fi/en/releases/jlt-mobile-computers-ceo-acquires-shares-from-the-companys-principal-owner)); founder Jan Olof Olofsson about 23-25% ([Affarsvarlden](https://www.affarsvarlden.se/aktie/jlt-mobile-computers)).

thesis.business_description: Fletcher King Plc (AIM, UK) is a commercial property adviser through its operating subsidiary Fletcher King Services Limited, providing agency, investment, rating and consultancy services to property owners and occupiers.
thesis.competitive_position: Small independent UK property consultancy with no scale moat; year to 30 April 2026 revenue was GBP 3.47m (2025: 3.84m) and statutory profit before tax only GBP 2k (2025: 274k) ([Investegate](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/fletcher-king--flk/final-results/9810202)). The company proposes selling 50% of Fletcher King Services Limited to management for GBP 1.2m plus GBP 100k, with put/call options over the remaining 50% ([Investegate](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/fletcher-king--flk/final-results/9810202)).
thesis.main_shareholders: CM Strategic 613 Limited conditionally agreed to acquire about 24.8% in 2021 ([MarketScreener](https://uk.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/FLETCHER-KING-PLC-4001943/news/CM-STRATEGIC-613-LIMITED-conditionally-agreed-to-acquire-approximately-24-8-stake-in-Fletcher-King-36615564/)); a Holding(s) in Company notice was released 29 May 2026 ([LSE](https://www.lse.co.uk/rns/FLK/holdings-in-company-e5w3m7d0l75d4cj.html)); current holders not verified.
thesis.red_flags: Proposed disposal of the operating business to management (subject to shareholder approval) would leave a cash shell under a new board, with the final dividend dropped and a 20p special dividend paid post year-end ([Investegate](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/fletcher-king--flk/final-results/9810202)); related-party element (management buyer); earnings essentially breakeven.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: S.C. Comalex S.A. (Alexandria, Teleorman county, Romania) leases and subleases real estate; its fixed assets are essentially buildings and land, including a restaurant.
thesis.competitive_position: Small state-controlled property lessor with local assets; no operating moat. Its rental income depends on local tenants, and the 2022 quarterly report shows court cases to recover unpaid rent ([BVB annual report 2021](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/COKG/COKG-RA_2021.pdf), [BVB Q1 2022 report](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/COKG/COKG-%20Raport_Trim_1_2022.pdf)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Romanian State through AAAS (Authority for the Administration of State Assets): 305,836 shares = 53.67484% of 569,794 shares ([BVB annual report 2021](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/COKG/COKG-RA_2021.pdf); Q1 2026 report states State via AAAS 53.67%: [BVB Q1 2026](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/COKG/COKG_20260528125913_1-COMALEX-SA--Raport-BVB-Trimestrul-1-2026---f1.pdf)). Remaining 46.33% held by individuals and legal entities, none named.
thesis.red_flags: State (AAAS) control at 53.67% with frequent general meetings in 2026 (January, February, March, April, July, August and October) suggests governance/administration activity ([BVB news](https://m.bvb.ro/FinancialInstruments/SelectedData/NewsItem/COKG-Convocare-AGAO-26-10-2026/88D01)); tenant arrears litigation noted in 2022 ([BVB Q1 2022](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/COKG/COKG-%20Raport_Trim_1_2022.pdf)); very small equity base (USD 0.21M per input) against a market cap of several million USD; illiquid.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (board chairman Cosmin Liviu Nicola per October 2026 AGM resolutions; no personal stake disclosed) ([BVB](https://m.bvb.ro/FinancialInstruments/SelectedData/NewsItem/COKG-Hotarari-AGA-O-26-10-2026/1D698)).

thesis.business_description: Prodlacta is a Brasov (Romania) dairy processor selling milk and dairy products in the Romanian market; FY2024 revenue was about RON 159.6m (+19% y/y) per Moldovan press reporting on the company ([Logos Press](https://logos-pres.md/en/news/moldovan-jlc-has-made-it-into-the-top-10-dairy-companies-in-romania/)).
thesis.competitive_position: Mid-sized regional dairy processor owned by Moldova's JLC Group, ranked about tenth among Romanian dairy producers at end-2025 ([Logos Press](https://logos-pres.md/en/news/moldovan-jlc-has-made-it-into-the-top-10-dairy-companies-in-romania/)). It spent nearly EUR 1m on modernisation in 2024 (milk collection centres, solar panels) per the same source. Margins are thin: net income fell from RON 4.63m (2023) to RON 2.75m (2024) ([Stockopedia](https://www.stockopedia.com/share-prices/prodlacta-sa-BSE:PRAE/income-statement)) and the 2025 audit report shows a net result of RON 1.23m ([BVB annual report](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/PRAE/PRAE_20260416172015_PRODLACTA-RAPORT-ANUAL.pdf)); no evident moat beyond local brand/distribution and group backing.
thesis.main_shareholders: JLC Group (Moldova) took control in 2012 ([Logos Press](https://logos-pres.md/noutati/compania-moldoveneasca-jlc-a-intrat-in-top-10-al-companiilor-din-sectorul-lactatelor-din-romania/)); a 2014 Bursa.ro article citing BVB data put JLC at 58.55% via JLC Germany and JLC Chisinau (dated, current stake not verified in this research; an undated Bursa.ro item lists an employees' association at 39.94%). Current register: see [BVB 2025 annual report](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/PRAE/PRAE_20260416172015_PRODLACTA-RAPORT-ANUAL.pdf).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling-holder dynamics: JLC dominates and free float is small. The 20 May 2026 AGM did not reach quorum per the Tradeville filings feed ([Tradeville](https://tradeville.ro/actiuni/PRAE/stiri)). Profitability is thin (RON 1.23m net result on ~RON 160m revenue; equity ~RON 50.1m per the audit report) ([BVB](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/PRAE/PRAE_20260416172015_PRODLACTA-RAPORT-ANUAL.pdf)). Company went through a court reorganisation plan in the early 2010s ([Bursa.ro](https://www.bursa.ro/planul-de-reorganizare-al-prodlacta-ar-putea-fi-confirmat-abia-pe-12-noiembrie-81527814)). Listed on illiquid AeRO segment; sources give conflicting share counts (57.0m vs 60.3m).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (JLC Group is the controlling holder; management holdings not found).

thesis.business_description: Altur S.A. (Slatina, Olt, Romania) manufactures cast and machined aluminium components, mainly for the automotive sector; 2025 revenue about RON 108-111m and net profit about RON 0.94-0.97m.
thesis.competitive_position: Romanian aluminium foundry/machining supplier with thin margins and customer-driven demand: Q1 2026 revenue was RON 24.06m, down 17.49% ([Stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/ALT/revenue/)); 2025 net profit RON 967,167 versus a RON 1.34m budget on revenue of RON 110.96m versus RON 118.77m budget ([BVB annual report 2025](https://bvb.ro/infocont/infocont26/ALT_20260428171519_Raport-anual-2025.pdf); [Termene](https://termene.ro/firma/1520249-ALTUR-SA)). No evident moat beyond tooling and customer qualification.
thesis.main_shareholders: Latest named holders found are historical: after the capital increase to RON 53.73m, Mecanica Rotes (METY) 29.33% and SIF Oltenia 23.21% ([Wall-Street.ro](https://www.wall-street.ro/articol/Piete-de-capital/32527/altur-slatina-si-a-dublat-capitalul-social-la-53-73-milioane-lei.html)); SIF Oltenia has since fully exited ([Wall-Street.ro](https://www.wall-street.ro/articol/Piete-de-capital/33244/sif-oltenia-si-a-lichidat-detinerea-de-8-52-din-altur.html)); an earlier structure listed Mecanica Rotes 28.04%, Revan Com Galati 7%, Celule Electrice Bailesti 5.02%. Current 5% holders are in the H1 2026 report ([BVB](https://bvb.ro/infocont/infocont26/ALT_20260827181339_Raport-semestrul-I-2026.pdf)), not retrievable.
thesis.red_flags: Insolvency history: Capital.ro reported Altur 'enters insolvency' in 2022 ([Capital.ro](https://www.capital.ro/altur-sa-slatina-intra-in-insolventa-compania-a-avut-un-profit-de-peste-3-milioane-lei-in-primele-noua-luni-din-2022.html)) - current procedural status not verified; bond maturity extension filed on BVB (company-issued bonds); sharp Q1 2026 revenue decline (-17.5%); thin net margin (about 0.9%); concentrated historical ownership.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (a 2014 report mentioned executives buying shares in large amounts; no current figures found).

thesis.business_description: Jarocin (Poland) manufacturer of bituminous roofing/insulation membranes, being integrated into the Selena group after a 2025 takeover.
thesis.competitive_position: Polish producer of bituminous membranes; acquirer Selena FM (building chemicals group) bought it together with PHP TES, consolidating bituminous-membrane production ([Selena](https://selena.com/en/the-office-of-competition-and-consumer-protection-uokik-paved-the-way-for-the-selena-group-to-acquire-izolacja-jarocin-and-php-tes/)). Competitive position now depends on the parent; UOKiK cleared the concentration on 27 Aug 2025 ([Selena](https://selena.com/en/the-office-of-competition-and-consumer-protection-uokik-paved-the-way-for-the-selena-group-to-acquire-izolacja-jarocin-and-php-tes/)). Standalone moat limited.
thesis.main_shareholders: Selena Industrial Technologies sp. z o.o. (Selena FM group) 2,197,734 shares = 57.83% of capital and votes (of 3,800,000) per Parkiet shareholder table (undated) ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/235521-izolacja-jarocin)). Former main holders Tomasz Ignatowicz, Zofia Pietrus and Anna Inczewska agreed in June 2025 to sell their stake (51.03%) at PLN 3.50/share ([Selena](https://selena.com/en/announcement-by-the-management-board-of-the-selena-group-on-the-conclusion-of-an-agreement-to-acquire-by-way-of-a-tender-offer-the-shares-of-izolacja-jarocin-s-a-and-the-shares-in-php-tes-sp-z-o/)).
thesis.red_flags: New controlling holder (57.83%) has suggested possible withdrawal of the shares from regulated-market trading ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/art44197981-zmiany-w-izolacji-jarocin)); a May 2026 third-party profile flags very poor trading liquidity ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/IZO/)). Delisting/squeeze-out risk, though none formally announced in sources found.
thesis.insider_ownership: Founders/former insiders (Ignatowicz, Pietrus, Inczewska) sold out in Sep 2025 (Pietrus sold 398,240 shares = 10.48%, per [Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/wiadomosci/20250911/grupa-selena-rozliczenie-zlecenia-kupna-akcji-izolacja-jarocin-sa)); current management holdings not disclosed.

thesis.business_description: S.C. Electrometal S.A. is a Timisoara-based industrial company listed on the BVB AeRO-SMT market; the sources retrieved did not describe its product segments in detail.
thesis.competitive_position: Segment-level market position could not be verified from the sources retrieved, so no moat is claimed. The company is controlled by Tim-Cardenas SRL, which held about 87.8% in 2021 ([BVB current report, Apr 2021](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/EMTL/EMTL_20210427165525_raport-curent-AGEA-2021-27-aprilie.pdf)), and shareholders approved delisting in July 2026 ([BVB EGM report 13.07.2026](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/EMTL/EMTL_20260713160206_RAPORT-CURENT-AGEA-130726-1.pdf)).
thesis.main_shareholders: SC Tim-Cardenas SRL: 541,283 shares = 87.7992% (as of 2021, latest figure found; current stake unconfirmed) ([BVB current report, Apr 2021](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/EMTL/EMTL_20210427165525_raport-curent-AGEA-2021-27-aprilie.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Delisting: the EGM of 13 July 2026 (resolution no. 128) approved withdrawal of the shares from AeRO-SMT and their deregistration, with 95.1176% of share capital voting in favour and 0.0130% against; a price of 84.95 lei per share for exiting shareholders was approved based on an independent expert report ([BVB EGM report 13.07.2026](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/EMTL/EMTL_20260713160206_RAPORT-CURENT-AGEA-130726-1.pdf)). Another EGM was convened for 31.08.2026 ([BVB](https://m.bvb.ro/FinancialInstruments/SelectedData/NewsItem/EMTL-Convocare-AGAE-31-08-2026/44367)). Controlling-holder dynamics: ~88% held by one entity; minority liquidity minimal.
thesis.insider_ownership: Controlling holder Tim-Cardenas SRL ~87.8% (2021); individual management holdings not disclosed in sources found ([BVB](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/EMTL/EMTL_20210427165525_raport-curent-AGEA-2021-27-aprilie.pdf)).

thesis.business_description: e-Xim IT S.A. (Warsaw; NewConnect) designs, implements and supports ServiceNow-platform enterprise service management and digital-transformation projects for banking, insurance, telecom, industrial and commercial clients in Poland and abroad.
thesis.competitive_position: Specialist ServiceNow integrator with partners ServiceNow and Broadcom (CA Technologies); 2024 revenue was PLN 22.09M, up 27.4% from PLN 17.34M ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/EXM/), [Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/EXIMIT/akcjonariat)). Niche expertise rather than a hard moat; dependent on one vendor ecosystem. Control passed to Greek QnR Group in 2026 ([QnR announcement](https://www.qnr.com.gr/images/files/Announcements/2026/2026.07.07%20QNR%20ANNOUNCEMENT%20ON%20THE%20ACQUISITION%20OF%20E-XIM%20IT.pdf)).
thesis.main_shareholders: QnR Group (Greece): agreed 7 July 2026 to acquire a 51% controlling stake in e-Xim IT; completion status not confirmed ([QnR announcement](https://www.qnr.com.gr/images/files/Announcements/2026/2026.07.07%20QNR%20ANNOUNCEMENT%20ON%20THE%20ACQUISITION%20OF%20E-XIM%20IT.pdf), [Naftemporiki](https://www.naftemporiki.gr/english/2134850/qr-acquires-majority-stake-in-polands-e-xim-it-to-expand-regional-footprint/)). Szymon Czubek (via family foundation): 21.87% or 23.49% before the deal per Bankier ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/EXIMIT/akcjonariat)).
thesis.red_flags: Pending change of control: QnR 51% acquisition (July 2026) may trigger a mandatory tender offer or reduced free float; no tender terms found ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/149173,akcjonariusze-e-xim-it-sprzedaja-wiekszosciowy-pakiet-akcji-greckiej-grupie-technologicznej)). Founder/seller exits could cause key-person and staff retention risk; NewConnect liquidity is thin; dependence on ServiceNow partnership.
thesis.insider_ownership: Szymon Czubek (via family foundation in organisation) 21.87% or 23.49% before the QnR deal ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/EXIMIT/akcjonariat)).

thesis.business_description: Krakow-based IT company offering EDI integration, web EDI, e-invoicing and eCMR solutions for data exchange between businesses, operating mainly in Poland as the Polish arm of the Vienna-based EDITEL group.
thesis.competitive_position: Niche B2B data-exchange/e-invoicing provider; it is a member of the PEF Expert consortium, which provides services through the broker of Poland's Electronic Invoicing Platform ([EMIS/aggregated profile summary](https://www.emis.cn/php/company-profile/PL/EDITEL_SA_en_2010696.html)). Moat comes from integration with a group network and customer switching costs, but it is a very small company (about 24-26 employees per third-party data) ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/EDL/company)). Management describes 2025 as a return to growth after a 2024 slowdown ([2025 annual report](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-05/20260527_121911_0000002949_0000075786.pdf)).
thesis.main_shareholders: EDITEL Austria GmbH 90.20% (2,662,333 of 2,951,567 shares and votes) as of 31 Dec 2025; other shareholders 9.80% ([2025 annual report](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-05/20260527_121911_0000002949_0000075786.pdf)). Older Parkiet register shows IDE sp. z o.o. 2.98% (2012, likely stale) ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/232691-editel-polska)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling parent holds 90.20% of shares and votes, leaving about 9.8% free float (liquidity and minority-holder risk; the parent already took a majority stake of 89.43% on 19 June 2019) ([2025 annual report](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-05/20260527_121911_0000002949_0000075786.pdf)). Third-party sources disagree on whether the shares trade on NewConnect or the main GPW market.
thesis.insider_ownership: Controlling holder is the parent EDITEL Austria GmbH (90.20%); individual management holdings not disclosed in sources found.

thesis.business_description: Ekopol Górnośląski Holding S.A. (Piekary Śląskie, Poland) is a holding focused on fuel distribution (diesel, petrol) and liquid-fuel tank sales, with steel products and fuel-management technology, and since October 2025 a residential development subsidiary (Ekopol Górnośląski Domy).
thesis.competitive_position: Regional fuel distributor with low-margin, commodity-type trading and little visible moat; diversification into housing development is new and unproven ([Ekopol 2025 directors' report](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-05/20260528_090742_0000002984_0000076665.pdf)). Aggregator data show 2025 revenue of about PLN 230.6m (+11.3%), not verified against the audited statements ([Stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/EGH/revenue/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: CEO Andrzej Piecuch is shown at about 23.5% by a data vendor ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/ko/stocks/pl/capital-goods/wse-egh/ekopol-gornoslaski-holding-shares/management)); the company has 2,513,525 shares of which 1,207,900 are privileged ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/wiadomosci/EKOPOL,3)); full >5% list is in the FY2025 report and was not verified.
thesis.red_flags: Privileged shares (1,207,900 of 2,513,525) give outsized voting control to insiders; fuel-trading margins are thin and exposed to price/regulatory swings; new real-estate development line adds execution risk; very small NewConnect free float and liquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Andrzej Piecuch about 23.5% (third-party data, unverified) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/ko/stocks/pl/capital-goods/wse-egh/ekopol-gornoslaski-holding-shares/management)); supervisory board members and linked entities bought shares in Apr-Jul 2026 per exchange notices.

thesis.business_description: Gambero Rosso S.p.A. (Rome; Euronext Growth Milan) is an Italian publisher and media group in wine, food and travel: guides (wine, restaurants, bars), magazines, TV, events and education.
thesis.competitive_position: Established Italian food-and-wine brand and guide franchise (Tre Bicchieri, Tre Forchette) with first-half 2026 revenue of EUR 7.14M, down 4% ([SoldiOnline](https://www.soldionline.it/notizie/azioni-italia/conti-gambero-rosso-primo-semestre-2026), [Milano Finanza](https://www.milanofinanza.it/news/gambero-rosso-nel-semestre-ebitda-76-2719019)). Brand is a moat of sorts, but the media and publishing business is small and shrinking in print; in September 2026 BolognaFiere took a stake in the control vehicle ([Borsa Italiana / Teleborsa](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsa/notizie/teleborsa/finanza/bolognafiere-e-class-editori-partnership-industriale-e-azionaria-per-gambero-rosso-201_2026-09-11_TLB.html?lang=it)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Class Editori: about 61.17% before the September 2026 deal (51.17% = 7,394,050 shares contributed to Gambero Rosso Holding plus 10% held directly); BolognaFiere acquired 49.9% of GR Holding (Class keeps 50.1% and a direct 10% stake) ([Borsa Italiana / Teleborsa](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsa/notizie/teleborsa/finanza/bolognafiere-e-class-editori-partnership-industriale-e-azionaria-per-gambero-rosso-201_2026-09-11_TLB.html?lang=it), [ItaliaOggi](https://www.italiaoggi.it/marketing-e-media/marketing/gambero-rosso-partnership-class-editori-bologna-fiere-oinbnye0)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling-holder dynamics: Class Editori (itself a small listed publisher) controls through GR Holding; BolognaFiere gets three of 12 board seats, a shift in governance ([Teleborsa](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsa/notizie/teleborsa/finanza/bolognafiere-e-class-editori-partnership-industriale-e-azionaria-per-gambero-rosso-201_2026-09-11_TLB.html?lang=it)). Revenue down 4% in H1 2026; Euronext Growth Milan liquidity is thin. Class group history of earlier sale of a 20% stake in Gambero Rosso to Pegaso ([Gambero Rosso](https://static.gamberorosso.it/comunicato-class-inerente-la-cessione-del-20-di-gambero-rosso-spa-a-pegaso.pdf)). Net debt and going-concern wording not retrieved.
thesis.insider_ownership: Controlled by Class Editori group (about 61.17% pre-deal); individual management holdings not disclosed.

thesis.business_description: Warsaw-based technology company in sourcing and e-procurement, with a B2B purchasing platform for companies and public administration, listed on NewConnect; subsidiaries include IQmatica and Select8 (formerly Zingflow).
thesis.competitive_position: Niche Polish e-procurement software vendor positioning on an 'AI-first' strategy ([TradingView](https://pl.tradingview.com/chart/LGT/vuKaCVVO/)); small scale (2024 revenue about 9.81M per [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/LGT/), about 17 employees). Moat is limited to platform/customer lock-in; no evidence found of dominant market share. Company describes itself as active in sourcing and e-procurement ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/software/wse-lgt/logintrade-shares/information)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Per Bankier shareholder table (holding dates 2013 and 2015, possibly stale): Marta Wudarzewska 25.41% of shares / 30.79% of votes; Michal Szlachcic 18.99% / 22.92%; Wlodzimierz Wudarzewski 18.85% / 22.83%; together 63.25% of shares and 76.54% of votes of 5,009,025 shares / 8,269,415 votes ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/LGTRADE/akcjonariat)). The company published an updated 5%+ list for the 30 June 2026 AGM, but its content could not be retrieved ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art44746661-logintrade-spolka-akcyjna-wykaz-akcjonariuszy-posiadajacych-co-najmniej-5-glosow-na-zwyczajnym-walnym-zgromadzeniu-logintrade-s-a-w-dniu-30-czerwca-2026-r)).
thesis.red_flags: Voting power concentrated in three holders (about 76.5% of votes per Bankier, dated 2013-2015 data) via preferred voting shares (8.27M votes vs 5.01M shares), so minority holders have limited influence ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/LGTRADE/akcjonariat)). Small NewConnect issuer with limited liquidity; current holder percentages unverified.
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder family: Marta and Wlodzimierz Wudarzewski hold about 25.4% and 18.9% of shares per Bankier (dated 2013), and Tomasz Wudarzewski is CEO per [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/LGT/); Michal Szlachcic 18.99% (2015). Current figures unverified.

thesis.business_description: Zielona Gora-based (founded 1989) manufacturer of lighting fixtures/luminaires, exporting mainly to European countries; listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange.
thesis.competitive_position: Mid-sized Polish luminaire maker competing with large international lighting groups and Asian imports; no clear moat beyond manufacturing know-how and customer relationships. 2025 total revenue was reported at PLN 180.7M ([FinancialFilings](https://financialfilings.com/companies/lug-spolka-akcyjna/)), but Q1 2026 revenue was reported down 62% y/y with a net loss ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/capital-goods/wse-lug/lug-shares)).
thesis.main_shareholders: CEO Ryszard Wtorkowski about 37.1% (Simply Wall St, undated) ([Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/capital-goods/wse-lug/lug-shares/ownership)); a headline reports MKK3 Sp. z o.o. becoming a new shareholder, stake not confirmed ([Comparic](https://comparic.pl/lug-s-a-nowym-akcjonariuszem-spolki-bedzie-mkk3-sp-z-o-o/)). Not confirmed against the 2025 annual report.
thesis.red_flags: Q1 2026 revenue down 62% y/y and a net loss per [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/capital-goods/wse-lug/lug-shares); Simply Wall St also flags a 'new risk' tag. Controlling-holder dynamics: CEO holds roughly 37% (undated). Past African expansion was unwound (LUG West Africa shares sold to Jintech Management for NGN 2.1M in 2021) ([ESPI via Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art26527561-lug-s-a-zawarcie-umowy-inwestycyjnej-z-jintech-management-ltd)). Reported market cap is very small relative to revenue.
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Ryszard Wtorkowski about 37.1% (undated, [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/capital-goods/wse-lug/lug-shares/ownership)).

thesis.business_description: Fazerles AD (Silistra, Bulgaria; incorporated 1993; listed on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange since April 2008) manufactures wood-based panel products (hardboard/fibreboard and plywood-type materials) used in furniture, doors, and fruit and vegetable boxes and crates.
thesis.competitive_position: Small regional Bulgarian wood-panel producer in a commodity niche; no moat evidenced. Revenue was about BGN 15.0M in 2025 with a net loss of about BGN 1.4M per Simply Wall St, though aggregator figures conflict ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stock/bul/fzls), [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bul/FZLS/financials/income-statement/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Fazerinvest AD: about 58.6% ([Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/bg/materials/bul-fzls/fazerles-ad-shares/ownership)); Leo Overseas Ltd: 9.16% and Capman Asset Management AD: 4.21% per Profit.bg/Simply Wall St (dates not confirmed) ([Profit.bg](https://www.profit.bg/article/2024012320160811665)).
thesis.red_flags: Net loss in 2025 and operating profit reportedly down about 67% ([EMIS](https://www.emis.com/php/company-profile/BG/Fazerles_AD__Фазерлес_АД__en_1403562.html), [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stock/bul/fzls)); controlling-holder dynamics (Fazerinvest AD ~58.6%) and thin liquidity on BSE (about 515k shares in issue per StockAnalysis) ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bul/FZLS/company)); aggregator financial data inconsistent (7.66 vs 14.98 revenue).
thesis.insider_ownership: Chairman Manol Todorov and director/CEO Milko Kesarovski listed as management; individual holdings not disclosed; parent Fazerinvest AD controls ~58.6% ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bul/FZLS/company)).

thesis.business_description: Arad, Romania company (founded 1924, formerly Feroneria SA) that until 29 May 2014 manufactured hardware (CAEN 2572); it now mainly owns land and buildings and leases production space to affiliates Feroneria Prod and VEROFER, while holding participation stakes in them ([IAMBA 2025 annual report](https://www.bvb.ro/info/Raportari/FERO/FERO_20260414141333_2025-Raport-anual-Iamba-SA.pdf); [IAMBA 2023 annual report](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/FERO/FERO-RA_2023.pdf)).
thesis.competitive_position: Effectively a small industrial-property lessor with related-party tenants rather than an operating manufacturer; competitive position depends on the Arad site assets and affiliate lease income. No evident moat; 33,818,014 shares listed on BVB's multilateral trading system ([Primet](https://primet.ro/actiuni/FERO)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Revenue relies on leases to related parties (five-year lease with Feroneria Prod and open-ended leases with VEROFER per the annual report above), i.e. related-party and tenant-concentration risk; trading on the MTS/AeRO-type segment with thin liquidity; no dividend was paid for 2024 (profit of RON 846,817 carried forward, AGM of 2 Apr 2025, per the 2025 annual-report excerpt), though a dividend communication followed in Aug 2026 ([BVB notice](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/FERO/FERO_20260824105119_RC-comunicat-dividende-BVB.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Sofia-based Bulgarian printing and outdoor advertising (billboard) company listed on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange, with 15 million shares in issue; FY2024 revenue about BGN 39.0M.
thesis.competitive_position: Established Bulgarian outdoor-advertising/printing operator; FY2024 revenue BGN 39.0M (+6.3%), net income BGN 1.53M (-16%); Q2 2025 revenue BGN 9.50M (-1.0%), net income BGN 722k ([Simply Wall St summaries via StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bul/BBRD/financials/)). Moat from owned/leased site inventory and permits in the domestic market; no evidence found of pricing power.
thesis.main_shareholders: Vassil Stefanov Genchev 25.024% and Stefan Vassilev Genchev 20.000% as of 31 Dec 2017 per company filing on Investor.bg ([Investor.bg](https://investor.bg/media/files/bulletin/p7s/06581d9d6f5e4c2a2e78a270740b0939.pdf.p7s)); no more recent breakdown found.
thesis.red_flags: Family-controlled (Genchev family about 45% as of 2017), with the chairman and CEO from the same family (Kalin Genchev, Stefan Genchev) - governance/related-party risk ([Stockanalysis company page](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bul/BBRD/company)). Thinly traded Bulgarian small cap; 2025 net sales reportedly fell about 4.5% per EMIS ([EMIS](https://www.emis.cn/php/company-profile/BG/Billboard_AD__Билборд_АД__en_2317696.html)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Genchev family: Vassil Stefanov Genchev 25.024% and Stefan Vassilev Genchev 20.000% (2017 filing, likely stale); Kalin Genchev is chairman and Stefan Genchev CEO.

name: Immersion SA

thesis.business_description: Immersion SA (Bordeaux, France; Euronext Growth ticker ALIMR) imports and sells virtual-reality technology products in France, founded 1994 by Christophe Chartier; fiscal year ends 30 June.
thesis.competitive_position: Niche reseller/integrator of VR hardware for professional users; FY2025 revenue about EUR 7.5M ([Stockopedia](https://www.stockopedia.com/share-prices/immersion-sa-EPA:ALIMR/)). Reseller model dependent on third-party suppliers, so little moat beyond relationships and expertise ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/epa/ALIMR/company)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Christophe Chartier ~77%, employees ~4%, public ~19% of capital per the management report for the year to 30 June 2023 ([AMF/DILA filing](https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/AMF/ECO/2023/10/FCECO072881_20231031.pdf)); 78.58% at the 2016 IPO ([Immersion IPO release](https://www.immersion.fr/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Realite_Virtuelle-Immersion_entre_en_Bourse.pdf)). Latest figures not verified.
thesis.red_flags: Controlling founder (~77%) and small ~19% free float with 1,268,290 shares in issue ([AMF/DILA](https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/AMF/ECO/2023/10/FCECO072881_20231031.pdf)) - very illiquid; key-person dependence on the founder-CEO; shareholder data dated 2023.
thesis.insider_ownership: Christophe Chartier (founder/CEO) ~77% and employees ~4% (FY to 30 June 2023) ([AMF/DILA](https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/AMF/ECO/2023/10/FCECO072881_20231031.pdf)).

gmFiscalYear: TTM to Dec-2025 (derived: FY Jun-2025 + H1 25/26 - H1 24/25)

thesis.business_description: AIK Fotboll AB (publ) is the Swedish listed company (class B shares on NGM) around the AIK men's football operations (Allsvenskan, Stockholm/Solna), earning revenue from the football business and playing at the Fabege-linked arena arrangement.
thesis.competitive_position: A single-club sports franchise with a large supporter base; no conventional moat beyond brand and loyal fans, and results depend on sporting performance and player trading. Control sits with the parent association through high-voting A-shares ([Affarsvarlden](https://www.affarsvarlden.se/aktie/aik-fotboll)). FY2025 reported a loss of about SEK 12.5M ([Fotbolldirekt](https://fotbolldirekt.se/allsvenskan/aik-meddelar-minusresultat-i-arsbokslutet/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: AIK Fotbollsforening 52.76% of votes and 10.05% of capital per its 2025 annual report ([AIK FF arsredovisning 2025](https://www.aikfotboll.se/media/edfjehkq/a-rsredovisning-2025-aik-fotbollsfo-rening.pdf)); Fabege and Per Bystedt described as the next largest owners, each just under 10% in an undated article ([Realtid](https://www.realtid.se/bors-finans/aik-supportrar-har-corner-i-klubben/)), with a later Realtid/Fotbolldirekt report putting Bystedt at ~17-18% of capital ([Fotbolldirekt](https://fotbolldirekt.se/allsvenskan/just-nu-bystedt-vald-till-ordforande-i-aik-fotboll/)); Berth Milton 8.4% of capital / 4.4% of votes per an FI flag, later reported as selling ([Realtid](https://www.realtid.se/bors-finans/milton-storagare-i-aik/)). Current percentages unverified.
thesis.red_flags: Loss of ~SEK 12.5M in FY2025 ([Fotbolldirekt](https://fotbolldirekt.se/allsvenskan/aik-meddelar-minusresultat-i-arsbokslutet/)); controlling-holder dynamics: the association holds 52.76% of votes on only 10.05% of capital ([AIK FF 2025](https://www.aikfotboll.se/media/edfjehkq/a-rsredovisning-2025-aik-fotbollsfo-rening.pdf)); press has reported past financial distress ([Realtid](https://www.realtid.se/bors-finans/aik-uppges-vara-nara-konkurs/), date not verified); thin trading and conflicting ownership data across sources.
thesis.insider_ownership: Per Bystedt reported as large owner (~17-18% of capital) and elected chairman of AIK Fotboll per Fotbolldirekt ([source](https://fotbolldirekt.se/allsvenskan/just-nu-bystedt-vald-till-ordforande-i-aik-fotboll/)); date and current status not verified.

thesis.business_description: Warsaw-based parcel-services provider (Pointpack S.A., NewConnect since Nov 2018) operating pick-up/drop-off (PUDO) points and automated parcel machines (APM); services were available at more than 18,600 points in Poland and 400+ in Croatia, with subsidiary P2A BOX (51%).
thesis.competitive_position: Niche logistics partner of Zabka convenience stores and carriers; 2025 revenue was PLN 85.7M (-32.6%) as the PUDO segment shrank after reduced cooperation with the Zabka network; APM revenue was PLN 56.3M (>66% of revenue) and Poczta Polska collected over 700 APMs ([Pointpack 2025 annual report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/1747_20260323_212100_Raport-roczny-za-2025-PointPack-jednostkowy.pdf)). Q4 2025 revenue was about PLN 17.8M, -42% y/y ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art43724051-pointpack-pl-spolka-akcyjna-informacja-o-przewidywanej-sprzedazy-netto-w-iv-kw-2025-r)). Revenue was PLN 127.2M in 2024 (+27%). Low-moat, contract-dependent business facing larger lockers networks.
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Severe customer/partner concentration: DHL Parcel Polska limited its cooperation with Pointpack in Zabka stores in 2024, with Pointpack estimating a PLN 12-16M revenue hit ([Wiadomosci Handlowe](https://www.wiadomoscihandlowe.pl/logistyka-dla-handlu/pointpack-podpisal-nowe-porozumienie-z-zabka-obie-strony-zapewniaja-ze-beda-dalej-rozmawiac-2513264)); revenue fell 32.6% in 2025 and 42% in Q4 ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art43724051-pointpack-pl-spolka-akcyjna-informacja-o-przewidywanej-sprzedazy-netto-w-iv-kw-2025-r)). Reports that Zabka is the target of a tender for 100% of its shares by Circle K's owner add ownership-change risk for its key partner ([Rzeczpospolita](https://www.rp.pl/handel/art44919171-wlasciciel-circle-k-przejmuje-zabke-bedzie-wezwanie-na-100-proc-akcji-spolki)). Dec 2023 filings concerned release of share pledges. Thin NewConnect liquidity (free float 'Pozostali' 56.92% of 1,118,873 shares).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Polish provider of outsourced accounting and bookkeeping services, with HR/payroll and tax-advisory services, for SME clients in Poland; majority-owned by PROFESCAPITAL Sp. z o.o.
thesis.competitive_position: Niche SME accounting-outsourcing provider in a highly fragmented Polish market with no evident moat beyond client relationships and scale of roughly 90-100 staff ([StockAnalysis company profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/ABK/company)). Revenue was about PLN 4.0M in the quarter ended 30 Sep 2025, up 4.45% y/y per aggregator data ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stock/wse/abk)). Aggregator profiles disagree on headcount and head-office city, so those details are unverified.
thesis.main_shareholders: PROFESCAPITAL Sp. z o.o. holds 2,074,110 of 2,694,760 shares (about 76.96%) per a register-style table ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/229011-abak)); Investing.com shows a similar ~76.97% ([Investing.com](https://uk.investing.com/equities/abak-sa-company-profile)). Remaining shares are free float; no other named holders found.
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder PROFESCAPITAL owns roughly 77% of shares, leaving a free float of about 23% (about 620k shares) and thin liquidity ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/229011-abak)). Management overlap with the parent: the Abak CEO also chairs PROFESCAPITAL's management board, which creates related-party/governance risk ([MarketScreener](https://it.marketscreener.com/insider/PAWEL-KAROL-PUTERKO-A0W3OX)). Third-party sources disagree on whether it trades on the main market or NewConnect ([TradingView](https://www.tradingview.com/symbols/NEWCONNECT-ABK/ideas)). No going-concern or auditor-qualification wording found in search results.
thesis.insider_ownership: Indirect: management (CEO Pawel Puterko) chairs the management board of controlling holder PROFESCAPITAL Sp. z o.o., and supervisory board vice-chair Wojciech Kaliciak sits on its board ([MarketScreener](https://it.marketscreener.com/insider/WOJCIECH-KALICIAK-A1VO4H)); direct personal holdings not disclosed in sources found.

thesis.business_description: Ukrproduct Group Ltd (Jersey-incorporated, AIM) produces and sells dairy products in Ukraine (including skimmed milk powder and other dairy products) and kvass; H1 2025 revenue was GBP 20.2m (+21.6%) with a net loss of GBP 0.2m ([Stockopedia interim results](https://www.stockopedia.com/share-prices/ukrproduct-LON:UKR/news/reg-ukrproduct-group-ltd-interim-results-urn:newsml:reuters.com:20250930:nRSd2954Ba); [Dec 2025 trading update](https://www.ticker.app/lse/UKR/rns/2025-12-18/Trading-Update/0260M)). All operations are in Ukraine.
thesis.competitive_position: A small regional dairy/beverage processor in a commodity-like market with no evident moat; operations are disrupted by the war (daily power outages of up to 14 hours in late 2025). Skimmed milk powder sales rose 74.7% but kvass fell 13.3% ([trading update](https://www.ticker.app/lse/UKR/rns/2025-12-18/Trading-Update/0260M)); FY2025 loss narrowed on higher revenue but FY2026 trading described as challenging ([RTT News](https://www.rttnews.com/3661605/ukrproduct-fy25-loss-narrows-on-higher-revenues-says-fy26-to-date-trading-challenging.aspx)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Simply Wall St: Crensel Finance Limited ~37.7% (about 14.97m shares) and Densim Group Management SA ~37.7% (about 14.94m shares); top four holders about 75.76% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/food-beverage-tobacco/aim-ukr/ukrproduct-group-shares/ownership)); data dated around FY2023 and not confirmed by a recent RNS holding notice. TipRanks lists Sergey Evlanchik as the largest owner without a percentage ([TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/gb:ukr/ownership)).
thesis.red_flags: Continuing breach of EBRD loan: Tranches A and B not repaid at maturity and interest unpaid since 1 March 2022 ([H1 2025 interim](https://www.stockopedia.com/share-prices/ukrproduct-LON:UKR/news/reg-ukrproduct-group-ltd-interim-results-urn:newsml:reuters.com:20250930:nRSd2954Ba)); auditor raised going-concern doubt on the FY2022 accounts ([MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/UKRPRODUCT-GROUP-LIMITED-4005059/news/Ukrproduct-Group-Limited-Auditor-Raises-Going-Concern-Doubt-44296940/)); H1 2025 net assets only GBP 1.6m (from GBP 4.9m) and cash GBP 0.1m; war and power-outage risk; two holders controlling ~75% leaves a thin free float.
thesis.insider_ownership: Sergey Evlanchik is an Executive Director ([2025 final results notice](https://www.stockopedia.com/share-prices/ukrproduct-LON:UKR/news/final-results-and-notice-of-agm-019eedeb-473c-7ed6-a3bf-b996b51f4cda/)); his holding was not confirmed (TipRanks names him as largest owner without a figure). Jack Rowell 0.35% per Simply Wall St.

thesis.business_description: Polman S.A. (Warsaw; NewConnect) provides industrial services in Poland, chiefly hydrodynamic cleaning of industrial installations and construction, modernization and servicing of cooling towers.
thesis.competitive_position: Niche industrial-services contractor; cooling-tower service work was about 34% of net sales in 2024 ([Comparic / annual report excerpt](https://comparic.pl/polman-z-kolejna-umowa-akcje-zyskuja-15-i-sa-na-historycznym-szczycie/), [2025 annual report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/1698_20260320_210700_RAPORT-ROCZNY-POLMAN-20032026.pdf)). Contract-based business with project dependence; no evidence found of a structural moat.
thesis.main_shareholders: Piotr Krawczyk (vice-president): 53.96% of capital and 60.54% of votes after a February 2020 transaction (latest figure found; current stake unconfirmed) ([ESPI notice via Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art27124771-polman-s-a)). ABS Investment S.A. fell below 5% in February 2020 ([ESPI via Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art27125481-polman-s-a)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder dynamics: management-linked shareholder with over 50% of votes (2020 data). NewConnect liquidity: share price around 0.40 PLN in April 2026 per StockAnalysis ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/PLM/statistics)). Project concentration in cooling-tower contracts. 2025/2026 shareholder lists not retrieved.
thesis.insider_ownership: Piotr Krawczyk (vice-president) 53.96% capital / 60.54% votes as of Feb 2020 ([ESPI via Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art27124771-polman-s-a)).

thesis.business_description: Swedish tile and stone retailer operating through its subsidiary Kakel Design (the operating company), with showrooms in the Stockholm/Malardalen area (Arsta, Vasteras, Varmdo, Taby, Eskilstuna) and supply to property and construction customers ([Q4 2025 report](https://cdn.bequoted.com/media/1/713c2fd1-3777-48f4-bb01-f888fd920a66/Kakel-Max-AB-Bokslutskommunike-Q4-2025.pdf)). FY2025 net sales were SEK 175.4m (2024: SEK 143.5m) with a net loss of SEK 1.4m (2024: loss SEK 5.5m).
thesis.competitive_position: Small regional specialist in tiles for property/construction customers, competing against large DIY and bathroom chains; no market-share data was found in public sources. Sales growth was strong in H2 2025 (Q4 net sales SEK 52.3m vs 37.2m, Q4 profit SEK 1.0m) but slowed in 2026 (Q2 net sales SEK 46.1m vs 45.6m) ([Q2 2026 report](https://cdn.bequoted.com/media/1/2784af0d-05cc-418c-8552-0d669160da95/Kakel-Max-AB-Kvartalsrapport-Q2-2026.pdf)). No evident moat; exposure to Swedish construction/renovation cycle.
thesis.main_shareholders: Svingbolsta Forvaltning AB 512,535 shares (16.87%) and Joakim Alm GPJ AB 498,298 shares (16.40%) per the Q1 2026 report top-10 list ([Q1 2026 report](https://cdn.bequoted.com/media/1/01f4af5b-67a3-4fd3-b67f-392a9093df22/Kakel-Max-AB-Kvartalsrapport-Q1-2026.pdf)); earlier top-10 (Q1 2025) also included Jonas Bengtsson Invest AB 315,000 (10.4%) and Dimitra AB 310,000 (10.2%) ([Q1 2025 report](https://l.cdn.bequoted.com/1/delarsrapport-q1-2025-116477/Kakel_Max_AB_Kvartalsrapport_Q1_2025.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Net loss in 2025 (SEK -1.4m) and 2024 (SEK -5.5m); profitability only recently turned positive on a quarterly basis ([Q4 2025 report](https://cdn.bequoted.com/media/1/713c2fd1-3777-48f4-bb01-f888fd920a66/Kakel-Max-AB-Bokslutskommunike-Q4-2025.pdf)). Growth slowing in 2026 (Q2 +1.2% y/y). Small share count (~3.04m shares) with several holders at 10-17% implies thin liquidity; CEO change (Michael Blom named CEO in Q1 2026 report, previously Ulf Ribbenstedt).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (Joakim Alm GPJ AB, 16.40%, is linked to property entrepreneur Joakim Alm per [Affarsvarlden](https://www.affarsvarlden.se/analys/kakel-max-stigande-marginaler); management holdings not found).

thesis.business_description: Polish NewConnect-listed designer and supplier of aesthetic-medicine devices and related products for clinics and similar facilities, selling to partners in Poland, Scandinavia and elsewhere in Europe ([CMI 2023 annual report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/48614145/DOC.20240529.48614145.CMI_Raport_roczny_2023_29052024_podpisany-1.pdf)).
thesis.competitive_position: Small niche supplier of aesthetic-medicine equipment; it introduced laser devices into regular sales and runs a pay-as-you-go settlement model with a Swedish partner ([CMI Q2 2025 report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/52178542/DOC.20250807.52178542.CMI_raport_kwartalny_IIQ2025-0.pdf)). Dependence on few distributors is evident: the 2024 annual report says orders from a German customer were lost, prompting a push into Scandinavia ([CMI 2024 annual report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/51659526/DOC.20250527.51659526.CMI_raport_roczny_2024-0.pdf)). No evident moat beyond product design and distributor relationships.
thesis.main_shareholders: Mariusz Kara about 54.9% of shares, Michal Sebastian about 4.32%, Semper Heres Fundacja Rodzinna about 9.89% (Simply Wall St aggregator of filings, [ownership page](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/healthcare/wse-cmi/cm-international-shares/ownership)); older Parkiet registry data (c.2019) shows Kara 54.86% of shares / ~66-69% of votes, Sebastian 4.32% / ~5.2-5.4% of votes and Weremczuk Holding 7.48% of votes ([Parkiet company page](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/231611-cm-international)). Figures may be dated.
thesis.red_flags: Customer concentration and loss of a German customer's orders ([2024 annual report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/51659526/DOC.20250527.51659526.CMI_raport_roczny_2024-0.pdf)); aggregator-reported Q1 2026 revenue of PLN 3.54M, down 42.5% y/y ([BiznesRadar financials](https://www.biznesradar.pl/raporty-finansowe-rachunek-zyskow-i-strat/CMI,C)); FY2025 annual report publication was moved to 22 May 2026 from 27 May 2026 ([CMI EBI 6/2026](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/2786_20260520_151400_CMI-EBI-6-2026-Zmiana-terminu-publikacji-raportu-za-2025-rok.pdf)); founder control (~55% of capital, higher in votes) and NewConnect low liquidity; about 1.2M shares outstanding (Parkiet).
thesis.insider_ownership: President Mariusz Kara ~54.9% and Vice-President Michal Sebastian ~4.32% (Simply Wall St, https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/healthcare/wse-cmi/cm-international-shares/ownership; Parkiet registry c.2019).

name: S.C. De Reparat Material Rulant Reva S.A.

thesis.business_description: S.C. De Reparat Material Rulant Reva S.A. (Simeria, Romania) repairs, overhauls and modernises railway rolling stock (freight wagons, passenger wagons, locomotives, axles), largely for Romanian rail operators such as CFR Calatori and for foreign wagon owners.
thesis.competitive_position: Described in the press as one of Romania's leading freight-wagon repairers, ranking first by 2025 turnover among CAEN 3020 rolling-stock firms in Hunedoara county; it states that over 33% of wagons repaired belong to foreign customers (undated interview) ([Bursa.ro interview](https://www.bursa.ro/alina-magdau-director-general-reva-simeria-parcurile-feroviare-din-romania-sunt-invechite-si-vine-vremea-innoirii-lor-22472331); [Termene.ro](https://termene.ro/firma/2150217)). Revenue was RON 140.8m in 2024 (+22%) and about RON 155m trailing with net income about RON 3.6m per an aggregator ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/REVA/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Grampet S.A. is the main shareholder; ZF reports businessman Gruia Stoica holding about 89% through Grampet (undated article, not verified against a current BVB register) ([ZF](https://www.zf.ro/burse-fonduri-mutuale/trenul-vin-banii-bursa-bucuresti-reva-simeria-companie-repara-20457615); [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/REVA/company)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder (about 89% via Grampet) leaves a free float of roughly 11% on the AeRO market; customer dependence on state rail operator SNTFC CFR Calatori for passenger-stock work ([BVB 2025 financial statements excerpt](https://www.bvb.ro/info/Raportari/REFE/REFE_20260327160009_Situatii-financiare-2025.pdf), filed under a different issuer code, so unverified); thin net margin (~2% on trailing revenue per aggregator data) ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/REVA/)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Gruia Stoica (via Grampet) about 89% per ZF (undated); not verified against a current filing ([ZF](https://www.zf.ro/burse-fonduri-mutuale/trenul-vin-banii-bursa-bucuresti-reva-simeria-companie-repara-20457615)).

thesis.business_description: Alimentara S.A. (Slatina, Romania) owns 17 commercial premises (2,461 sqm built area, including its head office) and earns almost all operating income from renting them; 2025 total revenue was RON 2.69m, of which RON 1.69m rental income.
thesis.competitive_position: Micro-cap real-estate/rental vehicle in a small Romanian town; its value rests on property holdings and financial investments rather than any operating moat ([Alimentara annual report 2025](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/ALRV/ALRV_20260331065638_Raport-financiar-anual-2025.pdf)). 2025 net profit was RON 1.21m ([Alimentara profit allocation notice](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/ALRV/ALRV_20260331065436_Comunicat-repartizare-profit-2025.pdf)).
thesis.main_shareholders: SIF Oltenia 85.2194% of share capital per a 2022 BVB filing (after buying a 33% stake in 2021 for about RON 8.95m); current register not verified ([Bursa.ro](https://www.bursa.ro/sif-oltenia-a-platit-noua-milioane-de-lei-pentru-o-treime-din-alimentara-slatina-43870547); [BVB ALRV filing](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/ALRV/ALRV_20220429142430_Vanzare-actiuni.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder SIF Oltenia (about 85%) leaves a free float of roughly 15% and very thin liquidity; trading was suspended around the ASF approval of the company's own purchase offer in early 2026 ([Tradeville news feed](https://tradeville.ro/actiuni/ALRV/stiri)); management changes reported on 11 May 2026 and a contract-termination notice around July 2026, details not verified ([BVB filing 11 May 2026](https://www.bvb.ro/info/Raportari/ALRV/ALRV_20260511164725_Raport-curent-modificari-in-conducerea-societatii-Alimentara.pdf)); a large part of profit is financial income (RON 0.98m of RON 2.69m revenue) ([Annual report 2025](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/ALRV/ALRV_20260331065638_Raport-financiar-anual-2025.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Euro-Tax.pl S.A. is a holding company whose operating subsidiary (Euro-Tax.pl Zwrot Podatku S.A.) assists Polish workers abroad (UK, Ireland, Germany, Netherlands, Belgium, Austria, Denmark) in reclaiming foreign income tax, often via recruitment and employment agencies.
thesis.competitive_position: Self-described leader of the Polish foreign-tax-refund niche, having processed over PLN 500m of refunds by 2017 ([Strefa Inwestorów](https://strefainwestorow.pl/wiadomosci/20170809/euro-taxpl-obsluzyl-ponad-500-mln-zl-zwrotow-podatkow)). Moat is brand and agency distribution relationships; it depends on foreign tax-authority processes and the migration flow of Polish workers. 2024 revenue was about PLN 33.75m (+1.45%) while profit fell about 78% to PLN 0.76m ([Bankier financial results](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/EUROTAX/wyniki-finansowe)).
