thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Sharp 2024 profit decline (-78%) and regulatory/tax-process dependence in several foreign jurisdictions; thin liquidity (5,000,000 shares; NewConnect) ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/spolka/PLEURTX00012)). Shareholder register not verified.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

name: AS Siguldas Ciltslietu Un Maksligas Apseklosanas Stacija

thesis.business_description: Latvian breeding-bull semen and cattle genetics company (founded 1957) in Sigulda, listed on Nasdaq Riga; 2025 net turnover EUR 1.94M (+17.3%) with profit of EUR 29.1k.
thesis.competitive_position: Describes itself as the only producer of high-quality breeding bull semen and one of the largest suppliers of it in Latvia ([Nasdaq Baltic/GlobeNewswire release via Researchpool](https://app.researchpool.com/company/scm1r-lv0000100600-siguldas-ciltslietu-un-maksligas-apseklosanas-stacija/press/scm1r-jsc-siguldas-ciltslietu-un-mkslgs-apskloanas-stacija-audited-annual-re-wD7PPBB6Hh)). Local niche with regulatory/breeding-programme barriers, but a very small business with thin profitability (2025 profit fell by EUR 51.7k).
thesis.main_shareholders: 'Siguldas mākslīgās apsēklošanas stacija' Ltd. 49.80% and SCI AG 8.07% of voting shares, per the nine-month 2024 report ([Nasdaq Baltic Q3 2024 report](https://nasdaqbaltic.com/market/upload/reports/scm/2024_q3_en_eur_00_las.pdf)); no more recent list found.
thesis.red_flags: Near-majority holder (49.80%) plus a second 8.07% holder leaves limited free float ([Nasdaq Baltic Q3 2024 report](https://nasdaqbaltic.com/market/upload/reports/scm/2024_q3_en_eur_00_las.pdf)). Very small scale: profit EUR 29.1k on EUR 1.94M turnover in 2025, so earnings are fragile.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Ormester Vagyonvedelmi Nyrt. (Hungary) provides security services: manned guarding, event security, cash and valuables transport and personal protection, in Hungary.
thesis.competitive_position: Mid-sized Hungarian private-security provider in a labour-intensive, low-margin sector with no structural moat; H1 2025 revenue HUF 1.67bn (H1 2024: HUF 1.73bn) and net profit HUF 24.96m (H1 2024: HUF 36.29m) ([BSE issuer page](https://bse.hu/pages/company_profile/$security/ORMESTER)); 2025 net margin only 0.63% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/hu/commercial-services/buse-ormester/ormester-vagyonvedelmi-nyrt-shares/past)).
thesis.main_shareholders: 2020 annual report: Istvan Kincs 25.48% (662,004 shares) and Gergely Kincs 14.50% (376,670 shares) ([BET annual report 2020](https://bet.hu/newkibdata/128536560/2020.%20%C3%A9vi%20vezet%C5%91s%C3%A9gi%20%C3%A9s%20%C3%BCzleti%20jelent%C3%A9s.pdf.pdf)); this is the latest named breakdown found, and an older 2011 disclosure showed a different split (Gergely Kincs 69.75%), so current holdings should be verified via the BSE voting-rights notice of 27 Feb 2026.
thesis.red_flags: Thin margins and falling H1 2025 revenue/profit; family-controlled with board chaired by Gergely Kincs (2026 AGM notice, [OTP Bank-hosted invitation](https://www.otpbank.hu/static/portal/sw/file/Ormester_kozgy_meghivo_20260319.pdf)); current shareholder register not confirmed; small-cap liquidity risk on BSE.
thesis.insider_ownership: Kincs family (Istvan 25.48%, Gergely 14.50% per 2020 annual report; Gergely Kincs is board chair per 2026 AGM notice).

thesis.business_description: Warsaw-based distributor of orthopaedic implants and medical materials (mainly joint endoprostheses supplied by Corin Ltd. (UK) and Merete (Germany)), listed on NewConnect since April 2019.
thesis.competitive_position: Small distributor in the Polish endoprosthetics market, dependent on a few foreign manufacturers and on hospital tenders; no proprietary moat. 2025 net sales were about PLN 32.2M (flat vs PLN 32.6M), EBIT about PLN 1.5M and net profit attributable about PLN 536k; management says the Polish endoprosthetics market was over 10% below 2023 with hospitals cutting procedures and stretching payment terms ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/MSM/wyniki-finansowe/skonsolidowany/roczny); [management letter](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-05/20260529_212907_0000003166_0000078516.pdf)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Marek Mlodzianowski (CEO) 54.10% (1,306,545 shares per a 2023 filing); Edyta Lerska 14.99% (older record) ([Stockwatch](https://stockwatch.pl/gpw/msm,akcjonariat,wskazniki.aspx); [2023 filing](https://www.bankier.pl/static/att/ebi/2023-05/0000150637_202305310000147299.pdf); [Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/236681-massmedica)).
thesis.red_flags: Hospitals stretching supplier payment terms and shrinking procedure volumes, with negative operating cash flow flagged by Simply Wall St ([management letter](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-05/20260529_212907_0000003166_0000078516.pdf); [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/healthcare/wse-msm/massmedica-shares/health)); supplier concentration (Corin, Merete); CEO holds about 54% so the free float is small; NewConnect liquidity; net profit fell from PLN 604k to PLN 536k.
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Marek Mlodzianowski about 54.10% (1,306,545 shares, 2023 filing) ([Stockwatch](https://stockwatch.pl/gpw/msm,akcjonariat,wskazniki.aspx)).

thesis.business_description: S.C. Constructii Hidrotehnice S.A. (Iasi, Romania; founded 1978) carries out hydrotechnical construction works, mainly for Hidroelectrica, with about 131 employees and FY2025 revenue of about RON 46.2m.
thesis.competitive_position: Specialist Romanian hydro-construction contractor with a track record on major hydropower works but heavy dependence on a single state client (Hidroelectrica) ([2023 annual report](https://m.bvb.ro/info/Raportari/CHIA/CHIA_20240418153318_RAPORT-ANUAL-2023.pdf); [Economica](https://www.economica.net/ce-planuri-are-acum-compania-care-a-facut-hidrocentralele-mari-ale-romaniei_786491.html/amp)). 2025 revenue fell about 13% to RON 46.2m with profit about RON 1.25m ([Termene](https://termene.ro/firma/8291606--)). Moat limited to specialised know-how and equipment.
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Customer concentration on Hidroelectrica; project-based, declining revenue (-13% in 2025). Governance friction: on 30 July 2026 a group of 7 shareholders holding 8.7% asked to add AGM items to review the board's report and approve measures to improve performance and protect assets ([BVB](https://m.bvb.ro/FinancialInstruments/SelectedData/NewsItem/CHIA-Completare-Convocare-AGAO-19-08-2026/86442)). Very small share count (about 521k shares) implies thin liquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (CEO Ioan Careja listed by Simply Wall St; holding not seen)

thesis.business_description: Polish organiser of business conferences and events listed on NewConnect (not the WSE main market) ([TradingView](https://in.tradingview.com/symbols/NEWCONNECT-MMC/?video=yes)); 2025 revenue was about PLN 14.1m (+4.8%) with net earnings of about PLN 0.14m (-89%) per StockAnalysis ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/MMC/)).
thesis.competitive_position: Niche events/conference organiser in Poland linked to the media group Gremi Media (a shareholder) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/commercial-services/wse-mmc/mm-conferences-shares/ownership)); earnings are volatile and margins thin (2025 net profit fell about 89% y/y per [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/MMC/)). Moat limited to relationships/brands of its events; sources conflict on revenue (Simply Wall St shows PLN 15.8m).
thesis.main_shareholders: Simply Wall St lists Piotr Zesiuk 50.3% and Gremi Media S.A. 47.1% (figures look inconsistent with the share count and are unverified) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/commercial-services/wse-mmc/mm-conferences-shares/ownership)); StockAnalysis describes the company as a subsidiary of Zesiuk Investment Sp. z o.o. ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/MMC/company)). The official 5%-of-votes list for the 15 April 2026 AGM was published by the company but not retrieved ([money.pl](https://www.money.pl/gielda/spolki-gpw/plmmcnf00014,emitent,1.html)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling-holder dynamics: two holders reportedly own about 97% combined, leaving a tiny free float (about 1.07m shares outstanding per [Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/237231-mm-conferences)). Sharp fall in 2025 net profit and tiny equity (about USD 1m). NewConnect listing implies low liquidity and lighter disclosure.
thesis.insider_ownership: Piotr Zesiuk (CEO and co-founder) about 50.3% directly/via Zesiuk Investment per Simply Wall St (unverified) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/commercial-services/wse-mmc/mm-conferences-shares/ownership)).

name: IBC POLSKA F & P spólka akcyjna

thesis.business_description: IBC Polska F&P S.A. (Mirkow, Poland; NewConnect, ticker IBC) supplies beverage dispensing and cooling equipment, refrigerated display cabinets and refrigeration service/repair in Poland and abroad, with roughly 15-17 employees.
thesis.competitive_position: Tiny niche equipment supplier; 2024 revenue was about PLN 9.7M, down ~10% ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/IBC/revenue/)), and the 2024 report cites a partnership with refrigerator maker IMBERA for beverage distribution in retail outlets ([2024 annual report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/51579842/DOC.20250516.51579842.Raport_roczny_za_2024_rok_IBC_POLSKA_F_P-2.pdf)). No evidence of a durable moat or meaningful market share; no market-size data found in sources ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stock/wse/ibc)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Andrzej Plak 41.50% and Piotr Flak 41.50%, others 17.0% of share capital (3,012,244 shares) per the 2025 directors' report ([IBC 2025 report, EBI May 2026](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-05/20260529_151203_0000003103_0000077839.pdf)); another table in the same filing set shows Piotr Flak 45.81% and others 12.69%, so exact split is unconfirmed.
thesis.red_flags: Two founders-holders control ~83% so free float is ~17% (illiquid NewConnect stock) ([2025 report](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-05/20260529_151203_0000003103_0000077839.pdf)); inconsistent shareholder tables within the 2025 filings; 2024 revenue fell ~10% ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/IBC/revenue/)); an extraordinary general meeting was convened for 30 June 2026 (agenda not retrieved) ([ESPI notice](https://money2.wpcdn.pl/gielda/gpw/espi/65/7300298682044993_1.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Andrzej Plak and Piotr Flak, each ~41.50% ([2025 report](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-05/20260529_151203_0000003103_0000077839.pdf)); both sit on the management boards of IBC Polska F&P and IBC Euroserwis per a 2013 analysis ([SII](https://www.sii.org.pl/7278/aktualnosci/biuletyn-newconnect/analiza-ibc-polska-fp.html)) - current roles not re-verified.

thesis.business_description: Sakana S.A. is a Polish NewConnect-listed company whose core activity is franchising/licensing the Sakana sushi restaurant brand, with subsidiaries (TKM Investment, STM, Sakana Restaurant, K6, Tokyo-Barcelona) operating restaurants such as a Sakana Sushi and Sticks outlet in a Warsaw shopping centre ([Sakana 2025 management report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/3299_20260601_220000_GK_Skonsolidowane_sprawozdanie_z_dzialalnosci_2025.pdf)). Poland only; FY2025 revenue was about PLN 22.8m, +11.5% y/y ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/SKN/revenue/)).
thesis.competitive_position: A small, regional sushi/casual-dining franchise brand in a crowded Polish restaurant market; the sources show no evidence of a durable moat beyond brand and locations. Growth has been steady (revenue PLN 12.3m in 2022 to PLN 16.0m in 2023 per [MarketScreener](https://uk.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/SAKANA-S-A-20705010/news/Sakana-S-A-Reports-Earnings-Results-for-the-Full-Year-Ended-December-31-2023-45961835/), PLN 22.8m in 2025), suggesting some brand traction but no proven pricing power.
thesis.main_shareholders: Per the 2024 AGM shareholder list (not verified as current): Anas Salahadin Adi 9,483,000 shares = 39.19% of votes (down from 18,966,000 shares / 78.38% before disposals); Tomasz Romanik 1,639,837 shares = 6.78% ([Bankier shareholders page](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/SAKANA/akcjonariat); [money.pl notices](https://www.money.pl/gielda/komunikaty/7045553973332097.html)). A 2026 list of 5% holders for the 7 July 2026 AGM exists but its contents were not visible.
thesis.red_flags: Auditor raised going-concern doubt in an earlier year (undated headline, c. 2022: [MarketScreener](https://uk.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/SAKANA-S-A-20705010/news/Sakana-S-A-Auditor-Raises-Going-Concern-Doubt-41451409/)); controlling-holder dynamics (largest holder sold roughly half his stake, see [parkiet.com notice](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art36104531-sakana-s-a-informacja-o-zbyciu-znacznego-pakietu-akcji)); NewConnect micro-cap with limited liquidity; consumer-facing restaurant business exposed to rent and wage inflation (general, not company-specific).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (largest holder Anas Salahadin Adi per [Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/SAKANA/akcjonariat); his board role was not confirmed).

thesis.business_description: S.C. Elerom S.A. (Cordun, Neamt county, Romania; founded 1960) makes electrical transformers, switchgear, and line fittings for low- and medium-voltage lines, mainly for the Romanian energy sector.
thesis.competitive_position: Small domestic niche supplier of electrical equipment (CAEN 2711) with roughly 56-60 employees; no evidence found of a durable moat or scale advantage ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/ro/capital-goods/bvb-eler/sc-elerom-shares), [Tradeville](https://tradeville.ro/actiuni/ELER)). Reported 2025 revenue of about RON 30.5 million, up about 35% year over year, per aggregator data ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/ELER/revenue/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Very thin float: about 261.5k shares outstanding per aggregator ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stock/bvb/eler)); a registry profile shows only three masked associates ([Termene.ro](https://termene.ro/firma/3426320)); a Tradeville news item refers to a holder crossing the 33% voting threshold without naming the holder ([Tradeville](https://tradeville.ro/actiuni/ELER/stiri)). Ownership transparency and liquidity risk; aggregator financials conflict across sources.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: QubicGames S.A. (Siedlce, Poland; NewConnect) develops and publishes mobile and video games, including Robonauts and Astro Bears Party, for a global audience.
thesis.competitive_position: Small Polish mobile/PC game developer-publisher with a portfolio of casual titles; no evidence of a durable moat, results are hit-dependent and the company runs share buybacks ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/QUB/company), [MarketScreener buyback](https://ca.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/QUBICGAMES-S-A-47418934/news/QubicGames-S-A-announces-an-Equity-Buyback-for-1-000-000-shares-representing-10-18-for-PLN-1-mill-41639946/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Jakub Pieczykolan (Management Board President): 3,610,372 shares = about 37.22% of capital and 41.89% of votes (4,390,372 votes) as of 9 June 2026 per Bankier shareholder page ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/QUBICGMS/akcjonariat)). Erne Ventures reported selling all its QUB shares ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/14191,erne-ventures-sprzedalo-wszystkie-posiadane-akcje-qubicgames)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling-holder dynamics: CEO/founder holds ~42% of votes with preferred voting shares (9.7M shares vs 10.48M votes) ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/QUBICGMS/akcjonariat)). Hit-driven revenue, small NewConnect float and liquidity; ongoing buybacks. A further stake-change notice (report 11/2026) was filed by Pieczykolan ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/159754,qubicgames-sa-11-2026-zmiana-stanu-posiadania)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Jakub Pieczykolan (President of the Management Board) about 37.22% of capital / 41.89% of votes as of 9 June 2026 ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/QUBICGMS/akcjonariat)).

thesis.business_description: Agromep S.A. (Koscian, Poland; NewConnect ticker AGP) is described by data aggregators as a distributor of tractors and agricultural machinery in Poland; the business scope was not confirmed from company filings.
thesis.competitive_position: Small regional agricultural-machinery trader; no evidence found of a moat or distinct market position ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/AGP/company)). The share base has been reshaped by a 2013 private placement of 760,000 shares and a 2023 capital reduction of 227,500 shares ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/229301-agromep)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Names disclosed in April 2026 notifications: Michal Lichaj, Zbyszek Miszkiewicz and an agreement involving Janina Miszkiewicz ([Parkiet ESPI](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art44231381-agromep-spolka-akcyjna-zmiana-stanu-posiadania)); the 5%+ list for the 30 June 2026 AGM exists ([Parkiet ESPI](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art44734671-agromep-spolka-akcyjna-wykaz-akcjonariuszy-posiadajacych-co-najmniej-5-liczby-glosow-na-zwz-agromep-s-a-w-dniu-30-czerwca-2026-r)) but the percentages could not be read in search results.
thesis.red_flags: Share-count inconsistencies between sources (3.26M shares less 227.5k reduction vs 2.53M per StockAnalysis) ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/229301-agromep), [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/AGP/)); repeated calls to shareholders to submit share documents (dematerialisation) ([Parkiet ESPI](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art27334141-agromep-s-a-czwarte-wezwanie-akcjonariuszy-do-zlozenia-dokumentow-akcji)); NewConnect liquidity and concentrated holdings; shareholder-change notices in April 2026 point to ownership shifts.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: S.C. Conted S.A. (Dorohoi, Botosani county, Romania) produces garments, mainly outerwear such as suits, jackets and trousers, sold on European and domestic markets.
thesis.competitive_position: Contract apparel manufacturer (subcontracting for fashion customers) with revenue of 32.52 million lei in 2024, down 20.61% from 40.96 million, and earnings of 128,322 lei, down 92.03% ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/CNTE/financials/), [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/ro/consumer-durables/bvb-cnte/sc-conted-shares/information)). Low-margin cut-and-make business without a clear moat ([Economica](https://www.economica.net/partenerul-zara-si-al-louis-vuitton-redus-la-tacere-de-marile-zgomote-de-la-bursa-din-bucuresti_46470.html/amp)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Hamidi Haissam: 62.12% after buying a block in November 2018 ([Bursa.ro](https://www.bursa.ro/hamidi-haissam-lanseaza-o-oferta-publica-de-preluare-a-conted-43023637)); he then launched a takeover bid for the remaining ~37.88% at 28.00 lei/share in February 2019, outcome and current stake not found ([Profit.ro](https://profit.ro/povesti-cu-profit/financiar/piata-de-capital/actionarul-majoritar-francez-de-la-conted-dorohoi-face-o-oferta-publica-de-preluare-la-un-pret-cu-30-peste-cel-de-piata-18842021)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder (~62%+ as of 2018-19) and thin float; sharp 2024 decline in revenue (-20.6%) and earnings (-92%) ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/CNTE/financials/)); dependence on European fashion customers; current shareholder register not verified (2025 annual report on BVB: [BVB](https://www.bvb.ro/infocont/infocont26/CNTE_20260327165507_Comunicat-de-presa-bvb-raport-anual-2025-EN.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Controlling shareholder Hamidi Haissam 62.12% (Nov 2018) ([Bursa.ro](https://www.bursa.ro/hamidi-haissam-lanseaza-o-oferta-publica-de-preluare-a-conted-43023637)); management holdings not disclosed.

thesis.business_description: Cluj-Napoca (Romania) company (S.C. Unirea S.A., Piata 1 Mai 1-2) that has converted from a former factory into a landlord: about 90% of revenue is rent from its own commercial/office property; roughly 8-10 employees.
thesis.competitive_position: Small property-rental business on land in Cluj-Napoca (privatised in 2007, when Ben & Ben bought the majority and a 49,000 sq m plot from AVAS); the asset base, not an operating moat, is the value driver. Revenue was about RON 6.2M in 2025 (+30%) with net profit of about RON 1.33M ([Actual de Cluj](https://actualdecluj.ro/fosta-fabrica-din-piata-1-mai-transformata-in-landlord-acum-cu-10-angajati-unirea-sa-castiga-90-din-venituri-din-chirii-cifra-de-afaceri-a-sarit-de-62-milioane-de-lei-in-2025-cu-30-fata-de-anul/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Mirela Bene 44.49%, Ben & Ben SA Cluj-Napoca 23.67%, Napocamin SRL 14.8% (undated figures from [Actual de Cluj](https://actualdecluj.ro/fosta-fabrica-din-piata-1-mai-transformata-in-landlord-acum-cu-10-angajati-unirea-sa-castiga-90-din-venituri-din-chirii-cifra-de-afaceri-a-sarit-de-62-milioane-de-lei-in-2025-cu-30-fata-de-anul/)); the AGM of April 2026 recorded 73.36% of capital present ([BVB](https://m.bvb.ro/info/Raportari/UNIR/UNIR_20260430192321_raport-AGOA-2026.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling group (Bene family companies) holds about 83% combined, leaving a very small free float; repeated AGM quorum failures (Aug 2025, April 2026 and September 2026 first convenings) ([BVB](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/UNIR/UNIR_20260902162202_RAPORT-AGOA-01-09-neintrunire.pdf)); September 2026 AGM agenda included a real-estate mortgage on a property at Drumul Sfantul Ioan 1 ([BVB](https://m.bvb.ro/FinancialInstruments/SelectedData/NewsItem/UNIR-Convocare-AGAO-1-2-septembrie-2026/3D114)); land has been sold to a bank for RON 7M previously ([Actual de Cluj](https://actualdecluj.ro/o-fabrica-din-cluj-vinde-teren-catre-o-banca-pentru-7-milioane-lei/)); single-asset concentration and thin liquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: Bene family group (Mirela Bene 44.49%; Ben & Ben 23.67%; Napocamin 14.8%, described as companies in the Ioan Bene group), undated, per [Actual de Cluj](https://actualdecluj.ro/fosta-fabrica-din-piata-1-mai-transformata-in-landlord-acum-cu-10-angajati-unirea-sa-castiga-90-din-venituri-din-chirii-cifra-de-afaceri-a-sarit-de-62-milioane-de-lei-in-2025-cu-30-fata-de-anul/).

thesis.business_description: Aztec International S.A. (Tarnowo Podgorne, Poland) makes washers (sealing washers), roof flashings and fasteners; subsidiaries include Aztec UK Ltd, Aztec Dichtscheiben GmbH and a 60% stake in Bimecom SA ([Ford Equity via ResearchPool](https://app.researchpool.com/provider/ford-equity-research/aztec-international-sa-azc-ford-equity-international-rating-and-forecast-report); [2025 group report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/1884_20260401_125200_Sprawozdanie-Zarzadu-z-dzialalnosci-Grupy-Kapitalowej-2025-sig.pdf)). Sells mainly in Poland, UK and Germany.
thesis.competitive_position: A niche fastener/sealing-washer maker with UK and German sales subsidiaries but no evidence of a durable moat: 2025 sales fell 41.7% mainly because two significant sales contracts expired at end-2024 and competitive pressure persisted ([Management Board letter 2025](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/1883_20260401_123700_List-Zarzadu-do-Akcjonariuszy-i-Inwestorow-2025-sig.pdf)). This indicates meaningful customer concentration and weak pricing power.
thesis.main_shareholders: Latest ownership table found is outdated (Q2 2014 report): Matthew de Graan 32.74%, Henry de Graan 31.76%, Hamade LCC 8.54% ([PAP, Q2 2014](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/17154959/DOC.20140807.17154959.Aztec_International_IIQ_2014-0.pdf)). Current register not verified; 3,414,667 shares outstanding ([2025 board statement](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/1883_20260401_123700_Sprawozdanie-Zarzadu-z-dzialalnosci-Aztec-International-SA-2025-sig.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Sales -41.7% and net loss at parent and group level in 2025 ([Management Board letter](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/1883_20260401_123700_List-Zarzadu-do-Akcjonariuszy-i-Inwestorow-2025-sig.pdf)); loss of two large sales contracts (customer concentration); key audit matters are revenue recognition and inventory (2023 inventory PLN 6.64m, [auditor report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/51258883/DOC.20250403.51258883.7._Sprawozdanie_niezaleznego_bieglego_rewidenta_z_badania_rocznego_jednostkowe-6.pdf)); NewConnect micro-cap with thin liquidity (market cap USD ~1.5m vs equity ~USD 4m).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (CEO Rafal Cedrowski signs the 2025 report; no holding found; the de Graan holders in the 2014 table may be founder/insiders but this was not confirmed).

thesis.business_description: Wroclaw-based importer and distributor of electrotechnical products, mainly LED lighting and accessories, owning the NEXTEC and NEXTEC PREMIUM brands; sells in Poland.
thesis.competitive_position: Small importer/distributor of LED lighting products with owned brands but no moat, facing price competition from Asian-sourced lighting and larger distributors; 2024 revenue was about PLN 12.9M ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/239131-poltronic); [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/PTN/)). Management report for 2025 was filed in March 2026 ([Sprawozdanie Zarzadu 2025](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/1658_20260320_131400_3_2025_Sprawozdanie-Zarządu-POLTRONIC-SA-2025-sig.pdf)). A Chinese subsidiary (ChengDi Co. Ltd.) was wound up ([Money.pl](https://www.money.pl/gielda/komunikaty/6782949010126465.html)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Per the May 2026 periodic report: Jaroslaw Leszczyszyn 64.60% of share capital; Marek Kolodziejski 16.77%; other holders 18.63% (share capital PLN 3,579,000) ([Poltronic periodic report, May 2026](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-05/20260515_110104_0000002563_0000073311.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder Leszczyszyn owns 64.60% and, with the CEO's 16.77%, insiders hold about 81%, leaving a free float of about 19% and thin liquidity ([Poltronic periodic report, May 2026](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-05/20260515_110104_0000002563_0000073311.pdf)). The management board has a single member (CEO Marek Kolodziejski), a governance concentration risk. NewConnect-listed micro-cap; closure of the ChengDi subsidiary ([Money.pl](https://www.money.pl/gielda/komunikaty/6782949010126465.html)). No going-concern or auditor-qualification wording found.
thesis.insider_ownership: Marek Kolodziejski (sole management board member and CEO) 16.77%; Jaroslaw Leszczyszyn 64.60% (controlling holder) ([Poltronic periodic report, May 2026](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-05/20260515_110104_0000002563_0000073311.pdf)).

thesis.business_description: Warsaw-based (NewConnect) PC/console game publisher and developer, dependent on the DRIFT21/DRIFTCE title (about 466,105 net copies sold and ~EUR 3.17m net revenue before publisher split as of Q2 2025).
thesis.competitive_position: Micro-cap game company whose results hinge on one title; management shifted its model after talks with PlayWay S.A. and is discussing simulator-genre projects with PlayWay ([Q2 2025 report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/52225017/DOC.20250814.52225017.ECC_Games_Raport_kwartalny_Q2_2025_final_PW_JT-0.pdf)). It ended a publishing agreement with Boombit S.A. in Feb 2024 ([Parkiet](https://parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art39825311-zawarcie-porozumienia-w-sprawie-rozwiazania-umowy-wydawniczej-z-boombit-s-a)). No moat beyond a single game IP.
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Single-title revenue concentration (DRIFT21) ([Q2 2025 report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/52225017/DOC.20250814.52225017.ECC_Games_Raport_kwartalny_Q2_2025_final_PW_JT-0.pdf)); terminated Boombit publishing agreement ([Parkiet](https://parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art39825311-zawarcie-porozumienia-w-sprawie-rozwiazania-umowy-wydawniczej-z-boombit-s-a)); market cap (~USD 1.35m) is at book value with tiny liquidity; shareholder structure not verified; strategic dependence on PlayWay relationship.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Robinson Europe S.A. (Bielsko-Biala, Poland; founded 1991) sells fishing equipment under its own brands in Poland and abroad; listed on NewConnect.
thesis.competitive_position: Small own-brand fishing-tackle distributor in a competitive consumer niche with no verified moat. Revenue for 2024 was about PLN 22.2m (+8.3%) with earnings of about PLN 0.33m (+32%) per an aggregator; a PLN 0.10 per share dividend for 2025 was paid in 2026 ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/RBS); [Biznesradar dividend page](https://www.biznesradar.pl/dywidenda/RBS)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Robinson Europe S.A. itself holds 370,959 treasury shares = 19.82% (Bankier, 2025-11-20); Slawomir Pszczola 250,000 shares = 13.36% (last entry dated 2016-03-30, may be outdated) ([Bankier shareholders](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/ROBINSON/akcjonariat)).
thesis.red_flags: Large treasury stake (about 19.8%) from ongoing buybacks, with an AGM agenda item to cancel treasury shares and reduce capital, shrinking free float and liquidity on NewConnect ([Parkiet buyback notice](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art43381021-robinson-europe-spolka-akcyjna-skup-akcji-wlasnych)); very thin earnings (PLN 0.33m on PLN 22.2m revenue); shareholder register not fully verified.
thesis.insider_ownership: Slawomir Pszczola listed at 13.36% (2016 data); management role not verified ([Bankier shareholders](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/ROBINSON/akcjonariat)).

thesis.business_description: SC Iprolam SA (Bucharest) is a heavy-engineering and design company that builds and modernizes rolling mills for metallurgy clients (ALRO Slatina, ArcelorMittal Roman, Liberty Galati, Erdemir Targoviste per its 2023 report), with some design services; registered CAEN activity is R&D.
thesis.competitive_position: Niche Romanian rolling-mill engineering contractor with ISO certifications and a small client base concentrated in metallurgy ([2023 annual report](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/IPRO/IPRO_20240426154047_RAPORT-ANUAL-2023.pdf)). Third-party data show 2025 revenue of about RON 10.35m and a loss of about RON 7.16m ([Targetare](https://targetare.ro/329/iprolam-sa)); equity RON 9.43m at 31 Dec 2025 per auditor ELF EXPERT ([BVB](https://www.bvb.ro/info/Raportari/IPRO/IPRO_20260423171537_Raport-de-audit-financiar-la-31-12-2025-IPROLAM-S-A.pdf)). No evident moat beyond know-how.
thesis.main_shareholders: UZIN International S.A. 30.247% (306,769 shares in the 2021 count) and other shareholders 69.753% per the 2021 annual report ([BVB](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/IPRO/IPRO-RAPORT%20ANUAL%202021.pdf)); the company is described in 2026 filings as part of the UZINGROUP group; current register not verified (11,156,288 shares now).
thesis.red_flags: Customer concentration in metallurgy; loss-making (2025 loss about RON 7.16m with an elevated insolvency risk rating on Targetare; Q1 2026 net loss RON 998.4k) ([Targetare](https://targetare.ro/329/iprolam-sa); [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/ro/capital-goods/bvb-ipro/sc-iprolam-shares/management)); controlling-group dynamics with UZINGROUP; low free float on BVB.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Sofia-based Bulgarian company (founded 1990) described by data providers as a maker, importer, distributor and servicer of PC components and IT systems, with about 15 employees; listed on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (ticker SBS) after a 2024 IPO ([StockAnalysis profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bul/SBS/company); [Profit.bg on the IPO prospectus](https://profit.bg/article/2024012319494618554)).
thesis.competitive_position: Very small domestic IT hardware/system integrator with no evident moat; competes with larger Bulgarian distributors and global OEMs. 2025 revenue about BGN 3.5M (+1.9%), with net income near zero after a roughly BGN 1.7M loss on asset sales (aggregator figures, [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bul/SBS/financials/)), not audited-report figures.
thesis.main_shareholders: At the 2024 IPO prospectus: SBS-linked holding entity 37.99%, Kiril Jelyazkov 31.08%, Antoaneta Jelyazkova 16.83%, Borislav Bratanov 7.58% ([Profit.bg, FSC prospectus approval](https://profit.bg/article/2024012319494618554)); Simply Wall St later shows the top 4 holders at 70.46% ([ownership page](https://simplywall.st/stocks/bg/tech/bul-sbs/specialized-business-systems-ad-shares/ownership)).
thesis.red_flags: Shareholder concentration (top 4 holders about 70% to 94% of capital depending on date) and family control; thin BSE liquidity after a small IPO; revenue base of only about BGN 3.5M with a 2024 net loss of roughly BGN 0.19M and a large 2025 asset-sale loss ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bul/SBS/financials/)); official 2025 annual report not reviewed.
thesis.insider_ownership: Kiril Jelyazkov 31.08% and Antoaneta Jelyazkova 16.83% (Profit.bg, IPO prospectus data, https://profit.bg/article/2024012319494618554); Borislav Bratanov 7.58% (same source; role not verified).

thesis.business_description: Mineral Midrange S.A. (Warsaw, NewConnect) mainly distributes software and provides IT services, notably IBM Planning Analytics implementations for cost planning and financial reporting; Polish customers, 14 employees.
thesis.competitive_position: Tiny software reseller/integrator with no visible moat; value rests on a few implementation projects and vendor relationships. 2025 net profit fell to about PLN 319k from about PLN 885k, and 2024 revenue was about PLN 16.13m, per the 2025 management report ([NewConnect EBI](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/1972_20260410_160500_2026-03-23-MINERAL-MIDRANGE-Sprawozdanie-z-dzialalności-2025.pdf)). Market cap was about PLN 3.73m in May 2026 ([Stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/MND/market-cap/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Latest holdings I could retrieve are dated December 2022 (shareholders present at EGM, not necessarily the full register): Tomasz Lewicki 26.42% of votes (1,165,000 shares); Robert Twarowski 23.51%, Marcin Zantonowicz 14.71%, Marek Wojtachnia 11.95% (resumed EGM 15 Dec 2022) ([filings index](https://financialfilings.com/companies/mineral-midrange-spolka-akcyjna/); [Bankier shareholder page](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/MINERAL/akcjonariat), share capital PLN 440,871, 4,408,709 votes). A 5%-holders list for the 11 Jun 2026 AGM exists ([money.pl](https://www.money.pl/gielda/spolki-gpw/plmnrlm00010,emitent,1.html)) but its content was not retrievable.
thesis.red_flags: Micro-scale (14 staff, market cap under PLN 4m) with earnings volatility (2025 net profit down about 64%); concentrated, shifting shareholder base between EGM lists in late 2022 suggesting control disputes or changes; NewConnect-level liquidity and disclosure.
thesis.insider_ownership: Tomasz Lewicki (CEO) held 26.42% of votes at the 1 Dec 2022 EGM (1,165,000 shares) per ESPI shareholder list as reported via search; current stake not confirmed.

thesis.business_description: Generationis.ai S.A. (Opole, Poland; formerly INFRA S.A., renamed 2 September 2024) is a technology company listed on NewConnect with no subsidiaries as of 31 Dec 2025; CEO Piotr Wolasewicz describes 2025 as a year of building foundations for future growth ([2025 annual report](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-06/20260601_230121_0000003319_0000080199.pdf); [Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/INFRA/podstawowe-dane)). Revenue is only about PLN 0.28m ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/IFA/financials/metrics)).
thesis.competitive_position: A pivoting micro-cap (formerly INFRA) repositioned as an AI company with negligible revenue (about PLN 282k) and no demonstrated competitive position or moat; the share price fell about 62% in the year to May 2026 with market cap around 3.9m ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/IFA/market-cap/)). Strategy and revenue sources were not verifiable from the sources found.
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Near-zero revenue (PLN 282k) and a strategic pivot with no track record; share price down about 62% in a year ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/IFA/market-cap/)); name/strategy change in 2024 and supervisory board re-appointed 29 August 2024 ([Q3 2024 report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/50101977/DOC.20241114.50101977.GENERATIONIS.AI_S.A._raport_kwartalny_za_3Q2024_ed-0.pdf)); NewConnect micro-cap with thin liquidity; no subsidiaries or diversified operations. Going-concern wording not retrieved.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: LC S.A. (formerly Ampli S.A.; renamed around 17 June 2025 per one data service; Tarnow, Poland) is a wholesaler and retailer of electrical materials in Poland (cables, lighting sources, installation accessories, switches).
thesis.competitive_position: Micro-cap regional distributor of electrical products in a fragmented, price-driven Polish market with no verified moat ([StockAnalysis profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/APL/company); [Parkiet company page](https://www.parkiet.com/spolka/ampli)). Financial data for FY2025 could not be located in search results.
thesis.main_shareholders: Artur Kostyrzewski 460,000 shares = 14.01% and Marek Moskal 380,813 shares = 11.60% of 3,282,000 shares (undated Parkiet data; may be outdated) ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/spolka/ampli)).
thesis.red_flags: Very small size and thin liquidity on the main-market ticker APL; shareholder data undated and the name change from Ampli to LC S.A. increases confusion with the unrelated LC Corp/Develia; shareholder structure not fully verified ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/spolka/ampli)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Provide IT Sweden AB (publ) is a Swedish digital agency/IT consultancy offering web and system development and consultant services under two brands; fiscal year ends 31 March ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/xsat/PROVIT/company); [Inderes release](https://www.inderes.se/en/releases/provide-it-sweden-ab-bokslutskommunike-20242025)). Sweden-based.
thesis.competitive_position: A tiny IT-consulting/web agency with no evident moat; the CEO wrote in the Q2 2025/26 report that the company needs larger volumes of new sales ([Inderes Q2 2025/26](https://www.inderes.se/releases/provide-it-sweden-ab-quarterly-report-q2-20252026)). Q3 2025/26 revenue was SEK 5.7m with an operating loss of SEK 0.5m; Q4 revenue was SEK 6.7m (vs SEK 7.7m) with operating profit of SEK 0.1m (vs loss SEK 0.5m) ([Inderes / year-end report](https://www.inderes.se/en/releases/provide-it-sweden-ab-bokslutskommunike-20242025)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Undated Inderes/Millistream list: Avanza Pension 15.0%, MPPK HoldCo AB 12.9%, Christer Eriksson 5.6% ([Inderes ownership](https://www.inderes.se/en/companies/Provide-IT-Sweden/ownership)). MPPK HoldCo AB (owned by Philip Kornmann, Marek Pietrzak and Mariusz Pietrzak) bought 846,840 shares from Faraj Industries AB in 2025 ([Inderes year-end report](https://www.inderes.se/en/releases/provide-it-sweden-ab-bokslutskommunike-20242025)).
thesis.red_flags: Recent change of control and CEO (Philip Kornmann replaced Bawan Faraj on 28 April 2025); new owners also run Codepole AB, a consultancy that rents out IT consultants like Provide (potential conflict of interest) ([Inderes](https://www.inderes.se/en/releases/provide-it-sweden-ab-bokslutskommunike-20242025)); liquidity-provider agreement terminated (announced Nov 2025) on a very illiquid micro-cap ([Inderes Q2 2025/26](https://www.inderes.se/releases/provide-it-sweden-ab-quarterly-report-q2-20252026)); volatile quarterly losses, revenue volatility; sales volumes need to grow. Going-concern wording not found.
thesis.insider_ownership: Philip Kornmann (CEO since 28 April 2025) co-owns MPPK HoldCo AB (12.9% in the Inderes table) with Marek and Mariusz Pietrzak ([Inderes](https://www.inderes.se/en/companies/Provide-IT-Sweden/ownership)); an April 2025 insider entry shows 13,888 shares for MPPK HoldCo (financialreports.eu).

thesis.business_description: Constantinou Bros Developers PLC (Paphos, Cyprus) is a real-estate developer listed on the Cyprus Stock Exchange, with shares listed in December 2025; it belongs to the Constantinou Bros group that also includes Constantinou Bros Hotels and Constantinou Bros Properties.
thesis.competitive_position: Very small Paphos-based developer in the Constantinou Bros group; no demonstrated moat beyond group brand and local land/project access. FY2025 annual report data: revenue EUR 572k, net income EUR 318k, total assets EUR 2.12m, equity EUR 687k ([FinancialReports.eu](https://financialreports.eu/companies/constantinou-bros-developers-plc)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Micro-scale and recently listed (Dec 2025) with extremely thin liquidity; data vendors show conflicting share counts and market capitalisation (Simply Wall St shows about 14.99k shares and EUR 37.8k cap vs TradingView price EUR 2.52), so the input market cap of USD 0.04m is unreliable ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/cy/real-estate-management-and-development/cse-cbd/constantinou-bros-developers-shares/information)); possible related-party/group dynamics with the Constantinou family not verified.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed
